title: Business Analyst
description:
**Project Role :** 
 Business Analyst
   

  

**Project Role Description :** 
 Analyze an organization and design its processes and systems, assessing the business model and its integration with technology. Assess current state, identify customer requirements, and define the future state and/or business solution. Research, gather and synthesize information.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 SAP EWM
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 NA
   

  

**Minimum 7\.5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

 Summary:
   

  

 As a Business Analyst, a typical day involves thoroughly examining the structure and operations of an organization to understand how its processes and systems function together. This role requires evaluating the existing business model and its alignment with technological solutions. The professional spends time identifying the needs and expectations of customers, envisioning improved future states or business solutions, and conducting detailed research to collect and integrate relevant information. Collaboration and critical thinking are essential to ensure that the organization s processes are optimized and well\-integrated with technology to support business goals effectively.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities:
   

  

* Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform.
* Responsible for team decisions.
* Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
* Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams.
* Lead efforts to align business processes with technological capabilities to enhance overall efficiency.
* Facilitate communication between stakeholders to ensure clarity and consensus on project objectives.
* Support junior team members by providing guidance and sharing knowledge to foster professional growth.


 Professional \& Technical Skills:
   

  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in SAP EWM.
* Strong analytical skills to assess and improve business processes.
* Excellent communication abilities to interact effectively with diverse teams and stakeholders.
* Experience in gathering and synthesizing complex information to support decision\-making.
* Ability to design and document business solutions that integrate technology and process improvements.
* Skilled in facilitating collaboration across multiple teams to achieve project goals.


 Additional Information:
   

  

* The candidate should have minimum 7\.5 years of experience in SAP EWM.
* This position is based at our Gurugram office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

title: Manager Business Analyst
description:
**About The Opportunity**
 Job Type: Permanent

**Job Description**
**Title** 
 Manager Business Analyst
   

  

**Department** 
 CE Technology
   

  

**Location** 
 Gurgaon/Bangalore
   

  

**Level** 
 5
   

  

 We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together \- and supporting each other \- all over the world. So, join our team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.
   

  

**About Your Team**
 Corporate Enablers Technology encompasses four distinct portfolios: Chief Finance Officer (CFO), Chief People Officer (CPO), General Counsel (GC), and Corporate Property Services (CPS). We provide the underlying technology for managing for example Fidelity’s core finance, HR, procurement, legal, risk and compliance, statutory reporting, real estate management, global security, and business continuity processes.
   

  

**About Your Role**
 As the Manager Business Analyst within the on Corporate Property Services (CPS) technology team, you will be responsible for end\-to\-end analysis of complex business requirements and the design of high\-quality solutions that align system capabilities, data capabilities, and business objectives. You will play a critical role in cross\-functional collaboration, working closely with Product, Technology, and external vendors to ensure effective solution delivery. This role requires a strong blend of business and technical analysis skills, deep understanding of processes and data, and the ability to drive clarity and execution within an agile delivery environment. This role will entail forging close working relationships with our colleagues in Corporate Property Services.
   

  

**About You**
**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead complex, high impact business analysis across strategic initiatives, translating ambiguous business problems into clear outcomes, prioritised requirements
* Act as the critical bridge between business, product, technology and external partners, ensuring solutions are commercially sound, \& technically feasible. Ability to understand a vendor product at pace is key.
* Drive pace and quality in delivery by using AI\-enabled analysis techniques, rapid prototyping, process mining, and structured decision making to accelerate discovery, validation, and solution design.
* Drive the end to end requirements lifecycle, from problem definition and stakeholder alignment through to solution validation, benefits realisation, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Raise the capability of the BA function by coaching colleagues, setting standards for high quality artefacts, challenging weak analysis, and embedding best practice across requirements, process design and stakeholder engagement.
* Lead process discovery and optimisation activity, using process mapping to challenge stakeholders to remove redundant steps, reduce handoffs, improve controls, and create leaner, more effective operating models.


**Experience \& Qualifications**
* 10\-12 years of business analysis experience in large or cross\-system projects, preferably in financial services.
* Strong BA competencies including process design, BRD creation, rule definition, business modelling, user stories, and data analysis.
* Strong data analysis skills (e.g., SQL fundamentals, understanding of data structures, validating data logic).
* Experience working within Agile, SAFe, Lean, Six Sigma, or hybrid delivery environments, with adaptability and a continuous‑learning mindset.
* Familiarity with tools like Jira, Confluence; MS Visio and Excel proficiency.
* Ability to participate in solution design discussions, provide requirement\-based analysis, and collaborate closely with Technology teams.
* Experience working with vendors, including managing requirements, coordinating interfaces, and ensuring delivery alignment.
* Strong understanding of enterprise architecture and system data flows, with the ability to interpret end\-to\-end data dependencies.
* High attention to detail with the ability to identify gaps in requirements, processes, data, or documentation.
* Skilled in facilitating business workshops, driving requirement clarity, scope alignment, shared understanding.


**Good to Have:**
* Experience in Corporate Property Services or corporate enabler domains.
* Integration analysis experience, such as API design, interface specifications, message flows, and end\-to\-end process mapping.
* Cloud data migration and data governance exposure.


**Feel rewarded**
 For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. title: Business Analyst (Pension Domain Knowledge)
description:
***Key Responsibilities:***




  




* Gather \& document business requirements specific to pension administration, legal/regulatory provisions (CCS Pension Rules, 1972\) \& fund/grant management processes.
* Act as the subject\-matter expert on pension domain rules \& calculations, translating complex domain regulations into functional specifications for the technical team.
* Map end\-to\-end workflows for pension sanction (PPO tracking/Bhavishya), grievance redressal (CPENGRAMS), retiree experience (Anubhav) \& life\-certificate (DLC/Jeevan Pramaan) processes.
* Support design of the unified pensioner identity \& Master Data Management approach anchored on the PPO number.
* Define acceptance criteria, validation rules \& reporting metrics relevant to pension\-sanction SLAs \& grievance\-resolution timelines.
* Perform User Acceptance Testing (UAT) \& other domain\-related testing/validation, and support training \& change\-management for DoPPW officials \& field offices.
* Liaise with DoPPW, CPAO, disbursing banks, the Directorate of Estates \& pensioner associations to validate domain requirements.



  





***Required Skills and Qualifications:***




  




* Bachelor's/Master's degree in any stream preferably Computer Science, IT, Business Administration, or related field; background in Public Administration, Economics, Finance or Pension Administration is desirable.
* 8\+ years of experience in business analysis, of which substantial experience should be in the pension, HR, or Government retirement\-benefits domain.
* Strong working knowledge of CCS (Pension) Rules, 1972 \& related Central Government pension processes.
* Strong skills in requirement elicitation, business process modelling (BPMN) \& functional specification documentation.
* Experience working with large\-scale Government digital platforms, and familiarity with accessibility/compliance frameworks (GIGW 3\.0, WCAG 2\.1, DPDP Act).
* Ability to perform UAT, prepare test scenarios \& validate system outputs against pension\-domain business rules.
* Excellent communication \& stakeholder\-engagement skills to work with DoPPW, pensioner associations \& the technical team.
* Certifications (desirable): CBAP / CCBA / PMI\-PBA or equivalent Business Analysis certification.

title: Lead: Unit Economics & NPV Strategy
description:
**Description**
 About The Company
   

  

 FairMoney is a pioneering mobile banking institution specializing in extending credit to emerging markets. Established in 2017, the company currently operates primarily within Nigeria, and it has secured nearly €50 million in funding from renowned global investors, including Tiger Global, DST, and Flourish Ventures.
   

  

 In alignment with its vision, FairMoney is actively constructing the foremost mobile banking platform and point\-of\-sale (POS) solution tailored for emerging markets. The journey began with the introduction of a digital microcredit application exclusively available on Android and iOS devices.
   

  

 Today, FairMoney has significantly expanded its range of services, encompassing a comprehensive suite of financial products, such as current accounts, savings accounts, debit cards, and state\-of\-the\-art POS solutions designed to meet the needs of both merchants and agents. FairMoney thrives on its diverse workforce, bringing together talent from over 27 nationalities.
   

  

 We operate at massive scale, move fast, and expect leaders to think in systems, not silos. Decisions are data\-driven, accountability is explicit, and impact matters.
   

  

 This role sits at the heart of how FairMoney decides
 **who to lend to, how much to lend, at what price, and why** 
 .
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are hiring a
 **Lead: Unit Economics \& NPV Strategy** 
 to own, improve, and operationalise FairMoney’s existing NPV and unit economics frameworks and ensure they become a core operating system for decision\-making, not just analytical artefacts.
   

  

 While FairMoney already has NPV models in place, they are not yet consistently embedded into credit decisions, pricing, experimentation, and growth trade\-offs. This role exists to close that gap.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be the single source of truth on
 **value creation vs value destruction** 
 , expected vs actual performance, and the economic impact of risk, pricing, and growth decisions.
   

  

 This is a senior, high\-ownership role for someone who pushes the bar, challenges assumptions, and thrives in a high\-growth, high\-pressure environment.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Own NPV \& Unit Economics: Own, audit, and improve NPV and unit economics models across lending products, ensuring consistent assumptions and decision\-ready outputs for pricing, credit cut\-offs, and capital allocation.
* Measure Expected vs Actual Performance: Build frameworks to measure performance across products, cohorts, credit policies, pricing strategies, and experiments, identifying key drivers of variance and feeding insights back into risk and pricing decisions.
* Drive Experimentation \& Value Attribution: Partner with Risk, Data Science, Product, and Growth to define NPV hypotheses, measure incremental economic value, and identify which initiatives should be scaled, improved, or stopped.
* Influence Business Decisions: Translate complex economic analysis into clear trade\-offs and provide credible insights to senior leadership, challenging models, policies, and decisions when the economics do not support them.
* Embed NPV in Decision\-Making: Integrate NPV thinking into credit policy reviews, risk governance, pricing and limit discussions, and planning cycles, while setting standards for transparency, documentation, and assumption discipline.
* Raise the Analytical Bar: Operate with high ownership and integrity, challenge analytical and execution standards, stay adaptable under pressure, and contribute to FairMoney’s mission of providing responsible access to credit.


**Requirements**
 Must\-Haves
   

  

* Strong experience in unit economics, NPV, LTV, or portfolio profitability (lending, fintech, banking, or adjacent sectors).
* Deep understanding of credit economics and how risk, pricing, tenure, and behaviour interact.
* Proven track record of measuring expected vs actual outcomes.
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders using data and logic.
* High ownership mindset with bias toward action.


 Nice\-To\-Have
   

  

* Experience in high\-growth fintech or scale\-up environments.
* Exposure to experimentation frameworks (A/B testing, policy tests, pricing tests).
* Strong SQL / Python / analytics tooling capability.
* Experience working closely with Risk, Data Science, and Growth teams.


 What Success Looks Like
   

  

 By Month 3
   

  

* Existing NPV models are audited, rationalised, and standardised.
* A portfolio\-level NPV view exists across all major products.
* Leadership has clear visibility into where value is created or destroyed.
* Experiments are routinely evaluated on NPV uplift versus control.


 By Month 6
   

  

* NPV actively drives decisions on:
* Credit cut\-offs
* Pricing bands
* Growth investment trade\-offs
* Gaps between expected and actual performance are measured, explained, and shrinking.
* Risk, Data Science, and Growth teams operate using a shared economic language.
* Leadership trusts NPV outputs enough to make difficult, high\-impact decisions.


 Final Note
   

  

 This is not a passive analytics role.
   

  

 We are looking for someone who is comfortable challenging assumptions, pushing for clarity, and holding the line on economic truth — even when it is inconvenient.
   

  

 If you are motivated by scale, complexity, ownership, and impact, this role will stretch you and reward you.
   

  

**Benefits**
* Paid Time Off
* Training \& Development
* Flexible work structure


**Recruitment Process**
* A screening call with a member of the recruitment team.
* Technical interview with the hiring manager.
* Case study round.
* Panel session based on the case study.

title: Senior Program coordinator/ Program Officer - Technical and Operation
description:
**Overview**
 Jhpiego is an international, non\-profit health organization and an affiliate of Johns Hopkins University, dedicated to improving the health of women and families in developing countries. For over 50 years, it has focused on providing high\-quality, low\-cost health care solutions, training health workers, and strengthening health systems.
   

  

 Jhpiego has been working in India since the 1980s in close partnership with national and state governments. With deep technical expertise and strong on\-the\-ground execution, Jhpiego helps design, test, and scale practical solutions and innovations that fit real\-world systems across 11 thematic domains (Maternal and Newborn Health, Reproductive Health, Nutrition, Immunization, Comprehensive Primary Health Care, Human Resources for Health, TB and Infectious Diseases, Global Health Security, Women's Cancers, Non\-Communicable Diseases, Digital Health).
   

  

**About The Program**
 Jhpiego provides strategic technical assistance to the Government of India's National TB Elimination Program (NTEP) to accelerate TB elimination through health systems strengthening, implementation research, digital innovations, and evidence\-based interventions. Working closely with the Central TB Division (CTD), State TB Cells, the National Health Mission (NHM), and development partners, Jhpiego supports the delivery of high\-quality, people\-centered TB services across the continuum of care.
   

  

 The program implements several national and multi\-state initiatives, including the Pro TB Impact Project, which strengthens TB service delivery at the primary healthcare level by integrating routine TB screening into Ayushman Arogya Mandirs (AAMs) and maternal health services, promoting differentiated care for high\-risk TB patients, and establishing learning labs to generate evidence for scalable interventions. Jhpiego also leads the Cough Syrup Sales Surveillance Initiative, an innovative pharmacy and AYUSH\-linked surveillance model that leverages digital technologies, community engagement, and referral systems to enable early identification of individuals with presumptive TB and ensure timely linkage to diagnostic and treatment services under NTEP.

title: Business Analyst
description:
**About the Role**




 We are looking for a business\-first analyst who thinks in outcomes, not dashboards. You will sit at the intersection of business strategy, analytics, and applied AI, translating stakeholder problems into data\-driven answers, and using AI agents and automation to make analytics faster, cheaper, and more repeatable. This is not a pure data role and not a pure AI engineering role. It is for someone who understands how the business makes money, can hold a room of senior stakeholders, and knows how to put modern AI tooling to work on real day\-to\-day analytics problems.
 



  





**What You Will Do:**




**Business analytics \& stakeholder management**



* Own the analytics agenda for one or more business units and understand their P\&L, KPIs, operating rhythm, and decision cycles.
* Partner with functional and leadership stakeholders to frame problems, define success metrics, and drive decisions with evidence.
* Present findings and recommendations to senior leadership; build alignment and challenge assumptions with data where needed.
* Take end\-to\-end accountability for analytics deliverables: scope, quality, timelines, and business impact.



  





**Reporting \& data**



* Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards and self\-serve reporting that leadership actually uses.
* Write and optimize SQL across large datasets; define metric logic and ensure a single source of truth.
* Work with data engineering on data models, pipelines, and data\-quality issues that block good analysis.



  





**Applied \& agentic AI**



* Identify high\-value, repetitive analytics workflows (report generation, variance commentary, data QA, ad\-hoc query handling, root\-cause analysis) and automate them using LLMs and AI agents.
* Design and deploy agentic workflows (multi\-step agents that pull data, run analysis, generate insights, and route outputs to stakeholders) with appropriate guardrails and human review.
* Evaluate and integrate AI tools (LLM APIs, agent frameworks, Copilot\-style assistants, RAG over business documentation) into the analytics stack.
* Act as the internal evangelist for AI\-augmented analytics by coaching analysts and business users on effective, responsible use.



  





**What We Are Looking For Must\-have**



* 2\+ years in business analytics, business intelligence, or a similar role with direct exposure to business decision\-making.
* Strong commercial acumen. You can explain how a business works and where the levers are.
* Proven ability to influence and convince senior stakeholders; comfortable with pushback and ambiguity.
* Demonstrated ownership: you have shipped things end to end and are accountable for outcomes, not just outputs.
* Advanced Power BI (data modelling, DAX, performance tuning, row\-level security, deployment).
* Advanced SQL (complex joins, window functions, CTEs, query optimisation).
* Hands\-on experience with applied AI in a business context, including prompt engineering, LLM APIs, and building or deploying AI agents / agentic workflows (e.g. LangChain/LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Copilot Studio, Claude/OpenAI agent SDKs, or equivalent).
* Practical understanding of where AI agents work well, where they fail, and how to design for reliability, cost, and governance.



  





**Good to have**



* Python for analysis and automation (pandas, notebooks, APIs).
* Experience with RAG, vector databases, or fine\-tuning for internal knowledge use cases.
* Exposure to Power BI \+ AI integrations (Copilot in Power BI, Fabric, Azure OpenAI).
* Experience in fintech, lending, or BFSI is a plus.
* Familiarity with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Azure Synapse).



  





**Who You Are**



* Business\-outcome obsessed. You start from the decision, not the data.
* A clear communicator who can simplify complexity for non\-technical leaders.
* Curious and pragmatic about AI. Excited by what agents can do, sceptical enough to test before trusting.
* Comfortable owning a problem with no playbook and being the person leadership calls when something needs to get done.



  





**What Success Looks Like in 12 Months**



* Leadership relies on your dashboards and analysis for key operating decisions.
* At least 3 to 5 recurring analytics workflows are running through AI agents with measurable time savings.
* Stakeholders see you as a trusted advisor, not a report builder.
* The analytics team's use of AI tooling has visibly matured because of you.

title: Lead Data Analyst
description:
**About Our Company**
 Ameriprise India LLP has been providing client based financial solutions to help clients plan and achieve their financial objectives for 20 years. We are part of Ameriprise Financial Inc., a US financial planning company headquartered in Minneapolis with a global presence and diversified financial services leader with more than $1\.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year\-end 2024\. The firm’s focus areas include Asset Management and Advice, Retirement Planning and Insurance Protection.
   

  

 Be part of an inclusive, collaborative culture that rewards you for your contributions, and work with other talented individuals who share your passion for doing great work. You’ll also have plenty of opportunities to make your mark at the office and a difference in your community. So, if you're talented, driven and want to work for a strong, ethical company that cares, take the next step and create a career at Ameriprise India LLP.
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are seeking a Lead \- Data Analyst for Reporting and Operations role in ABGD group, who can think strategically and interpret data. The role will be primarily responsible for managing intake process, perform A/B Test, Sales funnel analysis \& providing insight on data using Python.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a Lead Data Analyst to join our Gurgaon team. This role is for someone who is a strong data scientist first someone who can dig deep into data, build sound statistical/ML models, and translate ambiguous business problems into clear, actionable solutions. Exposure to Generative AI is a plus, but the core of this role is rigorous, hands\-on data science.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 Partner with senior stakeholders to understand problems, frame them as data science questions, and translate requirements into well\-scoped, actionable solutions
   

  

 Conduct extensive exploratory data analysis (EDA) to uncover patterns, validate assumptions, and identify the right modeling approach
   

  

 Build, validate, and maintain machine learning models end\-to\-end from problem framing to deployment and monitoring
   

  

 Continuously optimize existing models for accuracy, robustness, and business impact
   

  

 Write clean, efficient, production\-ready code in Python and SQL
   

  

 Work with large\-scale data using AWS SageMaker, Redshift/Snowflake, and S3
   

  

 Apply critical thinking to challenge assumptions, validate results, and ensure models solve the actual business problem, not just a technically interesting one
   

  

 Present findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders
   

  

 Must\-Have Skills
   

  

 5–7 years of hands\-on experience in data science / applied ML
   

  

 Strong critical thinking and problem\-solving ability, comfortable challenging requirements and getting to the real business question
   

  

 Deep data understanding and strong command over exploratory data analysis
   

  

 Proficiency in Python (pandas, numpy, scikit\-learn, etc.) and SQL
   

  

 Experience with AWS SageMaker for model building, training, and deployment
   

  

 Hands\-on experience with Redshift and/or Snowflake, and S3
   

  

 Proven track record of taking models from concept to production and maintaining them over time
   

  

 Strong ability to translate business problems into data science solutions and communicate results effectively
   

  

 Good to Have
   

  

 Exposure to Generative AI (LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, fine\-tuning, etc.)
   

  

 Note: This role is primarily a Data Science position. Strong core DS/ML fundamentals will be weighted more heavily than GenAI experience.
   

  

 What We're Looking For
   

  

 Someone who is genuinely curious about data, rigorous in their approach, and comfortable owning a problem from raw data to business impact, not just building models in isolation.
   

  

 In\-Office Collaboration
   

  

 We are a client\-centric, relationship\-based business. Working together, in\-person, is foundational to how we achieve results. By fostering a culture of face\-to\-face collaboration, idea sharing, productivity and personal connection, we deliver for our stakeholders — clients, advisors, employees and shareholders. Our employees work in the office at least three (3\) days per week, with flexibility to work from home two (2\) days per week. title: Senior Analyst - Field Analytics
description:
**Job Description**
**You Lead the Way. We’ve Got Your Back.**
 At American Express, we know that with the right backing, people and businesses have the power to progress in incredible ways. Whether we’re supporting our customers’ financial confidence to move ahead, taking commerce to new heights, or encouraging people to explore the world, our colleagues are constantly redefining what’s possible — and we’re proud to back each other every step of the way. When you join \#TeamAmex, you become part of a diverse community of over 60,000 colleagues, all with a common goal to deliver exceptional customer experience every day. We back our colleagues with the support they need to thrive, professionally and personally. That’s why we have Amex Flex, our enterprise working model that provides greater flexibility to colleagues while ensuring we preserve the important aspects of our unique in\-person culture. Depending on role and business needs, colleagues will either work onsite, in a hybrid model (combination of in\-office and virtual days) or fully virtually.
   

  

**Our Team**
 The Global Merchant \& Network Services (GMNS) organization is responsible for managing relationships with millions of Merchants and Partners around the world that facilitate American Express acceptance and enabling the day\-to\-day operations of our company’s payment network.
   

  

 The U.S. Merchant Marketing, Global Marketing Execution \& Analytics (UMGEA) team is responsible for leveraging marketing and analytics capabilities to drive sustainable growth through customer, partner, and product insights that inform the merchant value proposition, channel strategy, and investment optimization, while leveraging the full range of enterprise assets and partnerships for GMNS customers and ensuring we remain compliant as a network.
   

  

 The GMNS Analytics team within UMGEA is responsible for partnering with global markets to drive profitable growth, accelerating acceptance and amplifying the value of Amex acceptance to Merchants, bank partners and Card Members at scale. We offer powerful data and actionable insights to attract new businesses to engage with Amex, help existing businesses improve performance and capitalize on new opportunities.
   

  

**Description**
 The UMGEA – Global Analytics team is seeking an Analyst for the Field Analytics team. The Analyst will support the build and rollout of scalable merchant intelligence capabilities that help identify actionable opportunities, enable retention and growth initiatives, and inform Client Management and Marketing treatments across GMNS.
   

  

 This role will support work across merchant triggers, retention analytics, trigger arbitration, treatment playbooks, and predictive insights. The Analyst will help translate analytical opportunities into clear business actions, supporting the transition of insights and pilots into governed, production\-ready capabilities through platforms. The role requires strong analytical problem\-solving, attention to detail, execution discipline, and the ability to turn complex data into practical recommendations that can be activated by field, Client Management, and Marketing partners.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**RESPONSIBILITIES**
* Provide analytic and execution support for merchant retention, trigger arbitration, treatment playbooks, and predictive insights that enable GMNS growth initiatives and Client Management priorities.
* Analyze merchant performance, spend, engagement, coverage, and behavioral trends to identify early indicators of decline, retention risk, and growth opportunities and support field activation decisions.
* Support the development and scaling of merchant trigger capabilities, including deterministic and predictive triggers that help enable timely, insight\-led interventions.
* Help translate analytical pilots and proof\-of\-concepts into governed, production\-ready capabilities through enterprise platforms such as TargetIQ.
* Partner with cross\-functional stakeholders to understand business questions, define analytical requirements, and deliver timely, high\-quality insights.
* Translate complex data into clear, concise findings, treatment recommendations, and business actions that can be understood and acted upon by partners.
* Support automation and standardisation of recurring analytics processes to improve efficiency, reduce operational risk, and increase speed to market.


**Qualifications**
**QUALIFICATIONS**
* 2\-4 years of relevant experience in analytical domain.
* Intellectual curiosity, attention to detail ability to learn quickly and drive results.
* Ability to drive insights from data, manage multiple projects and drive results in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong collaboration skills with ability to build relationships and challenge the status quo.
* Excellent business writing and presentation skills with the ability to communicate effectively, build relationships and influence at all levels.
* Technical Skills: Familiarity with Google Big Query, SQL, Python, Lumi, PySpark and Tableau.
* Experience in dispute analytics, risk operations, or merchant business preferred.
* Experience in Machine Learning/ Cloud / Gen AI is a plus.


**Academic Background**
* Bachelors in Statistics/Mathematics/Economics/ Engineering/Data Science with relevant experience.
* Post Graduation in Statistics/Mathematics/ Economics/Engineering/Management is a plus.


**About Us**
 At American Express, our culture is built on a 175\-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world\-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.
   

  

 As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well\-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.
   

  

**About The Team**
 We back you with benefits that support your holistic well\-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:
   

  

* Competitive base salaries
* Bonus incentives
* Support for financial\-well\-being and retirement
* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
* Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
* Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
* Free access to global on\-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
* Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
* Career development and training opportunities

 Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

description:

Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world.  Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.
   

  

**AI at Cvent: Leading the Future**
 Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI\-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.
   

  

 Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI\-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.
   

  

*Disclaimer: Beware of Recruitment Scams \- Legitimate Cvent recruiting communications will always come from an official ‘name@cvent.com’ email. We never request any payments or ask for sensitive personal or financial information via chat or social media platforms. For more information, please visit: https://www.cvent.com/en/notice\-recruitment\-fraud*
**About The Role**
 As Analytics Manager at Cvent, you will own and drive the company's analytics and pricing intelligence agenda. You will manage a portfolio of analytics projects end\-to\-end spanning product usage, revenue, customer behavior, and pricing strategy while also serving as the primary analytical owner for Pricing. You will define and lead the team's AI strategy, partner closely with Product, Sales, Finance, and Marketing leadership, and build the tools, models, and processes that enable data\-driven and AI\-powered decision\-making at scale.
   

  

**Analytics Leadership**
* Own and manage the full analytics project portfolio \- scoping, prioritization, execution, and stakeholder communication across all active workstreams.
* Define and maintain analytics roadmaps aligned to business OKRs; present progress and outcomes to senior leadership on a regular cadence.
* Conduct comprehensive lifecycle analysis including data gathering, cleansing, advanced statistical modeling, and strategic recommendations.
* Build and maintain self\-serve dashboards and reports in Sigma/Tableau to enable business teams to access insights independently.
* Partner with Engineering and Data Platform teams to improve data quality, pipeline reliability, and overall analytics infrastructure.
* Champion a data\-driven culture by establishing best practices, documentation standards, and data literacy programs.


**Pricing Analytics**
* Lead key pricing analytics projects pivotal to company success \- including price optimization, discount governance, deal win/loss analysis, and competitive benchmarking.
* Develop advanced pricing tools and statistical models (e.g., price elasticity, willingness\-to\-pay, cohort value models) using R/Python.
* Power Quarterly Pricing Reviews by delivering structured updates, insights, and recommendations to Finance and GTM leadership.
* Provide deal\-support analytics to Sales teams, including custom pricing simulations, ROI models, and competitive positioning.
* Analyze market trends, competitive landscape, and customer data to inform and refine pricing strategies and discount policies.
* Interpret complex, multi\-dimensional data sets and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations for non\-technical stakeholders.


**AI \& Innovation**
* Define and lead the team's AI strategy, identifying high\-impact use cases for analytics, automation, and decision support across pricing, revenue, and customer intelligence.
* Serve as the team's subject\-matter expert on AI\-enabled analytics, upskilling colleagues and championing responsible, explainable use of AI in business contexts.
* Frame ambiguous business problems, scope the analysis, and deliver clear, decision\-ready recommendations powered by AI and ML techniques.
* Evaluate and deploy AI/ML models (e.g., forecasting, churn prediction, price optimization, NLP\-based feedback analysis) in collaboration with Data Science and Engineering teams.
* Stay current on emerging AI tools, LLM applications, and analytics automation technologies; assess applicability to Cvent's business context and advocate for adoption where appropriate.
* Establish guardrails and governance practices for AI\-generated insights to ensure accuracy, fairness, and business trustworthiness.


**Cross\-functional \& People Management**
* Work with senior leadership to prioritize analytics and pricing business needs, translating ambiguous questions into well\-defined analytical frameworks.
* Manage, mentor, and develop a team of analysts \- providing guidance on methodology, technical skills, career growth, and AI literacy.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Product, Sales, Finance, and Marketing to align on metrics definitions, reporting standards, and joint analyses.
* Communicate complex findings and strategic recommendations clearly through presentations and written reports for executive audiences.


 This is a senior techno\-functional role requiring deep technical expertise alongside strong business acumen, AI fluency, and leadership capabilities.
   

  

**Analytics \& Technical**
* Proven ability to manage multiple complex analytics projects simultaneously, with strong prioritization and stakeholder management skills.
* Expert\-level proficiency in SQL and BI tools \- Sigma and/or Tableau required.
* Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills; ability to build compelling executive\-ready presentations.
* Strong working knowledge of statistics and R/Python, ideally applied to pricing models, segmentation, or forecasting.
* Experience with Salesforce CRM data and AWS cloud environment (Redshift, S3, or equivalent).
* Ability to decipher large, complex, multi\-dimensional data sets and present findings in a coherent, business\-friendly structure.
* Experience developing pricing/value models using advanced statistical techniques is strongly preferred.


**AI \& Machine Learning**
* Hands\-on experience with AI/ML frameworks and tools (e.g., scikit\-learn, XGBoost, or similar) and the ability to apply them to real\-world business problems.
* Familiarity with LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) and experience integrating AI\-generated insights into analytics workflows or dashboards.
* Understanding of responsible AI principles \- bias detection, model interpretability, data governance \- and ability to implement guardrails in production settings.
* Ability to frame ambiguous, open\-ended business problems into structured analytical scopes and deliver decision\-ready outputs using AI\-driven approaches.
* Experience designing or overseeing AI/automation use cases that improved team productivity or analytical throughput.
* Familiarity with cloud AI/ML services (AWS SageMaker, Google Vertex AI, or similar) is a plus.


**Leadership \& Communication**
* Capability to clearly understand and articulate complex business problems and multi\-task across multiple high\-visibility projects.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills; comfortable presenting to C\-level executives.
* Demonstrated ability to upskill teams on new tools and methodologies including AI and analytics best practices.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.


**Qualifications\-**
* 10\-14 years of relevant working experience in analytics, pricing, revenue management, or technical consulting; SaaS/Tech industry preferred.
* 2\+ years of people management or team lead experience.
* BTech or graduation in Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Information Management, Statistics, or a related quantitative field.
* Demonstrated hands\-on experience with SQL, Sigma/Tableau, and Advanced Excel.
* Proven track record of delivering analytics projects that drove measurable business impact.
* Demonstrated experience applying AI/ML techniques to real\-world business problems; pricing, revenue, or customer analytics use cases preferred.

title: Lead: Unit Economics & NPV Strategy
description:
About The Company
 



 FairMoney is a pioneering mobile banking institution specializing in extending credit to emerging markets. Established in 2017, the company currently operates primarily within Nigeria, and it has secured nearly €50 million in funding from renowned global investors, including Tiger Global, DST, and Flourish Ventures.
 



 In alignment with its vision, FairMoney is actively constructing the foremost mobile banking platform and point\-of\-sale (POS) solution tailored for emerging markets. The journey began with the introduction of a digital microcredit application exclusively available on Android and iOS devices.
 



 Today, FairMoney has significantly expanded its range of services, encompassing a comprehensive suite of financial products, such as current accounts, savings accounts, debit cards, and state\-of\-the\-art POS solutions designed to meet the needs of both merchants and agents. FairMoney thrives on its diverse workforce, bringing together talent from over 27 nationalities.
 



 We operate at massive scale, move fast, and expect leaders to think in systems, not silos. Decisions are data\-driven, accountability is explicit, and impact matters.
 



 This role sits at the heart of how FairMoney decides
 **who to lend to, how much to lend, at what price, and why** 
 .
 



 About The Role
 



 We are hiring a
 **Lead: Unit Economics \& NPV Strategy** 
 to own, improve, and operationalise FairMoney's existing NPV and unit economics frameworks and ensure they become a core operating system for decision\-making, not just analytical artefacts.
 



 While FairMoney already has NPV models in place, they are not yet consistently embedded into credit decisions, pricing, experimentation, and growth trade\-offs. This role exists to close that gap.
 



 The successful candidate will be the single source of truth on
 **value creation vs value destruction** 
 , expected vs actual performance, and the economic impact of risk, pricing, and growth decisions.
 



 This is a senior, high\-ownership role for someone who pushes the bar, challenges assumptions, and thrives in a high\-growth, high\-pressure environment.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* **Own NPV \& Unit Economics:** 
 Own, audit, and improve NPV and unit economics models across lending products, ensuring consistent assumptions and decision\-ready outputs for pricing, credit cut\-offs, and capital allocation
* **Measure Expected vs Actual Performance:** 
 Build frameworks to measure performance across products, cohorts, credit policies, pricing strategies, and experiments, identifying key drivers of variance and feeding insights back into risk and pricing decisions
* **Drive Experimentation \& Value Attribution:** 
 Partner with Risk, Data Science, Product, and Growth to define NPV hypotheses, measure incremental economic value, and identify which initiatives should be scaled, improved, or stopped
* **Influence Business Decisions:** 
 Translate complex economic analysis into clear trade\-offs and provide credible insights to senior leadership, challenging models, policies, and decisions when the economics do not support them
* **Embed NPV in Decision\-Making:** 
 Integrate NPV thinking into credit policy reviews, risk governance, pricing and limit discussions, and planning cycles, while setting standards for transparency, documentation, and assumption discipline
* **Raise the Analytical Bar:** 
 Operate with high ownership and integrity, challenge analytical and execution standards, stay adaptable under pressure, and contribute to FairMoney's mission of providing responsible access to credit


**Requirements**

 Must\-Haves
 


* Strong experience in unit economics, NPV, LTV, or portfolio profitability (lending, fintech, banking, or adjacent sectors)
* Deep understanding of credit economics and how risk, pricing, tenure, and behaviour interact
* Proven track record of measuring expected vs actual outcomes
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders using data and logic
* High ownership mindset with bias toward action



 Nice\-To\-Have
 


* Experience in high\-growth fintech or scale\-up environments
* Exposure to experimentation frameworks (A/B testing, policy tests, pricing tests)
* Strong SQL / Python / analytics tooling capability
* Experience working closely with Risk, Data Science, and Growth teams



 What Success Looks Like
 


**By Month 3**
* Existing NPV models are audited, rationalised, and standardised
* A portfolio\-level NPV view exists across all major products
* Leadership has clear visibility into where value is created or destroyed
* Experiments are routinely evaluated on NPV uplift versus control


**By Month 6**
* NPV actively drives decisions on:


* Credit cut\-offs
* Pricing bands
* Growth investment trade\-offs
* Gaps between expected and actual performance are measured, explained, and shrinking
* Risk, Data Science, and Growth teams operate using a shared economic language
* Leadership trusts NPV outputs enough to make difficult, high\-impact decisions



 Final Note
 



 This is not a passive analytics role.
 



 We are looking for someone who is comfortable challenging assumptions, pushing for clarity, and holding the line on economic truth — even when it is inconvenient.
 



 If you are motivated by scale, complexity, ownership, and impact, this role will stretch you and reward you.
   

  




**Benefits**
* Paid Time Off
* Training \& Development
* Flexible work structure



**Recruitment Process:** 



* A screening call with a member of the recruitment team
* Technical interview with the hiring manager
* Case study round
* Panel session based on the case study

**Role:**

**Function:** 
 Data Engineering / AI/ML Platform
 



**Location:**

**Type:**

**Industry:** 
 Media Production, Broadcast Media, Online Media
 



  





**About Company** 




 The company is one of India's largest private FM radio networks. It reaches over 40 million listeners weekly across 49 cities, 1,000\+ towns, and 50,000 villages.
 



 It is the only private FM station broadcasting from Jammu \& Kashmir, with an international presence in Singapore and Bhutan. Its digital platform extends the brand into curated lifestyle, music, and news content.
 



 The company operates at the intersection of legacy broadcast media and digital innovation, with a team of 740\.
 



  





**Position Overview** 




 The company is building a next\-generation media super\-app that unifies video, audio, radio, micro\-drama, news, and commerce on a single digital platform. This role owns the scalable data and ML infrastructure powering content discovery, personalised recommendations, and user engagement at scale. The engineer in this role bridges production data systems and AI/ML teams, moving models from experimentation into reliable, high\-throughput production environments.
 



  





**Role \& Responsibilities** 



* Design and build scalable data architecture for a high\-volume consumer media platform, covering ingestion, transformation, storage, and serving layers for user activity, content consumption, and commerce data.
* Build and maintain batch and real\-time streaming pipelines processing millions of user events and large volumes of multimedia metadata using technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Flink, or Airflow.
* Architect data lakes, warehouses, and analytical datasets supporting product analytics, reporting, and AI/ML use cases; enforce data quality, lineage, observability, and governance across all pipelines.
* Develop feature engineering pipelines and reusable feature stores for recommendation, personalisation, ranking, search, and content intelligence systems.
* Build training and inference pipelines connecting production data with ML models; enable continuous feedback loops for model retraining from live user interactions.
* Deploy ML/AI models into production on AWS, GCP, or Azure; containerise and orchestrate model workloads using Docker and Kubernetes; build APIs/services for consumer\-facing AI integration.
* Monitor model and pipeline performance — latency, scalability, reliability — and partner with AI/ML teams to operationalise models from experimentation to production.



  





**Must Have Criteria** 



* 7–9 years of hands\-on software or data engineering experience, with a track record of building and operating large\-scale data platforms.
* Strong proficiency in Python, Java, or Scala for data and ML pipeline development.
* Production experience with distributed data processing and streaming technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Flink, or Airflow.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud\-based data infrastructure on AWS, GCP, or Azure, including data lakes, warehouses, and distributed storage.
* Demonstrated experience deploying ML/AI models into production environments, including batch and real\-time inference pipelines.
* Proficiency with Docker and Kubernetes for containerising and orchestrating model and pipeline workloads.
* Strong understanding of data architecture, distributed systems, and data modelling for both analytical and ML use cases.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Experience building data infrastructure for recommendation, personalisation, search, or content ranking systems.
* Exposure to feature stores, MLOps platforms, and ML training/inference workload management.
* Prior experience on high\-scale B2C or consumer internet platforms handling behavioural and event\-streaming data.
* Background in media, OTT, video, audio, music, social media, gaming, or news platforms.
* Exposure to Generative AI, embeddings, vector databases, or LLM\-based applications.



  





**What We Offer** 



* End\-to\-end ownership of data and AI platform infrastructure for a consumer product reaching tens of millions of users.
* Opportunity to work at the convergence of broadcast media and digital innovation on a greenfield super\-app build.
* Collaborative environment with AI/ML, product, and engineering teams working on high\-impact personalisation and content intelligence problems.

title: Manager/Sr Manager - Field Analytics
description:
**Job Description**
**You Lead the Way. We’ve Got Your Back.**
 At American Express, we know that with the right backing, people and businesses have the power to progress in incredible ways. Whether we’re supporting our customers’ financial confidence to move ahead, taking commerce to new heights, or encouraging people to explore the world, our colleagues are constantly redefining what’s possible — and we’re proud to back each other every step of the way. When you join \#TeamAmex, you become part of a diverse community of over 60,000 colleagues, all with a common goal to deliver exceptional customer experience every day. We back our colleagues with the support they need to thrive, professionally and personally. That’s why we have Amex Flex, our enterprise working model that provides greater flexibility to colleagues while ensuring we preserve the important aspects of our unique in\-person culture. Depending on role and business needs, colleagues will either work onsite, in a hybrid model (combination of in\-office and virtual days) or fully virtually.
   

  

**Our Team**
 The Global Merchant \& Network Services (GMNS) organization is responsible for managing relationships with millions of Merchants and Partners around the world that facilitate American Express acceptance and enabling the day\-to\-day operations of our company’s payment network.
   

  

 The U.S. Merchant Marketing, Global Marketing Execution \& Analytics (UMGEA) team is responsible for leveraging marketing and analytics capabilities to drive sustainable growth through customer, partner, and product insights that inform the merchant value proposition, channel strategy, and investment optimization, while leveraging the full range of enterprise assets and partnerships for GMNS customers and ensuring we remain compliant as a network.
   

  

 The GMNS Analytics team within UMGEA is responsible for partnering with global markets to drive profitable growth, accelerating acceptance and amplifying the value of Amex acceptance to Merchants, bank partners and Card Members at scale. We offer powerful data and actionable insights to attract new businesses to engage with Amex, help existing businesses improve performance and capitalize on new opportunities.
   

  

**Description**
 The UMGEA – Global Analytics team is seeking a Manager / Senior Manager, Field Analytics to help lead merchant trigger intelligence and scaled field analytics capabilities. This role will support the continued development and scaling of our flagship analytics\-led merchant trigger program that enables field teams to identify out\-of\-pattern merchant activity, surface actionable leads, and make timely interventions to retain charge volume and improve merchant experience.
   

  

 The individual will partner closely with Field, Marketing, Product, Technology, Compliance, and business stakeholders to translate merchant needs and business opportunities into scalable analytics solutions. The role will be responsible for advancing deterministic and predictive trigger capabilities, strengthening prioritization and arbitration logic, integrating trigger workflows into enterprise platforms, and building measurement frameworks that quantify business impact, including charge volume retained and merchant issues resolved. The role requires strong analytical judgment, stakeholder management, and the ability to move complex pilots into compliant, production\-ready capabilities.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**RESPONSIBILITIES**
* Lead the development, delivery, and scaling of analytics\-driven merchant trigger capabilities to support proactive merchant retention, growth, and experience improvement.
* Translate merchant behavior, transaction patterns, and field feedback into actionable trigger logic, prioritization frameworks, and treatment playbooks that enable targeted merchant treatments.
* Partner with Field, Marketing, Product, Technology, Compliance, and business stakeholders to integrate trigger workflows into scalable platforms.
* Support the transition of analytical pilots into compliant, production\-ready capabilities, ensuring alignment with enterprise governance and risk standards.
* Leverage emerging technologies, including GenAI, to improve intelligence and support field enablement.
* Lead and inspire a high\-performing analytics team, fostering strong ownership, collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.


**Qualifications**
**QUALIFICATIONS**
* 4\+ years of experience in data or analytics functions with a strong business acumen.
* Intellectual curiosity, agility, and quick learning skills to bring structure to shifting priorities, managing multiple demands, and ambiguity.
* The ability to drive insights from data, manage multiple projects, and drive results in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong leadership and collaboration skills, able to challenge the status quo and inspire a team.
* Excellent business writing and presentation skills with the ability to communicate effectively, build relationships, and influence at all levels.
* Technical Skills: Familiarity with Google Bigquery, SQL, R, Python, Lumi, PySpark and Tableau.
* Experience in the merchant business preferred.
* Experience in Machine Learning/ Cloud / Gen AI is a plus.


**Academic Background**
* Bachelors in Statistics/Mathematics/Economics/ Engineering/Data Science with relevant experience.
* Post Graduation in Statistics/Mathematics/ Economics/Engineering/Management is a plus.


**About Us**
 At American Express, our culture is built on a 175\-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world\-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.
   

  

 As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well\-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.
   

  

**About The Team**
 We back you with benefits that support your holistic well\-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:

 American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.
   

  

 Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
**About Atlys**
 Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.
   

  

 Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.
   

  

 Atlys is changing that.
   

  

 We’re building an AI\-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for
 **1M\+ travellers across 127 countries** 
 . But we’re still early.
   

  

**The Role**
 We’re looking for a
 **Senior Data Analyst** 
 to own critical business data end to end and help teams make better decisions with it.
   

  

 You’ll build the metrics, dashboards and analyses that become the single source of truth across the business, while partnering closely with teams to solve high\-impact problems and uncover growth opportunities.
   

  

 This role is for someone who can independently navigate messy data, define the right questions, and turn analysis into clear decisions and action.
   

  

**The Job**
* Own business data as a reliable source of truth by ensuring key metrics, reports and dashboards are accurate, consistent and trusted across teams.
* Build and evolve decision\-making systems across business, marketing, finance and other core functions through dashboards, reporting and analytical frameworks.
* Turn complex datasets into actionable insights by writing advanced SQL, analysing large datasets, and identifying trends, anomalies and opportunities.
* Define the metrics that matter by partnering with teams to establish KPIs, improve measurement and create clarity around performance.
* Lead data\-driven problem solving by independently structuring ambiguous business questions, diagnosing root causes and recommending actions that improve outcomes.


**The Ideal Candidate**
**You’ll Likely Thrive In This Role If You**
* Have 3\-6 years of experience in data analytics, business analytics or a similar role, ideally in a fast\-moving consumer or technology business.
* Are exceptionally strong in SQL and comfortable independently working with large, complex and imperfect datasets.
* Have strong experience with visualisation tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker Studio or Metabase, and can build dashboards that drive decisions rather than just report numbers.
* Bring strong analytical and business judgment, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems and translate analysis into clear recommendations for stakeholders.
* Have exposure to Python or a strong understanding of how data flows through products and technology systems.


**What You Can Expect**
 Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.
   

  

**Here’s What You Can Expect**
* Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
* Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check\-up on us.
* A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* Learning \& development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* Great tools to do your best work, including high\-spec equipment and software.
* An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.


 Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.
   

  

*Come build the intelligence layer for global travel*

**Troovy (HonestInnovations ForYou Private Limited)**

 Full\-time, work from office

 Founder's Office

 2–4 years preferred

 INR 8 LPA \- INR 10 LPA
 



  





**About The Role** 




 This role sits at the intersection of
 **sales, data, technology, finance, operations, logistics and market execution** 
 . You will operate Troovy’s internal GT Control Tower alongside various tools. Your job is to ensure that data is reliable, processes are followed, insights become actions and actions are taken to closure.
 



  





 This is not a passive MIS or reporting position. It is an analytical, hands\-on execution role for someone who enjoys bringing structure to fast\-moving operations.
 



  





**What You Will Own** 



* **GT systems and data:** 
 Maintain clean, connected data across Troovy’s GT Control Tower, FieldAssist SFA and DMS, including employees, distributors, territories, outlets, products, orders, invoices, collections and master mappings.
* **Business analysis:** 
 Analyse primary sales, secondary sales, collections, outlet productivity, repeat behaviour, salesforce performance, distributor performance, SKU movement and market development using Excel and dashboards.
* **Insight\-to\-action execution:** 
 Convert findings into owner\-wise action plans. This could include dormant or low\-selling stores, missed visits, suspicious orders, missing asset deployment, poor repeat rates or underperforming territories.
* **Order\-to\-cash coordination:** 
 Track primary orders from PI to invoice, dispatch and delivery. Coordinate with operations, logistics and finance on delayed orders, collections, outstanding, ageing, credit notes, debit notes, ledgers and distributor issues.
* **Field\-force governance:** 
 Monitor attendance, beat adherence, outlet coverage, productive calls, order quality, sales, repeat orders and task completion across ASM, ASE/SO and PSR/DBSM teams.
* **Market development:** 
 Track assets, promoters, sampling, branding and outlet\-level interventions. Ensure each activity is assigned, executed, verified and supported by proper field evidence.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 



* Troovy has one trusted and reconciled view of GT performance.
* Missing, delayed, duplicate or suspicious data is detected before reviews.
* Every operational exception has an owner, deadline, status and evidence of closure.
* Orders and processes do not remain stuck because teams were not followed up with.
* Sales managers receive specific action lists, not just spreadsheets.
* All tools \& processes are consistently followed by the field and distributor teams.
* Weekly analysis clearly explains what changed, why it changed and what must happen next.



  





**Who We Are Looking For** 



* 2–4 years of experience in FMCG sales operations, commercial excellence, GT operations, distribution, MIS, business analytics or a similar role.
* Strong hands\-on Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, lookups, data cleaning, Power Query and business dashboards.
* Ability to identify patterns, inconsistencies and manipulation in large operational datasets.
* Strong follow\-through and the confidence to coordinate with a large field force and multiple internal teams.
* Understanding of primary sales, secondary sales, distributors, outlets, collections and FMCG order\-to\-cash processes.
* Comfortable combining desk\-based analysis with occasional market and distributor visits.
* Clear written and verbal communication with disciplined task documentation.



  





**Good To Have** 



* Experience with FieldAssist or another SFA/DMS platform.
* Knowledge of SQL, Power BI, Tableau, Python or other analytical tools.
* Experience auditing salesforce productivity, outlet coverage or retail execution.
* Experience working directly with founders or senior business leaders.

title: Evidence Lead, AI Access Initiative (EAII Advisors)
description:
**About The AI Access Initiative (2AI)**
 We're at an inflection point in artificial intelligence \- presenting both tremendous potential opportunity and risk for people in developing countries. AI capabilities are improving on a timescale measured in months, while development systems often move on timescales measured in decades. Much of the technology needed for positive impact exists today, but few organizations exist to bridge research, deployment, and scaled implementation: we must act now to ensure AI's benefits reach people in poverty in LMICs.
   

  

 Incubated at Evidence Action, we're scaling The AI Access Initiative, an organization focused on scaling AI\-enabled 'big bets' to benefit tens or hundreds of millions of people in poverty in low\- and middle\-income countries (LMICs). We operate at the intersection of global development actors, top AI labs, and leading researchers to drive meaningful access to AI's benefits for the 3\.5 billion people living in poverty globally. We create "public good," open\-sourced playbooks, toolkits, and insights that define how to design and launch tractable and impactful AI\-enabled programs. Given the scale of opportunity, we expect our portfolio to expand substantially, but to start, we're scaling two programs focused on AI in Agriculture and AI in Health.
   

  

* Agriculture: We have an ambitious goal to reach 100M\+ farmers with AI\-enabled weather forecasts, expand forecast R\&D to generate novel forecasts, and build public and private sector (WhatsApp, telcos) delivery channels to deliver new, LLM\-generated voice and image content that maximizes behavior change.
* Health: Here, our initial goal is to scale AI\-enabled clinical decision support to 20M\+ people via telemedicine platforms, dramatically improving diagnosis and health outcomes at a national level. We are also planning to explore and test novel interventions for low\-resource settings, including direct\-to\-consumer (DTC) health interventions.


 We are led by former Evidence Action CEO Kanika Bahl, a founding member of Anthropic's Long\-Term Benefit Trust, and advised by Nobel Laureate Michael Kremer; Dario Amodei, CEO of Anthropic; and Kent Walker, President, Global Affairs for Alphabet and Google. This work builds on Evidence Action's track record reaching 530M\+ people with cost\-effective, evidence\-based programs across 9 countries in Africa and Asia, with a focus on last\-mile delivery.
   

  

**About 2AI India And EAII Advisors**
 EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India, supports state governments in delivering evidence\-based public health programs. Operating across 10 states, EAII Advisors provides technical assistance to ministries of health, education, water, and women and child development, reducing health burdens in impoverished communities and improving the long\-term wellbeing of children and families.
   

  

 2AI India is being incubated as a project within EAII Advisors, with plans to spin off into an independent entity at the end of this year. We are hiring a founding team: the first hires will shape the culture, establish the operating model, and own early wins before the organization scales.
   

  

**Roles And Responsibilities**
 The Evidence Lead is 2AI India's primary engine for measuring whether our programs work and why. This is not a traditional monitoring and evaluation (M\&E) role. The focus is generating insights that change program design in real time. Data collection for government reporting is a real but secondary function, roughly 20% of the role. The Evidence Lead is also expected to be actively applying AI and machine learning (ML) tools to evaluation.
   

  

*Evidence Generation and Program Measurement*
* Measures the effectiveness of new programs and ideas, from early concept tests through scaled delivery, and defines what "working" means for each before it launches
* Identifies the right data sources for evaluation, including administrative data, program data, partner data, and primary collection, and making the tradeoffs between rigor, cost, and speed explicit
* Designs and runs cost\-effectiveness models, making the assumptions behind each result legible to the people making the call
* Builds the measurement and feedback loops into program design from the start rather than retrofitting them after launch
* Owns the data collection and reporting obligations that come with government partnerships, roughly 20% of the role,


*Thought Partnership to Programs*
* Serves as a thought partner to the programs team on program design, ensuring programs are built to be measurable and monitoring and evaluation efforts measure what really matters.
* Translates findings into recommendations that program leads can act on, and is explicit about the confidence behind each one


*AI and ML Applied to Evaluation*
* Applies AI and ML tools directly to evaluation and data analysis work, and keeps that practice current as the tools change
* Builds the data and modeling infrastructure that lets a small team run rapid and purpose\-built analysis


*External Representation*
* Presents 2AI's evidence and data externally, with findings tailored to the needs of specific audiences: funders, partners, government counterparts, and the research community


*Team building and enablement*
* Fosters a strong, values\-aligned culture as a leader across the organization
* Willingness to roll\-up sleeves and pitch in to the organization building activities required of a founding team
* Overtime, hires and enables a team of strong monitoring, learning, and evaluation professionals committed to objectively assessing our programs and fostering their improvement


 Disclaimer: The duties and responsibilities described are not a comprehensive list and additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time.
   

  

**Requirements**
**Essentials:**
* Relevant professional background: 7\-9 years of experience in M\&E, impact evaluation, or applied research in global health or international development
* Rigorous evidence environment: has worked in an organization where methodological standards were high and contested, such as academic research, a think tank, or an equivalent research lab
* Applied AI and ML fluency: is already using AI and ML tools in evaluation and data analysis work today
* Cost\-effectiveness modelling: experience building and updating cost\-effectiveness analyses, and can explain the assumptions driving a result to a non\-technical decision\-maker
* Analytical structuring: structures ambiguous problems, thinks analytically, and solves quantitative problems without waiting for a fully specified brief
* Program collaboration instincts: experience working in close proximity to programs; can understand how program needs and constraints differ from research needs, and adjusts the evidence agenda accordingly
* Clear communication: shows clarity of thought, writes compellingly, and translates technical information into common language for varied audiences
* External credibility: can present to funders, government counterparts, and technical peers and hold up under questioning
* Experience navigating Indian government data systems and state\-level reporting requirements
* Comfort with ambiguity: a track record of doing well in early\-stage, resource\-constrained environments where the path is not defined and you build it as you go
* Initiative and bias to action: takes ownership of unassigned problems and moves without being asked


**What Success Looks Like**
 In the First 6 Months:
   

  

* You have a working measurement approach with key indicators for the agriculture program, agreed with the Program Director, that specifies what evidence would change the program's direction
* You have built or adapted a cost\-effectiveness model for at least one priority intervention, and leadership understands and trusts its assumptions
* You have mapped the available data landscape in India, including what government and partner systems can and cannot tell us


**Compensation :** 
 Competitive and commensurate with the individual's credentials, experience, and previous pay scale.
   

  

**Benefits**
 EAII provides a comprehensive benefits package for employees. Benefits include:
   

  

* Comprehensive health insurance with IPD and OPD provisions
* Life and Accidental insurance
* PF, ESIC and Gratuity as per statutory requirements
* Generous leave
* Mental and physical wellbeing benefits
* Learning \& Development benefits
* Avenues for engagement and recognition

Our economists work alongside policy researchers, evaluators and subject matter experts to provide robust economic analysis that informs policy development, appraisal, evaluation and investment decisions.
   

  

 Our economics team delivers economic evaluation, value for money (VfM) analysis, cost\-benefit analysis, impact assessment, economic appraisal, business case development and bespoke economic analysis. We work on issues at the top of today’s policy agenda, including economic growth, energy, telecoms, security, the impact of new technologies, and better regulation.

 The Analyst (Economist) role will focus on providing high\-quality economic analysis across policy research and evaluation projects. The role will contribute to growing our portfolio of economic and value for money evaluations and other bespoke economic analysis.

 From day one, you will have the opportunity to contribute to a diverse range of economic analyses for UK public sector clients. You will be a core member of our growing and collegiate team and work in an international environment in which more than 30 nationalities are represented. * Undertake economic analysis supporting policy research and evaluation.

* Analyse quantitative datasets and evidence.

* Work within multidisciplinary teams.

 You will thrive in a fast\-paced environment. You will have a wide range of interests and be able to develop a nuanced understanding of complex economic issues.  Your experience could have been gained in consulting, government, a regulatory agency, academia, or the private sector.

* Economic evaluation, value for money analysis, appraisal or cost\-benefit analysis.

 **LIBIL** 
 , our litigation intelligence and legal due diligence platform.
 



 LIBIL helps businesses identify and assess litigation, criminal, regulatory, insolvency, and other legal risks associated with individuals and entities.
 



 We are now building a repeatable enterprise GTM engine for LIBIL and are looking for someone to help us build it from the ground up.

 We are looking for a
 **GTM Engineer**

 **Sales, Growth, Data, Automation, and Product** 
 . You will help us identify the right accounts, buyers, use cases, triggers, and messaging, and then turn those insights into
 **repeatable, automated GTM systems**
