title: Assistant Project Coordinator- (Research)/Senior Researcher - Delhi
description:
Assistant Project Coordinator \- (Research) / Senior Researcher
 



 Indian Police Foundation \| Internal Police Reforms Project
 



  





 Organisation: Indian Police Foundation
 



 Project: Internal Police Reforms Project
 



 Location: Indian Police Foundation HQ, New Delhi (C\-8, 8758, Vasant Kunj, New Delhi \- 110070\)
 



 Number of Positions: 1
 



 Tenure: Contractual. Offered initially for 1 year but extendable till the completion of the project (2027\-2028\).
 



 Remuneration: Rs. 75,000 per month (Assistant Project Coordinator \- Research) / Rs. 60,000 per month (Senior Researcher), including Rs. 5,000 as transport allowance.
 



 Last date to apply: 5 October 2026, till 4:00 PM only.
 



  





 OVERVIEW
 



  





 Applications are invited for the position of Assistant Project Coordinator \- (Research)/Senior Researcher on a contractual basis.
 



  





 Candidates possessing a minimum of 3 years or more of relevant experience will be considered for the position of Assistant Project Coordinator (Research). However, candidates shortlisted with less than 3 years of relevant experience will be considered for the position of Senior Researcher.
 



  





 Although the position is in Delhi, the APC\- Research/Senior Researcher is expected to travel to various (3 states) both for research as well as project implementation and monitoring.
 



  





 ABOUT THE ROLE
 



  





 The role of the Assistant Project Coordinator \- (Research)/Senior Researcher involves coordinating both the research and operational components of the Internal Police Reforms Project. Working closely with the Project Director (PD), Project Coordinator (PC), and State Supervisors, the he/she will play a key role in project planning, research, implementation, coordination, monitoring, and documentation across three states (Punjab, Telangana \& Tamil Nadu).
 



  





 ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATIONS
 



  





 \- Educational Qualification: M.A in Social Sciences/Police Sciences/Criminology/Public Safety or any other related field. However, candidates with Ph.D. in relevant domains will be preferred.
 



 \- Researcher/Consultant with experience of 3 years or more in social research in universities, other research institutes, NGOs, think tanks, or consulting firms. (Minimum experience may be relaxed in exceptional cases at the discretion of the Project Director).
 



 \- Experience in Independent Research Study Design and leading/mentoring research team.
 



 \- Proficiency \& experience in developing and conducting Baseline, Midline and Endline evaluation study.
 



 \- Proficiency in Research Tool Development for empirical data collection.
 



 \- Proficiency in mixed\-data \- quantitative and qualitative \- analysis \& and knowledge of quantitative data analysis software (advance excel, SPSS/STATA).
 



 \- Ability to understand and communicate the meaning of field\-based data and writing research report.
 



 \- Strong management, coordination and leadership skills for engagement with senior police officers, trainers, research staff and other research institutions.
 



 \- High level of proficiency in computer skills.
 



 \- Willingness and good health to undertake field visits (as and when required).
 



 \- Good command over English and Hindi.
 



 \- Attend the IPF office at Vasant Kunj, Delhi, on a regular basis.
 



  





 DESIRABLE
 



  





 \- Previous experience of working with Police organisations.
 



 \- Familiarity with criminal laws (major \& minor).
 



 \- Familiarity with relevant Supreme Court judgments \& NHRC directives.
 



 \- Familiarity with MHA and State Government circulars related to citizen centric policing.
 



 \- Familiarity with recommendations of various police commissions, including the National Police Commission (1979\-81\), related to citizen centric policing.
 



 \- Publications of Research papers/articles in various journals/magazines/Newspapers.
 



  





 ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
 



  





 1\. Research and Data Analysis
 



  





 \- Head the research team, provide guidance to Research Associates both in Headquarters \& States, and monitor their work.
 



 \- Guide Research Associates in data analysis for various stakeholders for both quantitative and qualitative data collected through three tools (structured questionnaires, FGDs, and in\-depth interviews).
 



 \- Coordinate with and visit the external agencies engaged for data analysis \& report writing (Centre for Economic \& Social Studies, Hyderabad \& Centre for Good Governance, Hyderabad).
 



 \- Guide and Supervise Research Associates in desk research, including analysis of reports of the National Police Commission and other committees on police reforms.
 



 \- Formulation of Reports to State DGP on Public Grievances in 3 states based on data analysis.
 



  





 2\. Formulation of Change Manual
 



  





 \- Assist in the Formulation of Change Manual \& its action plan for all the 3 states based on the Project Focus areas, namely improving Compliant / FIR Registration and Police Response, improving Citizen Services and Community Engagement, prevention of Harassment by Police, and improving Police Conduct and Behaviour.
 



 \- Presentation of Change Manual to the respective state DGPs in 3 States.
 



  





 3\. Baseline and Endline Evaluation
 



  





 \- Work on evaluation parameters, selection of police stations for evaluation, training of field enumerators, and ensure that the data required by the agency for conducting baseline and endline evaluations is provided in a timely manner.
 



 \- Guide in the formulation of Data Collection Tools by evaluation agencies.
 



 \- Support and monitor the execution of Baseline and Endline evaluations by independent agency in selected police stations across Punjab, Telangana, and Tamil Nadu.
 



 \- Review and scrutinize the reports prepared by the evaluation agencies.
 



  





 4\. Engagement with Experts
 



  





 Assist the Project Director and Project Coordinator in engaging with Experts for vetting and finalization of the following activities:
 



  





 \- Finalization of Research Methodology
 



 \- Evaluation Parameters for (Baseline and Endline Evaluation)
 



 \- Change Manual prepared for all 3 states
 



 \- Baseline \& Endline Reports prepared by Evaluation agencies
 



 \- Final Project report (combined report for all 3 States)
 



  





 5\. Training
 



  





 \- Assist in the preparation of state\-specific training manual \& training materials.
 



 \- Support and participate in the conduct of training programmes for police office in all 3 states.
 



  





 6\. Project Implementation and Monitoring
 



  





 \- Support monitoring of project implementation across 90 police stations in three states, including field visits to selected police stations on quarterly basis.
 



  





 7\. Coordination
 



  





 Ensuring smooth communication, information exchange and prompt follow up with:
 



  





 \- All state project monitoring units (State Supervisor \& Research Associates in 3 states)
 



 \- External agencies engaged in data analysis (CESS, Hyderabad \& CGG, Hyderabad)
 



 \- Evaluation Agencies for Baseline \& Endline Evaluation in 3 states
 



 \- Donor Agency
 



  





 8\. Documentation and Reporting
 



  





 \- Documentation of Best Practice Visit reports submitted by the Project Coordinator, State Supervisors \& Assistant Project Coordinator \- (Research)/Senior Researcher (himself).
 



 \- Formulation of Reports to the Donor Agency as and when required.
 



 \- Preparation of the Final Project Report, based on Public consultation meetings, Change Manual, baseline and endline evaluation reports from the respective states and monthly reports from respective State Supervisors.
 



  





 9\. Miscellaneous
 



  





 \- Assistant Project Coordinator \- (Research)/Senior Researcher will report to the Project Director and Project Coordinator.
 



 \- In\-addition to the above\-mentioned job chart, the Project Director \& Project Coordinator may assign any other project related tasks from time to time.
 



  





 SALARY AND OTHER SERVICE CONDITIONS
 



  





 \- Assistant Project Coordinator \- (Research): Rs. 75,000 per month (including Rs. 5,000 as transport allowance)
 



 \- Senior Researcher: Rs. 60,000 per month (including Rs. 5,000 as transport allowance)
 



 \- The selected candidate will have to give the undertaking in the form of the bond to serve for minimum period of one year.
 



 \- Economy\-class airfare for visits to various States and UTs
 



 \- Accommodation in police guest houses (or will be reimbursed as per IPF policy).
 



 \- Other service conditions will be governed by IPF HR and other policies
 



  





 SELECTION PROCESS
 



  





 Selection will be based on a written examination and an interview (if you clear the written exam) to be held on 15th \& 16th October 2026 at IPF HQ New Delhi.
 



  





 HOW TO APPLY
 



  





 Please visit https://www.policefoundationindia.org/careers for detailed guidelines.
 



  





 \- Download the application form and fill it out electronically, along with updated CV in PDF format \& send them to us at recruitment.tpfi@gmail.com
 



 \- For queries, write to recruitment.tpfi@gmail.com or contact 9625878853 (Admin Officer) \& 9910224876 (Project Coordinator).
 



 \- Last date for online submission of applications: 5th October 2026 till 4:00 PM only.

Come join us!
   

  

**The Role**
 Content Analyst will work with our Content team to expand AlphaSense’s content offering and support the needs of our clients. You will work together with a team of: product managers, content analysts, software engineers, and content vendors. Tasks will include: identifying and onboarding new content, configuring automatic content ingestion processes, and monitoring content quality. Content sets include public company presentations, news, regulatory, trade journals, publications, and other content available via the web.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will have: strong written and verbal communication skills; prior content onboarding and support experience; solid analytical skills; web research; and troubleshooting skills.
   

  

**Roles And Responsibilities**

Define requirements for quality reports and execute quality reports.
* Troubleshooting Content Issues : Bring new ideas and concepts forward to develop innovative and effective ways of troubleshooting content issues.

Escalate to internal teams and externally to content providers when necessary, raise tickets, and track issues. Coordinate with engineering teams, product managers, and content providers regularly.
* Coordinate with content providers : Proactively follow up with content providers and internal teams in order to resolve issues in a timely manner. Keep the stakeholders/requestors up to date on their reported issues.
* Content Flow Monitoring \& Reporting : Track processing state, generate content usage reports, and maintain logs of content requests (e.g., via Productboard or similar tools).
* Documentation : Create, update, and document content onboarding processes.
* Quality Assurance and Quality Control: review documents for property categorization and tagging across our processing pipeline of content

* Outstanding oral and written communication skills
* 0\-4 years of data entry and/or data maintenance experience.

* Ability to distill and explain complex issues in simple terms

 The UMGEA – Global Analytics team is seeking an Analyst for the Field Analytics team. The Analyst will support the build and rollout of scalable merchant intelligence capabilities that help identify actionable opportunities, enable retention and growth initiatives, and inform Client Management and Marketing treatments across GMNS.
   

  

 This role will support work across merchant triggers, retention analytics, trigger arbitration, treatment playbooks, and predictive insights. The Analyst will help translate analytical opportunities into clear business actions, supporting the transition of insights and pilots into governed, production\-ready capabilities through platforms. The role requires strong analytical problem\-solving, attention to detail, execution discipline, and the ability to turn complex data into practical recommendations that can be activated by field, Client Management, and Marketing partners.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Provide analytic and execution support for merchant retention, trigger arbitration, treatment playbooks, and predictive insights that enable GMNS growth initiatives and CLM priorities.
* Analyze merchant performance, spend, engagement, coverage, and behavioral trends to identify early indicators of decline, retention risk, and growth opportunities and support field activation decisions.
* Support the development and scaling of merchant trigger capabilities, including deterministic and predictive triggers that help enable timely, insight\-led interventions.
* Help translate analytical pilots and proof\-of\-concepts into governed, production\-ready capabilities through enterprise platforms such as TargetIQ .
* Partner with cross\-functional stakeholders to understand business questions, define analytical requirements, and deliver timely, high\-quality insights.
* Translate complex data into clear, concise findings, treatment recommendations, and business actions that can be understood and acted upon by partners.
* Support automation and standardization of recurring analytics processes to improve efficiency, reduce operational risk, and increase speed to market.


**Qualifications**
* 2\-4 years of relevant experience in analytical domain.
* Intellectual curiosity, attention to detail ability to learn quickly and drive results.
* Ability to drive insights from data, manage multiple projects and drive results in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong collaboration skills with ability to build relationships and challenge the status quo.
* Excellent business writing and presentation skills with the ability to communicate effectively, build relationships and influence at all levels.
* Technical Skills: Familiarity with Google Big Query, SQL, Python, Lumi, PySpark and Tableau.
* Experience in dispute analytics, risk operations, or merchant business preferred.
* Experience in Machine Learning/ Cloud / Gen AI is a plus.


**Academic Background**
* Bachelors in Statistics/Mathematics/Economics/ Engineering/Data Science with relevant experience.
* Post Graduation in Statistics/Mathematics/ Economics/Engineering/Management is a plus.

 At American Express, our culture is built on a 175\-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. Working under the direction of the SC Digitalization Manager, the role helps ensure data is structured, consistent, governed, and usable across systems to support operational performance, planning, service, inventory, working capital, and cost optimization. title: Senior Analyst - Supply Chain
description:
**Job Description \- Senior Analyst \- Supply Chain** 




  





**You should apply if you have:** 



* Prior D2C or e\-commerce background — you already understand the complexity of order\-to\-delivery systems, multi\-node fulfilment, and the operational quirks of a high\-velocity consumer business, so you're not learning the domain from scratch
* A sharp analytical mind with genuine curiosity about how logistics networks, warehouses, and support operations actually work end to end
* Strong quantitative comfort — you can model fulfilment and logistics allocation, inventory positioning, vendor performance, and RTO/COD risk with real rigour
* A builder's instinct — you don't stop at a dashboard; you want to prototype the algorithmic product (an allocation engine, a fraud score, a routing rule) that fixes the problem programmatically
* An AI\-first workflow — you use LLMs and vibe coding tools to build working prototypes, not just slides
* Comfort operating across multiple functions at once — warehouse, logistics, customer support, production, and procurement all draw on your intelligence layer
* High ownership through to closure — you don't stop at 'I shared the analysis'; you track whether the fix actually moved the metric
* Ownership\-driven attitude — you investigate problems no one assigned to you and push recommendations through to adoption



  





**You should not apply if you:** 



* Don't have prior D2C or e\-commerce exposure — this role assumes you already understand that operating environment; it isn't a place to learn it from zero
* Are looking to run day\-to\-day warehouse or logistics operations — this is an intelligence and analytics role that informs ops, not an ops role itself
* Need a long ramp time — we expect you to get conversant across WH, logistics, CS, production, and procurement context quickly
* Are uncomfortable holding several functions in your head at once and prioritizing across them
* See your job as ending at a report — here the goal is often a working algorithmic product, not just a recommendation
* Consider your job done once a dashboard ships — you need to keep watching it and flag when something breaks



  





**Skills Required:** 




  





**Must\-Have** 



* D2C / E\-commerce Background: hands\-on experience in a D2C, quick\-commerce, or high\-velocity consumer business — this is non\-negotiable, since it's what lets you understand the complexity of our systems from day one
* Supply Chain \& Logistics Analytics: reasoning about how orders should be allocated across fulfilment and logistics partners, and how a fulfilment network should evolve as the business scales
* COD \& RTO Risk Analysis: analysing order and delivery patterns to flag fraud and RTO risk
* Data Modelling \& SQL: comfortable querying and modelling on a warehouse (Redshift or similar) to build data cuts for multiple functions
* Algorithmic Product Thinking: able to scope and prototype rule\-based or lightweight algorithmic tools that automate a decision (allocation, routing, cancellation prediction) rather than just reporting on it
* Customer Support Ops Analytics: building scorecards for support quality/efficiency and identifying automation opportunities, including voice agent/IVR use cases
* Vendor Performance Analytics: analysing vendor\-level data (fill rate, quality, lead time, cost) to help procurement decide when to de\-risk away from a vendor or push for more utilization from one
* Structured Project \& Impact Tracking: taking a finding from problem statement and baseline through to a tracked project with a target KPI, and validating after the fact whether it actually moved the number
* Analytics Tools: Excel/Google Sheets for modelling and a BI tool (Metabase/Power BI) for reporting
* AI\-Assisted Building: using LLMs and vibe coding tools to prototype logistics and CS intelligence tools quickly



  





**Good to Have** 



* Python for scripting data pulls, automations, or lightweight algorithmic prototypes
* Prior exposure to COD/RTO fraud protection systems
* Familiarity with WMS/OMS platforms or courier aggregators
* Exposure to voice agent/IVR or CS automation platforms
* Basic optimization or linear\-programming concepts for allocation/inventory problems



  





**What will you do?** 




**Fulfilment \& Logistics Allocation Intelligence** 



* Build data\-driven logic for how orders should be allocated across fulfilment locations and courier partners
* Assess how the fulfilment network should evolve as order volumes and geographies grow, and where new locations would help
* This kind of business case — going from a raw operational question to a data\-backed algorithm that runs the decision — is representative of the business cases and product algorithms you'll own end to end in this role



**Inventory Optimization** 



* Build models to project stock requirements at the fulfilment\-location level across the network
* Minimize stockouts and overstock by improving how inventory is positioned across locations



**COD \& RTO Fraud Protection** 



* Analyse COD order patterns to identify at\-risk pin codes, customers, and order profiles
* Build and monitor fraud/risk scoring systems that flag orders before dispatch



**Vendor Intelligence for Procurement** 



* Analyse vendor\-level performance — fill rate, quality, lead time, cost — to give procurement a clear, data\-backed view of each vendor
* Help procurement decide when to de\-risk away from a vendor versus when to push for greater utilization from one



**Customer Support Intelligence**

title: Analyst - D2C Merchandising
description:
**Job Description \- Analyst \- D2C Merchandising** 




  





**You should apply if you have:** 



* A sharp analytical mind combined with a genuine feel for on\-site consumer experience — you notice when a layout, widget, or page just doesn't convert, and you can prove why with data
* Strong grounding in A/B testing methodology — designing hypotheses, sizing tests, and reading results correctly rather than eyeballing conversion bumps
* Comfort blending qualitative and quantitative research — you can watch session recordings on tools like Hotjar/Clarity and run user interviews, and translate what you see into a testable hypothesis
* Fluency with product/funnel analytics — you can dig into event\-level data to find exactly where the funnel is leaking and size the opportunity to fix it
* An ownership mindset over the D2C storefront as a whole — you think of every widget, PDP section, sale page, and search result as real estate to be optimized, not just decorated
* An AI\-first workflow — you use LLMs and vibe coding tools to prototype page changes, synthesize research, and move faster than a traditional analyst would
* Stakeholder management ability — you can take a merchandizing recommendation to the product and design teams and defend it with evidence



**You should not apply if you:** 



* Are looking to run merchandising operations day\-to\-day (inventory, pricing, catalog ops) — this is an analysis and optimization role, not a merch\-ops role
* Need a long ramp time — we expect you to understand our D2C storefront and start proposing tests within weeks
* Treat a page redesign or a new widget as the finish line rather than the start of a measurement cycle
* Are uncomfortable making a judgment call on a page layout without a perfectly clean dataset behind it



  





**Skills Required:** 




**Must\-Have** 



* A/B Testing \& Experimentation Design: framing hypotheses, calculating sample size and test duration, and reading out results correctly
* Session Recording \& Behavioural Research: hands\-on use of Hotjar and/or Microsoft Clarity to watch and synthesize real user sessions into friction points
* Product/Funnel Analytics: using event\-based analytics tools to identify exactly where the funnel is leaking and quantify the opportunity
* Qualitative Research: running and synthesizing session recordings and user interviews into actionable findings
* Merchandizing \& Storefront Analytics: reasoning about widget placement, PDP structure, sale page architecture, and on\-site search/discovery
* Analytics Tools: GA4 (or similar) for on\-site behaviour, a BI tool (Metabase/Power BI) for reporting, and Excel/Sheets for modelling
* AI\-Assisted Building: using LLMs and vibe coding tools to prototype pages, synthesize research, and speed up analysis



**Good to Have** 



* Familiarity with event\-based product analytics platforms such as Mixpanel or Amplitude
* Basic familiarity with Figma or similar to mock up widget/page changes
* Prior experience with PDP or CRO optimization in a D2C or e\-commerce business
* Python for basic scripting on data pulls or test analysis



  





**What will you do?** 




**Own the D2C Storefront Real Estate** 



* Decide how every widget on the homepage, category, and PDP pages should be placed and sequenced
* Plan and prioritize sale and campaign page layouts across major sale events
* Continuously audit the storefront for underperforming or redundant real estate



**Run A/B Testing \& Experimentation** 



* Design and run structured A/B tests on landing pages, PDPs, widgets, and on\-site promotions
* Define success metrics, calculate sample size, and read out results with statistical rigour
* Build and maintain a prioritized backlog of testing hypotheses



**Drive Consumer Insights** 



* Watch and synthesize session recordings on Hotjar/Clarity to uncover on\-site friction points
* Run user interviews to go deeper on the 'why' behind observed behaviour
* Convert qualitative signals into testable hypotheses and merchandizing recommendations



**Diagnose Funnel Leakages** 



* Use product analytics tools to trace the funnel step by step and pinpoint where users drop off
* Quantify the size of each leakage and prioritize fixes by potential impact
* Partner with product on instrumentation gaps when the data needed isn't already tracked



**Plan On\-Site Promotions \& Campaigns** 



* Plan how sale pages, campaign pages, and promotional widgets should look and be sequenced across the site
* Coordinate timing and placement of on\-site promotions with the marketing calendar



**Optimize PDPs and On\-Site Search** 



* Identify PDP\-level improvements — content, trust signals, cross\-sell, review placement — and validate them with data
* Monitor on\-site search and discovery performance and recommend improvements to relevance and merchandizing rules



  





**Translate Insights into Merchandising Recommendations** 



* Convert findings into clear, prioritized recommendations for the merchandising operations team to execute
* You own the analysis and the recommendation — the merchandising team owns execution — so follow\-through and clarity matter

title: Demand Planner
description:
At McCormick, we bring our passion for flavor to work each day. We encourage growth, respect everyone's contributions and do what's right for our business, our people, our communities and our planet. Join us on our quest to make every meal and moment better.
   

  

 Founded in Baltimore, MD in 1889 in a room and a cellar by 25\-year\-old Willoughby McCormick with three employees, McCormick is a global leader in flavour. With over 14,000 employees around the world and more than $6 Billion in annual sales, the Company manufactures, markets, and distributes spices, seasoning mixes, condiments and other flavourful products to the entire food industry, retail outlets, food manufactures, food service businesses and consumers.
   

  

 While our global headquarters are in the Baltimore, Maryland, USA area, McCormick operates and serves customers from nearly 60 locations in 25 countries and 170 markets in Asia\-Pacific, China, Europe, Middle East and Africa, and the Americas, including North, South and Central America
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The Demand Planner executes the demand forecasting strategy for a low\-volume and low complexity portfolio, accountable for \<$500\+ million of annual sales revenue. This role requires analytical mastery and proven experience with statistical modeling. The Demand Planner also requires strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex algorithms to cross\-functional business partners. The position helps support the monthly Pre\-Commercial Review/Consensus process within the IBP framework by owning the baseline statistical forecast. This role also supports Product Life Cycle management through supply chain forecasting, error detection and resolution. By providing accurate baseline forecasts and reducing forecast bias, this position enables McCormick to deliver predictable financial results and ensure cost, service and working capital goals are met.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Maintains historical baseline data and trends, determines best\-fit statistical models for each SKU, and cleanses historical data to remove anomalies where applicable.
* Tracks and maintains demand KPIs (Forecast Accuracy and Forecast Bias) to determine appropriate root cause corrective action next steps.
* Communication of downstream impacts of material plan changes (short\-term).
* Forecast Value\-Add (FVA) analysis and implementation
* Trouble shoots large, complex system problems with IT and GBS; develops forecast scenarios with assumptions.
* Support role in IBP and S\&OE processes (Pre\-PCR, PCR and PSRs)


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Finance, Supply Chain, or related field of study.

title: Fraud Manager
description:
The Fraud Management professional is responsible for preventing, detecting, investigating, and mitigating fraudulent activities across the life insurance business. This role ensures protection of company assets, policyholders, and brand reputation by implementing effective fraud controls, analytics, and investigation processes throughout the policy lifecycle.
 



  





**Fraud Detection \& Prevention** 




  





 • Identify, analyze, and investigate suspected or actual incidents of fraud/ suspected fraud involving internal policy violations or fraudulent activities related to proposals, underwriting, claims, servicing, and distribution.
 



 • Develop and implement fraud prevention strategies, red\-flag indicators, and early warning systems.
 



 • Monitor high\-risk transactions, claims, complaints agents, medical service providers, and third\-party vendors.
 



 • Conduct Fraud risk assessment and Forensic audits
 



 • Create fraud training and awareness programs for Employees, agents, distribution channel and policy holders.
 



  





**Investigations \& Case Management**




  





 • Conduct detailed fraud investigations, including document review, interviews, and field verifications.
 



 • Coordinate with internal teams (underwriting, claims, sales, legal) to gather evidence.
 



 • Prepare investigation reports and recommend appropriate actions.
 



  





**Data Analytics \& Reporting**




  





 • Use data analytics, MIS, and dashboards to identify fraud patterns and emerging risks.
 



 • Track fraud trends, loss metrics, recovery amounts, and control effectiveness.
 



 • Present regular reports to senior management and risk committees.
 



 • Conduct meetings of Fraud monitoring committee (FMC) and support the FMC in discharging its function
 



  





**Stakeholder \& Regulatory Coordination**




  





 • Liaise with law enforcement agencies, regulators, forensic experts, and external investigators when required.
 



 • Ensure compliance with regulatory guidelines, internal policies, and industry best practices related to fraud risk management.
 



  





**Process Improvement \& Training**




  





 • Ability to prepare policies and process notes around fraud and related areas
 



 • Strengthen fraud control frameworks and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
 



 • Conduct fraud awareness training for employees, agents, and partners.
 



 • Support automation and technology initiatives for fraud detection and prevention.
 



  





**Key Skills \& Competencies**




 • Strong knowledge of life insurance products, underwriting, and claims processes
 



 • Investigation and analytical skills
 



 • Understanding of fraud typologies and risk assessment
 



 • Data analysis and reporting (Excel, SQL, BI tools preferred)
 



 • Communication and stakeholder management
 



 • High ethical standards and attention to detail
 



  





**Qualifications**




  





 • Bachelor’s degree
 



 • Professional certifications in fraud/risk (e.g., CFE, CFI, AML) are an advantage
 



  





**Experience**




  





 • 5 to 7 years of experience in fraud management, risk, Financial Crime, or compliance within life insurance or financial services (depending on role level)

title: Specialist, Oracle HCM
description:
**Make your mark with Thiess** 





 Every day, all around the world, Thiess supports and celebrates our people. We recognise talent, reward transparency, champion diversity and embrace change.
 



 Join us and hone your skills and develop new ones. Take on big challenges and grow through mentorship, collaboration, and empowerment.
 








**The Opportunity** 





 As Oracle HCM Application Specialist within the People Systems team, you will support and enhance Thiess's HR systems and technology landscape, applying strong technical and functional expertise in Oracle HCM Cloud configuration, integrations, and data management to deliver reliable system solutions and process efficiencies that improve the employee and leader experience across the business globally.
 




**Reporting to the Manager, People Systems, you will provide timely, high\-quality technical support to the HR team and broader business, including the scoping, implementation, and optimisation of HR systems projects to ensure accurate, consistent, and efficient outcomes.** 










**As the \[Position Title], you will:** 





**Operational BAU Support** 




 • Act as the first and second point of contact for Oracle HCM issues raised by the global workforce through the ticketing system.
   

 • Be the HR domain expert and HCM functional specialist for the implemented modules including Core HR, Talent, Performance, Goals,
 



**Recruitment, Onboarding and Compensation \& Benefits.** 




  

 • Support strategy and roadmap formulation for Oracle HCM and other HR systems, supporting the Manager, People Systems.
   

 • Triage, investigate, and resolve incidents and service requests within agreed service levels.
   

 • Provide ongoing L2/L3 functional and technical support for production issues, service requests, and change requests, ensuring SLA\-driven system stability.
   

 • Make system configuration changes, correct data, and troubleshoot issues across HCM modules.
   

 • Keep clear records of resolutions, configurations, and known issues.
   

 • Escalate complex issues to Oracle Support or implementation partners (CIMIC / Oracle / WIPRO) where needed.
 



**Projects** 




 • Own end\-to\-end delivery of HCM rollout projects, from requirements and solution design through configuration, data migration, cutover, and hypercare support.
   

 • Support the rollout of Oracle HCM across different geographies, and Thiess businesses working with regional HR, Payroll, and IT stakeholders.
   

 • Define integration requirements between Oracle HCM and other systems, and resolve integration issues.
   

 • Take part in fit\-gap analysis and recommend target\-state design and process improvements.
   

 • Present project updates, steering committee papers, and post\-implementation reviews to leadership.
 



**Enhancements** 




 • Identify opportunities to improve systems and processes based on user feedback and recurring trends.
   

 • Support the design, testing, and roll\-out of new features, functionality, and quarterly Oracle updates.
   

 • Drive continuous HCM optimisation and automation of operational tasks and reporting.
   

 • Build and maintain reports and dashboards using BI Publisher and OTBI for actionable HR insights.
   

 • Support change impact assessment and user communication or training for new enhancements.
   

 Commercial \& Stakeholder Relationships • Look for cost efficiencies where possible, without compromising safety.
   

 • Engage others by focusing on common ground and shared objectives.
   

 • Consult with stakeholders before making decisions.
 



**People \& Leadership** 




 • Work towards plans to achieve team and business goals.
   

 • Support others to deliver results and improvements.
   

 • Coordinate effectively across teams and manage issues, conflict, and problems as they arise.
   

 • Build collaborative relationships with global HR functions.
   

 Health, Safety \& Sustainability • Understand the critical risks in your area and reassess hazards if the work area changes.
   

 • Know and apply the standards and procedures relevant to your role. Stop the job if in doubt, fix the problem, or warn others of danger.
 








**About you** 





**Formal Education** 




 • Bachelor's and/ or master's degree in technology, Human Resources, or a related field preferred.
   

 • Oracle HCM Cloud certification(s) advantageous.
 



**Work Experience** 




 • 3\+ years' experience working with Oracle HCM / Fusion.
   

 • In\-depth experience with Oracle HCM modules including Core HR, Talent, Performance, Goals, Recruitment, Onboarding and Compensation \& Benefits.
   

 • Experience supporting or delivering Oracle HCM Cloud implementation projects, ideally across multiple countries spread across diverse businesses.
 



**Technical Skills** 




 • Strong domain knowledge of HR, Payroll, Time \& Attendance and Talent management processes is a must
   

 • Strong technical and functional knowledge of Oracle HCM Cloud, including configuration, integrations, and data management.
   

 • Confident troubleshooting skills, able to diagnose and resolve issues efficiently within a ticketing environment.
   

 • Understanding of system integrations (e.g., middleware, third\-party HR platforms) and data governance principles.
   

 • Able to translate business requirements into practical, scalable system solutions.
   

 • Proficient in MS PowerPoint, Word and Excel.
   

 • Well\-developed written and oral communication, with excellent attention to detail.
   

 • Comfortable working with stakeholders across Mining Operations, HR, Payroll, IT, Finance and business leadership in different regions and time zones.
   

 • Strong understanding of HR processes and associated workflows.
 




**What's on offer** 





 At Thiess, our people are the heart of everything we do. We're committed to creating a workplace where everyone can thrive \- safely, confidently and with opportunities to grow.
 


* Competitive salary package.
* Ongoing training \& development opportunities.
* A strong safety\-first culture across all operations, built on care, respect and accountability.
* Range of corporate discounts including health insurance (Medibank), travel \& retail products.







**About Thiess** 

 Thiess works with clients in Australia, Asia and the Americas in the dynamic field of open\-cut and underground mining.The pioneering spirit of our founders \- the legendary Thiess brothers \- is our legacy and inspires our vision to harness the power of people and technology to drive sustainable change. At Thiess, you will have the opportunity to play a part in the global energy transition. We are growing our commodities portfolio to include metals and minerals critical to the energy transition and developing services to enable sustainable mining.We’re creating a culture of curiosity, knowledge\-sharing, and continuous learning \- supporting our people to contribute to Thiess’ success and continued growth in sustainable mining. We’ll support you in honing your skills and developing new ones, taking on challenges and growing through mentorship, collaboration, and empowerment. We offer our people ongoing technical training and development opportunities so they can reach their full potential. We also invest in the workforce of the future, with a range of programs for people starting their careers. We recognise the value of an inclusive and diverse workplace through our vision of everyone matters always. We’re focused on creating an inclusive environment to enable our people to bring their best self to work because they feel safe, included and empowered.
 **About Capability Hubs**
 Thiess’ Capability Hubs are a key part of how we deliver work globally \- connecting skilled talent with business needs to provide high\-quality, efficient, and scalable services across functions and regions. The Capability Hubs enable access to global capability, supporting business growth while strengthening consistency, performance, and value delivery across Thiess. Our Capability Hubs operate as an integrated extension of the business, working in close partnership with Service Recipients to deliver outcomes that matter. With a strong focus on service discipline, governance, and continuous improvement, the Hubs play a critical role in how Thiess operates and evolves.
 **Make your mark \- Globally, People First**
 Our Capability Hubs offer the opportunity to make your mark as part of a global business, collaborating across diverse teams to connect global capability with local delivery. You will contribute to shared success while building valuable professional experience in a supportive and respectful environment where your contribution is rewarded, and your wellbeing is valued. This experience is underpinned by four key pillars \- Global Connection, Meaningful Contribution, Career Opportunities, and a Values\-led Culture \- which define what it means to work within our Capability Hubs. You will work globally with diverse teams, broadening your perspective and deepening your expertise, while contributing to meaningful outcomes that deliver value to the business. You will also build practical experience and capability to support your ongoing career growth, within a values\-led culture where people are respected, supported, and recognised for their contribution.
 





**How to Apply** 




 This role is an opportunity to take the next step in your career. With our culture of recognition, development, and a stimulating and satisfying work environment, there is no better time to join Thiess. Please click the "
 **apply** 
 " button below to apply for this role. Thiess follows an Employment check Process for all successful applicants, which includes two employment references, an ID check, educational and a medical assessment. These checks are essential to your application, and your recruiter will support you through the process. Should you require assistance applying for this opportunity, please contact us at RecruitmentIndia@thiess.com

title: Integrated Logistics Continuous Improvement Manager
description:
**It's more than a job**
 As a member of the Freight Forwarding team Kuehne\+Nagel, you will play a key role in transporting goods, optimising processes, and fulfilling our customers' promises. And by transporting medicines, toys and important machine parts, you are not only delivering goods, you are making small and big moments possible for people all around the world. At Kuehne\+Nagel, our contribution counts in more ways than we imagine.
   

  

 ‎
   

  

 Deploying and leading the CI service offering and owning the CI program for the customer, aiming achievement of cost and cash savings in KNIL customer’s supply chain. Leading business case development, providing status updates on CI program to Business Manager / customer, ensuring achievement of savings targets. Following approach to savings idea generation, validation and implementation based on KNIL experience and tailoring it to the specifics of the customer, as well as enrichment of the approach based on own best practices.
   

  

**How you create impact**
 Problem Solving
   

  

* Identifies supply chain inefficiencies, builds improvement business cases, and drives optimization initiatives to achieve cost savings


 Savings target setting
   

  

* Maps value streams, performs loss analysis, and defines cost and cash\-saving opportunities. Aligns savings targets, timelines, and resources with customers and Business Manager


 Savings pipeline development
   

  

* Leads data\-driven improvement by validating baselines, generating ideas with cross\-functional teams, and building a multi\-year portfolio of high\-impact initiatives


 Savings status tracking
   

  

* Aligns on savings calculation and reporting, maintains trackers and dashboards, and drives regular reviews to convert ideas into executable projects


 Savings delivery
   

  

* Oversees end\-to\-end execution, manages risks, and tracks actual savings to ensure benefits realization


**What we would like you to bring**
* Proven track record in change management and/or project management (min. 5 years)
* Proven experience in all transportation modes
* Proven experience in supply chain cost budgeting / optimization / value stream mapping
* Proven experience in business case creation
* Proven experience of cross regional or global collaboration in multinational environment
* Preferred candidate to have Forwarding / Logistics background


**What's in it for you**
 At Kuehne\+Nagel, you’ll be part of a global logistics leader that believes in creating real impact—on business, on customers, and on careers. Here’s what you can look forward to:
   

  

* Global Exposure: Step into a world of international opportunities with a presence in 100\+ countries
* People\-Centric Culture: Join a team where your voice matters and people genuinely care
* Learning \& Development: Grow with us personally and professionally through world\-class training and career pathways
* Innovation \& Sustainability: Be part of a future\-focused company driving real change in logistics and the planet
* Rewards \& Recognition: Get rewarded for your passion, performance, and potential
* Stability with Agility: Enjoy the best of both worlds a trusted global brand with a startup spirit


**Who we are**
 Logistics shapes everyday life \- from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne\+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.
   

  

 As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. Whether we help deliver life\-saving medicines, develop sustainable transportation solutions or support our local communities, your career will contribute to more than you can imagine.

title: People Systems Analyst
description:
**Bravura’s Commitment and Mission**
 At Bravura Solutions, collaboration, diversity and excellence matter. We value your ideas, giving you room to be curious and innovate in an exciting, fast\-paced, and flexible environment. We look for many different skills and abilities, as well as how you can add value to Bravura and our culture.
   

  

 As a Global FinTech market leader and ASX listed company, Bravura is a trusted partner to over 350 leading financial services clients, delivering wealth management technology and products. We invest significantly in our technology hubs and innovation labs, which inspire and drive our creative, future\-focused mindset. We take pride in developing cutting\-edge, digital first technology solutions that support our clients to achieve financial security and prosperity for their customers.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Workday Analyst serves as a functional and technical expert for Workday HCM and related modules. This role partners closely with HR, Finance, and IT to optimize system functionality, configure enhancements, troubleshoot issues, and drive Workday best practices. The ideal candidate has deep Workday knowledge, strong analytical skills, and the ability to translate business needs into scalable system solutions.
   

  

**Position Purpose**
 Reporting to the People system Manager, based in Sydney, the Senior/ People system analyst is needed to provide expert systems support with Workday and other integrated systems as needed.
   

  

 One component of this role is to help optimize the Workday system by streamlining business processes and enabling enhancements such as reporting automation and dashboards, providing coaching and guidance to the broader team, training and presenting to business and People \& Culture stakeholders and ticket resolution.
   

  

 The Senior /People Systems Analyst will also be required to support across other People related systems and tools including survey tool, recruitment, remuneration and consolidate and provide reporting and key People \& Culture metrics.
   

  

**What We 'll Do**
**System Administration \& Configuration**
* Lead configuration, testing, and deployment of Workday modules such as HCM, Talent, Absence, and Compensation.
* Manage Workday security, business processes and reporting.
* Evaluate existing configurations and recommend optimizations aligned with business strategy and Workday best practices.


**Support \& Troubleshooting**
* Serve as the primary escalation point for Workday issues and inquiries.
* Diagnose root causes, resolve system errors, and coordinate fixes with IT or internal teams.
* Maintain data integrity through audits, validation, and quality checks.


**Enhancements \& Projects**
* Lead Workday enhancement cycles, including requirements gathering, solution design, testing, and deployment.
* Manage semi\-annual Workday releases, assess tenant impacts, and communicate changes to stakeholders.
* Support system\-related HR initiatives such as process improvements, workflow automation, and new module implementations.


**Reporting \& Analytics**
* Build advanced custom reports, dashboards, metrics, and scorecards using Workday Reporting.
* Provide actionable analytics and insights to HR leadership and business stakeholders.
* Ensure compliance with data governance and confidentiality standards.


**Stakeholder Collaboration**
* Partner with HR, Finance, Payroll, and business leaders to understand operational needs and deliver effective Workday solutions.
* Train end users, develop documentation, and enhance Workday adoption across the organization.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to enhance the employee experience using Workday tools


**Corporate Responsibilities Environmental \& Health \& Safety**
* Ensure Annual Training is competed as required.
* Review Annually \& Comply with all Company policies related to H\&S and Environmental Management Systems
* Report all/any breaches or accidents/near misses immediately when discovered.


**Unleash your potential**
 To be successful in this role, your background and experience will include:
   

  

  

* Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent experience.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on Workday experience, including configuration and administration.
* Expertise in at least two Workday modules (e.g., HCM Core, Compensation, Absence, Payroll and Talent).
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and troubleshooting abilities.
* Experience with Workday report writing and complex calculated fields.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills


**Core Competencies**
* Attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
* Ability to manage multiple projects and deadline
* Strong business acumen
* Collaborative and proactive partnership mindset
* Continuous improvement mentality


**Preferred**
* Workday Pro or Workday certification(s).
* Experience with Workday integrations (EIB, Core Connectors, Studio).
* Familiarity with release management processes and Workday tenants (sandbox, preview, production).
* Prior experience in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment.


**Working at Bravura**
 Our people are the heart of our business. We work hard to provide a rich employee experience and a robust framework for ongoing career development.
   

  

  

* Competitive salary and employee benefits scheme
* 2 paid volunteering days and a range of community\-based initiatives to get involved in
* Parental (including secondary) leave policy
* Free meals/free transport/cab service


**So, what’s next?**
 We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion so even if you don’t match every listed skill or tick all the boxes, we’d still love to hear from you.
   

  

 Please note that interviews are primarily conducted virtually and if you require any reasonable adjustments or would like to note which pronouns you use, please let us know.
   

  

 All final applicants for this position will be asked to consent to a criminal record and background check. Please note that people with criminal records are not automatically barred from applying for this position. Each application will be considered on its merits.

title: Delivery Operations Associate Manager
description:
**Skill required:** 
 Financial Planning \& Analysis \- Financial Planning and Analysis (FP\&A)
   

  

**Designation:** 
 Delivery Operations Associate Manager
   

  

**Qualifications:** 
 Any Graduation
   

  

**Years of Experience:** 
 10 to 14 years
   

  

**About Accenture**
 Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song— all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 784,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com
   

  

**What would you do?** 
 The primary responsibility of the role is to proactively manage the delivery of Group Management and Statutory Reporting information in line with the agreed service level agreements by acting as a P\&L owner. Group Management information will include financial information and scenarios required for S\&OP meetings, H1 and FY targets. This will include challenging assumptions and coordination data inputs in all internal reporting systems, running the forecasting process activities, preparation and generation of financial information accurately and performing quality review with key finance senior stakeholders prior to releasing to the customer for approval. Drive independent analysis and provide insightful recommendations to the senior stakeholders. The objective of this role is to enable the Area Finance team to meet their business objectives by consolidating area financials, tracking actuals delivery vs budgets, providing key insights for Finance leadership team, as well as managing monthly dashboards and providing executive summary for Finance leadership team along with insights on key drivers. This role will partner senior stakeholders across various functional teams (Marketing Directors, Commercial Directors, Heads of Finance, Supply Chain Directors, etc) to provide strategic financial guidance on key financial performance in the market. Specific responsibilities include, but not limited to, overseeing financial forecasts, industry value projections, regulatory impacts to the category, price war analysis, etc. The ideal candidate will proactively and collaboratively work across the organization to develop a competitor framework that can effectively be used as a platform to provide insights revenue and resource allocation and drive recommendations on potential course of action. This position requires an excellent knowledge of financials, strategic thinking, analytical expertise, and leadership skills. information.
   

  

**What are we looking for?**
* Qualifications: CAs \& CFAs
* 8–12 years of progressive finance experience
* Proven track record in budgeting, forecasting, and strategic financial analysis.
* Experience in global FMCG / CPG / Tobacco industries or similar dynamic environments is an advantage.
* Demonstrated ability to manage teams, influence senior stakeholders, and drive process improvements.
* Advanced Excel (macros, pivot tables, etc.), ERP systems (SAP), FP\&A tools, BI dashboards, Alteryx, Agentic AI, Lean Six Sigma, Tableau
* Knowledge of FP\&A tools (SAP BPC, Hyperion, Anaplan,)
* In\-depth knowledge of P\&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow management.
* Strong ability to convey financial information clearly to senior leadership.
* Excellent analytical skills and ability to handle large volumes of data accurately.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills; able to work across all levels and functions.
* Ability to work under pressure, meet tight deadlines, and adapt to rapidly changing conditions.
* Ability to proactively identify risk, perform sensitivity analysis and drive risk mitigation
* Detail\-oriented, proactive, and capable of rational decision\-making and problem\-solving.
* Roles and Responsibilities:
* Own / Lead the preparation of annual budgets and periodic forecasts, ensuring accuracy and alignment with business objectives.
* Conduct variance analysis on actual vs. budget/forecast, identify key drivers to the variances, analyze trends, risks, and opportunities, and provide actionable recommendations.
* Develop financial models for scenario planning, sensitivity analysis, and long\-range forecasting to support strategic initiatives.
* Deliver timely and accurate financial reports and dashboards, translating complex data into clear, actionable insights for senior leadership.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to influence decision\-making, optimize costs, and ensure resource allocation aligns with strategic priorities.
* Drive efficiency through automation and implement best practices for FP\&A processes, reporting, and data accuracy.
* Ensure adherence to financial policies, internal controls, and regulatory requirements across all FP\&A activities.
* Manage and mentor FP\&A analysts, fostering a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and high performance.
* Act as a vital member of the Consumer Leadership team in GBS, focusing on the Commercial Finance experience
* Support the Consumer Delivery Lead in creating value across product categories
* Present forecasts, performance, and potential risks/opportunities across all product lines including new categories and prepare strategies for senior stakeholders, considering competitor actions
* Perform financial modelling, sensitivity, and scenario analysis to accurately reflect the impact of proposed changes on the operating results of the business and to support informed business decisions.
* Evaluate the financial impact of regulatory change
* Lead and coordinate efforts for process improvement and efficiency within the commercial finance team, providing timely insights
* Undertake ad\-hoc projects as needed
* Contribute to developing integrated business strategies for portfolio, pricing, excise, and trade, considering all elements of the mix
* Conduct competitor reviews and share key insights with Top Management, incorporating them into pricing and excise discussions
* Establish governance and risk guidelines for pricing and excise activities to ensure strong controls and SOx compliance (where applicable)
* Please note that this role may require you to work in rotational shifts

Girls and children who have experienced abuse or violence benefit from greater access to healing, care, support, gender justice, and other services needed to ensure physical, social and mental well\-being.  Additionally, Protsahan nurtures grassroots partnerships focused on Healing Childhood Trauma through comprehensive training, research, and advocacy initiatives. These efforts aim to fortify the child protection ecosystem and promote holistic well\-being for every child, particularly those in remote areas across India.

 **www.protsahan.co.in**
 The Program Officer – MEL will play a key role in translating field data and digital insights into clear, actionable evidence that strengthens program delivery across Protsahan’s work.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 The Program Officer – MEL will ensure that Protsahan’s program data is collected systematically and on a regular basis, maintained with high levels of accuracy, and regularly analysed to generate actionable insights for program improvement and organisational learning. The role will work closely with program teams to monitor implementation, identify gaps, track outcomes, and surface emerging trends. The Officer should be able to analyse and clearly represent both quantitative and qualitative data, translating complex findings into accessible insights, reports, and visualisations. The role will also involve working with diverse data sources including digital applications, social media platforms, and large datasets to identify patterns and strengthen evidence\-based decision\-making. Strong data analytics skills, including knowledge of BigQuery, SQL, dashboards, data extraction and management, and social and digital media trends, will be a significant advantage.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Monitoring Programs**
* Implement monitoring and evaluation plans, formats, tools, and reporting systems across Protsahan programs and partners.
* Ensure program data is collected systematically and regularly.
* Maintain accurate, complete, and up\-to\-date program data.
* Conduct regular field visits and data verification checks to confirm reported data reflects on\-ground program implementation.
* Work with field teams to strengthen their understanding and use of monitoring data that is accurate, complete, and meaningful.


**Data Management \& Analysis**
* Collect and analyse quantitative and qualitative primary and secondary data, including data generated through monitoring, assessments, and evaluations.
* Conduct regular data quality checks to identify gaps, inconsistencies, anomalies, and data collection issues.
* Identify patterns, trends, gaps, emerging issues, and insights from the data to inform program decisions.
* Use basic Excel skills for data management, analysis, and reporting, and have working knowledge of SQL for querying and analysing data in BigQuery.
* Support assessments, evaluation studies, and other evidence\-generation initiatives, including tool development, fieldwork, analysis, and documentation.


**Digital and AI\-enabled Learning**
* Collect and analyse data from diverse digital sources, including social media platforms, digital applications, and large datasets, to track and interpret trends, patterns, and engagement.
* Use digital data to generate insights and inform decision\-making.
* Maintain and improve AI\-enabled learning tools, such as chatbots or digital assistants, that reinforce training and support frontline staff with day\-to\-day protocol questions.
* Keep AI\-enabled content accurate, up to date, and aligned with program protocols and safeguarding requirements, with appropriate human oversight.


**Knowledge Management**
* Maintain and update curriculum, facilitator resources, and AI chatbot content.
* Maintain and update Protsahan’s repository of program evidence, lessons learned, and field knowledge.
* Contribute to periodic learning reviews.
* Support the development and quality assurance of MEL tools including data collection formats, indicators, and reporting templates ensuring they stay accurate and consistent as program insights evolve.


**Candidate Requirements**

* On case data, girls’ personal information, and anything gathered during fieldwork or research.
* Adaptability and Learning Agility: Comfortable working in a dynamic grassroots environment where priorities, systems, and approaches may evolve based on field realities and organisational needs.
* Analytical and Critical Thinking: Able to look beyond numbers and reports, identify meaningful patterns, ask the right questions, and distinguish between surface\-level trends and genuine insights. Including AI literacy with judgment i.e., you can maintain a working chatbot, and you know exactly where automation stops and human judgment must take over especially in programs involving girls.

* Collaboration and Curiosity: Able to work respectfully with diverse teams, listen to field perspectives, question existing approaches constructively, and continuously learn from evidence and experience.

title: Manager Impact, India and Southeast Asia
company: The Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet
description:
The Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet (Global Energy Alliance) The Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet (Global Energy Alliance) works for a world where everyone has access to affordable, reliable, clean electricity and the means to use it to improve their lives. Our Alliance builds transformative public, private, philanthropic partnerships to end energy poverty and accelerate green economic opportunity. Founded in 2021 by The Rockefeller Foundation, IKEA Foundation, and Bezos Earth Fund, we design innovative projects/programs, unlock finance, strengthen institutions and transform markets, delivering progress anchored in deep community engagement. By uniting actors across the value chain, from households to heads of state, we go beyond individual projects to drive lasting systems change. With work in more than 30 countries across Africa, Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, our Alliance aims to reach 1 billion people with clean electricity, prevent 4 billion tons of carbon emissions and create or improve 150 million jobs.
   

  

**Contract type: Fulltime, Open ended**
**Reports Directly To**
 Direct Reports:
   

  

**Matrix/Dual Reports**
 Chief Impact Officer
   

  

 None
   

  

 VP, India; MD, Grids of the Future
   

  

**Overview Of The Role**
 Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet’s goals are bold and audacious. We recognize that the path to a just energy transition worldwide will be complex, non\-linear, and filled with successes and opportunities, alongside failures and challenges. The Manager, Impact, India and Southeast Asia will support our effort to measure our contribution to impact through evaluations, monitoring and learning. Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning (MEL) is embedded within our operating model, to ensure that we have an ear to the ground so we remain responsive and opportunistic, while generating insights that support continuous improvement.
   

  

 Stepping into a start\-up environment, the Manager, Impact, India and Southeast Asia will lead monitoring, evaluation and learning for the India and Southeast Asia portfolio, guided by the organization’s Impact framework. They will also lead impact measurement for the Grids of the Future pillar across all regions, and provide monitoring and analytics support across the global portfolio. They will be responsible for independently establishing the routine and long\-term work component of these workstreams, ensuring that they are efficiently managed and executed.
   

  

**Accountabilities** 
  

  

* 
+ Monitoring: Providing backend impact data quality assurance for all India and Southeast Asia transactions. Provide technical advice on target setting, indicators, theory of change mechanisms, causality links for the India and Southeast Asia portfolio. Onboard and train program teams on results monitoring sheets – ensuring compliance. They will also support the monitoring function across the global portfolio, including data compilation, quality checks and analytics for quarterly impact reporting, working alongside the Alliance’s external monitoring and learning partner.
+ Grids of the Future impact: Leading impact measurement for the Grids of the Future pillar across all regions. Developing and maintaining expected\-impact estimates for utility partnerships, grid digitalization, battery energy storage and distributed energy resource programs, working with program teams and external modelling partners. Tracking realized impact against expected impact as programs move through the pipeline, and designing evaluations of utility\-level outcomes such as reliability, losses and effects on consumers.
+ Evaluation: Sourcing and managing independent evaluation partners working closely with the Director of Evaluation. Establishing the pulse on what needs evaluation and when by closely working with the India and Southeast Asia and Grids of the Future teams in sourcing evaluation questions. Selecting fit for purpose evaluation approaches and tools and sense checking their design and functionality.
+ Learning: Support the team in designing and managing ongoing reflection, sense\-making, and learning from the work to inform potential shifts in strategy when necessary, using data and evidence to rationalize change.
+ Capacity building: Onboarding, training and operationalizing Impact functions in country teams, solution teams and hiring monitoring evaluation and learning consultants. Ensuring that all requirements per the Impact framework are met in the investment cycle for all India and Southeast Asia programs.
+ Systems integration: Ensuring the internal Global Energy Alliance systems tracking progress on program implementation, financial execution and impact measuring are integrating, working in close collaboration with the IT systems manager, the management teams for country programs and scalable solutions and the Investment team.
+ Advisory function: Advising global Impact colleagues and external technical providers by ground truthing India and Southeast Asia portfolio realities.


**BEHAVIORAL COMPETENCIES**
**Preferred Attributes**
* Working in Partnership: Learning with, learning from, and learning for our partners, particularly those who are closest to the work on the ground. Balancing the needs of multiple stakeholders and working in partnership wherever possible.
* Directs Work: Being strategic with efforts and generating information that informs decision making and improves impact. Providing direction and removing obstacles to get work done.
* Manages Complexity: Makes sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
* Values Differences: Recognizes the value of different perspectives and commits to inclusion, equity, and diversity in every aspect of work.
* Intellectual Humility: We know that we don’t have all the answer. We strive to be equally comfortable talking about what is not working as we are celebrating our successes. We listen to the voices of those we serve.
* Innovation and Entrepreneurial Spirit: A self\-starter who takes initiative to identify areas of improvement and uses an energetic, pragmatic, and creative approach to optimize practice; embodying ‘Start\-Up Philosophy.’


**Required Experience**
* 10\-15 years of experience in monitoring, evaluation, and learning.
* Advanced degree in relevant subjects such as economics, public policy, or similar areas with strong training in evaluation, monitoring and learning.
* Experience in developing best\-in\-class monitoring, evaluation and learning approaches including designing and establishing these systems from scratch. Ideal experience gained in a complex organizational environment.
* Substantial experience of monitoring, evaluation and learning in the context of climate and energy programs, and/or programs driving systems change. Experience with contribution analysis will be a plus.
* Experience measuring the impact of grid infrastructure, utility performance or battery energy storage programs, including modelling expected impacts and validating them against realized results.
* Experience working in India and Southeast Asia, with familiarity with the region’s energy sector, utilities and government programs.
* Experience working independently in a fast\-paced environment.
* Experience working with contractors, consultants to ensure value for money and quality actionable outcomes.
* Exceptional attention to detail.
* Strong writing skills.
* Expertise in STATA, R or similar software packages, and MS Excel.
* Experience with Power BI or other dashboard tools, data engineering and applied use of AI tools for analysis will be a plus.


 Please submit your application on or before

It is not only the right thing to do – we could not make an impact without our team members' diverse perspectives and experiences.  Requirements

title: Fintech Fraud & Risk Analytics Engineer
description:
**Location:** 
 Gurgaon / Remote (Hybrid / Flexible Work Policy)
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
   

  

**Experience Required:** 
 3–5 Years
   

  

**Industry\-Standard Salary Range:** 
 18 LPA – 32 LPA
   

  

**About Us \& Our Mission**
 In the fast\-paced ecosystem of digital B2B fintech settlement rails and cross\-border payments, financial fraud attempts are increasingly sophisticated and executed in milliseconds. Protecting enterprise ledger systems and merchant accounts requires real\-time anomaly detection, sophisticated graph analysis, and instantaneous risk scoring.
   

  

 Our engineering culture values proactive threat mitigation, high\-performance data processing, and uncompromised system reliability. If you want to build intelligent risk engines that protect multi\-million\-dollar financial networks from malicious actors, you will find your professional home with us.
   

  

 The Role \& Impact
   

  

 We are seeking a sharp, data\-driven
 **Fintech Fraud \& Risk Analytics Engineer** 
 to design, build, and deploy real\-time fraud detection and risk scoring systems. In this role, you will analyze massive transaction streams, build behavioral profiling models, and implement automated rules and machine learning classifiers that flag suspicious activities before settlement occurs. You will work at the critical intersection of data science, backend engineering, and financial security.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities \& Daily Expectations
   

  

* Risk Engine Development: Design and scale real\-time transaction screening microservices and rule evaluation engines using Python, FastAPI, and asynchronous message queues.
* Feature Engineering: Build and maintain low\-latency feature stores that compute rolling user velocity, device fingerprinting, and transactional behavioral anomalies on the fly.
* Model Integration: Integrate machine learning classification and anomaly detection models (Isolation Forests, XGBoost, graph\-based link analysis) directly into payment processing pipelines.
* Investigation Dashboards: Build analytical reporting tools and investigative dashboards for compliance teams to review flagged transactions and audit fraud patterns.
* Latency Optimization: Ensure fraud evaluation checks execute well within tight SLA windows (under 50 milliseconds) to prevent payment friction.


**What We Are Looking For (Requirements)**
* Experience: 3 to 5 years of professional experience in data engineering, machine learning engineering, or backend development within fintech, banking, or risk management domains.
* Technical Mastery: Strong command of Python, advanced SQL, and experience with streaming data platforms (Kafka/Flink) and relational/NoSQL datastores.
* Domain Knowledge: Solid understanding of payment gateway flows, anti\-money laundering (AML) indicators, KYC verification logic, and common fintech fraud vectors.
* Analytical Mindset: Proven ability to analyze large datasets, spot statistical anomalies, and tune precision/recall tradeoffs for risk models.
* Education: Degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or equivalent analytical field.


**What We Offer \& How To Apply**
* Competitive Compensation: Industry\-standard salary bracket (18–32 LPA) backed by performance bonuses and equity options.
* High\-Impact Role: Direct ownership over core financial security and fraud prevention systems.
