title: Sr Data Product Manager , Global SAP Analytics
description:
At McCormick, we bring our passion for flavor to work each day. We encourage growth, respect everyone's contributions and do what's right for our business, our people, our communities and our planet. Join us on our quest to make every meal and moment better.
   

  

 Founded in Baltimore, MD in 1889 in a room and a cellar by 25\-year\-old Willoughby McCormick with three employees, McCormick is a global leader in flavour. With over 14,000 employees around the world and more than $6 Billion in annual sales, the Company manufactures, markets, and distributes spices, seasoning mixes, condiments and other flavourful products to the entire food industry, retail outlets, food manufactures, food service businesses and consumers.
   

  

 While our global headquarters are in the Baltimore, Maryland, USA area, McCormick operates and serves customers from nearly 60 locations in 25 countries and 170 markets in Asia\-Pacific, China, Europe, Middle East and Africa, and the Americas, including North, South and Central America
   

  

**Position Overview**
 The Data Product Manager (SAP Analytics) leads the strategy, design, and delivery of trusted, high\-value data products for McCormick’s SAP Analytics. This role is accountable for the end\-to\-end lifecycle, quality, and adoption of SAP Analytics data products that enable measurable business outcomes — including strategic decision\-making, performance transparency, and operational excellence across McCormick.
   

  

 The Data Product Manager (SAP Analytics) is accountable for the definition, championing, and most importantly, delivery of trusted, high\-value data products. The role works as one with McCormick’s Transformation \& Technology (including Data \& Analytics, Data Governance, Information Security and Technology teams) and Global Business Solutions (including Automation and Data Science \& Engineering teams) functions to connect people, platforms, and processes — establishing a trusted, intelligent, and connected SAP Analytics data foundation that supports McCormick’s global growth and enterprise value creation.
   

  

**Description**
**Key Responsibilities**
* Data Product Strategy \& Vision: Defines the strategy and roadmap for SAP Analytics data products that enable functional priorities and deliver measurable business value in alignment with McCormick’s enterprise data strategies—both at the functional level, as established by the Data Owner, and at the enterprise level as established by the Chief Data \& Analytics Officer (CDAO). Partners with stakeholders and Transformation \& Technology Business Relationship Managers (BRMs) to prioritize initiatives based on business impact, ROI potential, and readiness for advanced analytics and AI applications. Directs the design and delivery of data products that generate tangible business outcomes while ensuring scalability, interoperability, and long‑term sustainability. Establishes and maintains strong cross‑functional alignment to effectively prioritize initiatives, communicate progress, and advance McCormick’s data‑driven transformation.
* Data Product Lifecycle Ownership: Directs the planning, prioritization, and delivery of SAP Analytic data products through an agile, iterative approach that ensures responsiveness to evolving business needs. Manages the data product backlog—translating functional requirements into clear, actionable user stories—and directs Data Engineers, Data Architects (who are part of the AI and analytics product teams), and Data Stewards to deliver high\-quality, secure, and accessible data solutions. Oversees release planning and approval in alignment with governance and quality standards.
* Data Quality, Trust \& Compliance: Drives adherence to enterprise and functional standards for data quality, lineage, metadata, and compliance across SAP Analytic data products. Partners with key stakeholders to embed governance and regulatory requirements into data product design and delivery. Monitors data quality and trust metrics, driving continuous improvement to ensure data products remain reliable, reusable, and fit for analytical and AI\-driven use cases.
* Data Enablement \& Workforce Readiness: Enables relevant stakeholders to easily find, understand, and use trusted data by ensuring data products are well\-documented, cataloged, and supported with clear usage guidance. Partners with key stakeholders to maintain accurate catalog entries, metadata, and reference materials that promote consistent and compliant data use. Leads initiatives to strengthen engagement with data products and activate a culture where data is valued, trusted, and responsibly used as “ground truth”.
* Data Product Performance \& Value Realization: Defines and tracks performance metrics to measure the adoption, quality, and business impact of SAP Analytic data products. Establishes feedback loops that leverage usage insights and stakeholder input to drive continuous improvement and optimization. Partners with the Data Owner to quantify and communicate data product value, demonstrating significant advancement McCormick’s digital and AI transformation.


**Required Qualifications**
 Level of Education and Discipline
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business Analytics, or other applicable field
* Candidates with strong SAP Analytics qualifications and a demonstrated track record of data literacy may also be considered in lieu of the above degree requirements


 Experience \- functional/industry/commercial knowledge, business acumen
   

  

* 15\+ years of experience in data product management, data strategy, or data governance within a complex or global organization
* 12\+ years of experience in SAP Analytics within the CPG, food, or manufacturing industries
* Proven ability to manage the end\-to\-end lifecycle of data products, from vision and roadmap through delivery and adoption
* Strong understanding of data architecture, quality, metadata, and governance, with the ability to connect technical design to business value and apply modern data product concepts (e.g. data mesh)
* Demonstrated success working in Agile environments, collaborating with cross\-functional teams including Data Engineering, IT, and business stakeholders
* Solid business acumen and communication skills, with experience quantifying data product value and driving data adoption across functions


 Interpersonal Skills \- leadership, interactions, communication, influence
   

  

 Strategic thinking skills are essential to develop data products that create business value and support key business objectives and strategies. By connecting business context with technical execution, the role balances competing needs, prioritizes product backlogs, and ensures successful delivery of data products that achieve business objectives while driving accountability for data quality, governance, and adoption within an Agile, iterative environment.
   

  

 Influencing and collaboration skills are critical to align diverse stakeholders and advance McCormick’s enterprise data and governance strategy. The Data Product Owner builds trusted relationships across multiple functions including RDQR, Transformation \& Technology, and Global Business Solutions, leading through influence and collaboration to deliver data products that meet evolving business needs.
   

  

 Communication skills are required to articulate data product vision, value, and progress in a clear and compelling way. The role tailors messages to different audiences, ensuring complex ideas are conveyed with clarity and purpose. Active listening, transparency, and structured communication are used to align expectations, secure engagement, and reinforce accountability for trusted, high‑value data products.
   

  

 At McCormick, we have over a 100\-year legacy based on our “Power of People” principle. This principle fosters an unusually dedicated workforce requiring a culture of respect, recognition, inclusion and collaboration based on the highest ethical value

title: Risk Analytics - Product Analyst - Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY GDS \- Delivery Excellence Senior position**
 Within last decade, cost of delivery and Delivery excellence has become the most critical factors to run successful and popular businesses spread around the globe. To support such a dynamic and fast paced IT transformation industry, we are using various cutting\-edge Delivery Excellence models and tools with relentless focus on automation to offer best in class and tailor\-made solutions to our clients.
   

  

 As a part of our global team you will be part of GDS projects as Delivery Excellence management professional. You will be involved in working on challenging problems and creating next generation delivery excellence platforms.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 Are you a detail driven professional with a passion for translating business needs into impactful product experiences? Do you thrive at the intersection of people, process, and technology? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you to join our Product team and help shape solutions that deliver real value to our clients and users.
   

  

 In this role, you’ll serve as a critical bridge between the business stakeholders and the development and engineering teams. Your work will influence how ideas become features, how features become products, and how products deliver meaningful outcomes in a fast paced, evolving environment.
   

  

 As a key member of the Product team, you will play a hands on role in defining business requirements, crafting user stories, and ensuring that technical execution aligns seamlessly with business objectives. You will lead user acceptance testing (UAT), drive iterative testing cycles, validate enhancements, and ensure that issues or defects are accurately identified, tracked, and resolved. Your keen eye for detail and strong communication skills will help ensure that every release meets the highest standards of quality and functionality.
   

  

 This is a client facing and user centric role where you will engage with stakeholders, address queries, clarify requirements, and ensure that feedback is incorporated into continuous product improvements. You’ll gain a deep understanding of real world user behaviors, business processes, and product journeys—making this the perfect place to grow as a product focused business professional while driving meaningful impact across the product lifecycle.
   

  

 If you’re energized by the opportunity to influence product development end to end, collaborate with cross functional teams, and help bring scalable, user friendly solutions to life, this role provides the platform for you to make a lasting difference.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements, ensuring alignment across stakeholders, product managers, and engineering teams.
* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by testing the defined test cases, validating functionality, and ensuring readiness for release.
* Support in iterative testing cycles, identifying defects, documenting issues, validating fixes, and performing regression testing as needed.
* Responsible for decision\-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.
* Serve as one of the primary liaison between business teams and engineering, providing clarifications, resolving requirement gaps, and ensuring shared understanding throughout the product lifecycle.
* Review and validate bug fixes, ensuring that resolved issues meet expected outcomes before closure.
* Engage with clients and end users, addressing queries, troubleshooting issues, and gathering feedback for continuous improvement.
* Support product rollout activities, including release planning, communication, and training support where required.
* Monitor product performance post release, identify enhancement opportunities, and contribute to backlog prioritization.
* Maintain comprehensive documentation including requirement specifications, UAT plans, test results, and user feedback logs.
* Support product strategy, roadmap planning, and end\-to\-end product lifecycle management for Internal Controls and Audit solutions.
* Partner with stakeholders across business, risk, audit, and technology teams to gather requirements and drive product adoption.
* Own MIS, reporting, KPI tracking, and executive dashboards to measure product performance and business outcomes.
* Analyse large datasets to derive insights, identify control gaps, and support decision\-making.
* Drive product implementation, rollout, user onboarding, and change management initiatives.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to define functional requirements and prioritise product backlogs.
* Identify automation and AI opportunities to enhance audit and internal control processes.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Risk Assessment – Assessment of internal processes to identify findings, vulnerabilities, and control gaps/deviations identified across applications and infrastructure.
* Control Monitoring / Testing \- Understanding of controls around Business processes, ITGC, Cyber, Data protection and privacy to perform testing of design and operational effectiveness of controls.
* Ability to create process documentation.
* Ability to understand business problems in Risk/Finance and contribute to translating them into solution or product requirements.
* Exposure (through projects or roles) to Risk, Finance, Supply Chain Operations (SCO), or related business functions preferred.
* Demonstrates interest in AI/analytics\-driven Risk solutions and their business applications.
* Agentic AI architecture\- Design agentic AI system architectures and define associated technical guardrails.
* Functional understanding of foundation models (LLMs) and associated risks. Awareness of the AI deployment lifecycle
* Control Automation – Identify automation opportunities using analytics platform to monitor the operational effectiveness on the regular basis.
* Basic exposure to Presales, solutioning, proposal support, or client presentations is a plus.
* Interest in working in tech\-enabled or AI\-led Risk products/solutions environment.
* Ability to support senior team members in product development, go\-to\-market efforts, and client engagements.
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with business delivery teams.
* Analytical thinking.
* Strong team\-player and self\-started attitude.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, global delivery environment with distributed teams.
* Well organized, attentive to details attitude.
* Open to hiring across locations, aligned with EY’s Global Delivery Services (GDS) model.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Overall 3\-6 years of experience in Risk Advisory (preferably Internal Controls) experience with Big 4 or comparable professional services environment
* CA or Master’s degree in Business Administration or Risk management
* Good to have certifications – CISA, CISM, CIA, AIGP, ISO 42001, CISSP, CRISC, CCSK, ISO 27001, and others (as relevant)
* Any 1 hard tech skill is a must – Either Python or Databricks Or full stack or AI
* Product Management experience with demonstrated ownership of delivering business solutions.
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
* Experience in reporting, MIS, analytics, and data\-driven decision making.
* Hands\-on experience in product implementation and deployment.
* Domain expertise in Internal Controls, Risk, Compliance, or Audit (mandatory).


**What We Look For**
* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team of 250\+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Analyst/Sr. Analyst - Risk Management
description:
**Job Description**
 Credit and Fraud Risk (CFR) team helps drive profitable business growth by reducing the risk of fraud and maintaining industry lowest credit loss rates. It uses an array of tools and ever\-evolving technology to detect and combat fraud, minimize the disruption of good spending, and provide a world\-class customer experience. The team leads efforts that leverage data and digital advancements to improve risk management as well as enable commerce and drive innovation.
   

  

 A single decision can have many outcomes. And when that decision affects millions of customers, it needs to be the right one. That’s where our Credit \& Fraud Risk (CFR) Analytics \& Data Science CoE team comes in. The team leads efforts that leverage data and digital advancements to improve risk management as well as enable commerce and drive innovation, every day. Right from targeting the right customer for our products to underwriting them to managing their experience with Amex when they get onboarded, every decision is advised by groundbreaking analytics \& data science. We help the company grow its business profitably while delivering the world's best customer experience, all powered by data. We are the backbone of all financial services operations at American Express and impact every aspect of the company.
   

  

 As a part of the team, you’ll have the opportunity to work in one of the best companies for data scientists in the country. You will solve real world business problems while getting exposure to the industry’s top leaders in analytics, data science and machine learning. If you’re passionate about solving complex problems and crafting solutions that impact millions, you should consider a career in CFR.
   

  

**Description On The Role**
 Development, review and/or execution of economic logic \& analytical solutions to drive profitable credit business actions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Understand the core business of AXP and the levers behind various decisions
* Analyze large amounts of data to derive business insights and create innovative solutions
* Leverage the power of closed loop through Amex network to make decisions more intelligent and relevant
* Innovate with a focus on developing newer and better approaches using big data \& machine learning solution
* Clear articulation and structuring of business findings across prospect and customer domain to the leadership and key partners
* Maintain external lens and be aware of developments in the field of Finance/Payments/Analytics etc.


**Qualifications**
**Minimum Qualifications**

description:

 Coro is Bain’s persistent product development and engineering organization serving the firm’s digital solutions across Commercial Excellence (B2B) and the newly established Demand Generation Suite (B2C). Coro brings together technology, data, and services to build and operate proprietary solutions that create differentiated value for Bain’s clients and case teams.
 





 This role sits within the newly established B2C pillar of Coro, building the technical foundation for Artemis – Bain’s AI\-driven marketing and commercial investment allocation platform, and one of three products in the Demand Generation Suite.
 




  






**WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM** 






 The Software Engineer role is a full stack engineering position focused on building and maintaining product features across the Artemis backend (Python/FastAPI) and frontend (React/TypeScript). Engineers in this role contribute to platform capabilities used by consultants and clients in live engagements, working within established patterns and with guidance from senior team members. Contributions span both the API layer and the React components that surface those capabilities to users — including the marketing mix model configuration interface, channel allocation dashboards, scenario planning tools, and client\-ready output views.
 





 This is a delivery\-focused role for engineers who are ready to contribute meaningfully across the full stack and grow their ownership over time. The core expectation is shipping well\-tested features within defined specifications, collaborating closely with senior engineers, and developing the habits and judgment that come with working in a production product environment. Additional responsibilities include participating in support and operations by identifying system defects, contributing to troubleshooting efforts, and supporting code deployments.
 




  






**WHAT YOU’LL DO** 





 Feature Development
 
* Implement features across backend API logic and React frontend components for assigned Artemis product areas, working from clear specifications and with guidance from senior engineers. Contribute to taking features from development through testing and deployment across both layers.
* Build and maintain backend routes for assigned product areas, following established patterns for request/response contracts, versioning, and testing. Keep TypeScript type contracts on the frontend in sync with backend changes.



 Frontend and Data Visualization 
 
* Build and maintain React components using the shared Demand Generation Suite design system, contributing to marketing analytics interfaces including channel allocation dashboards, scenario comparison views, and model configuration workflows. Follow established component and styling conventions.
* Write database queries and data access logic for Artemis data models, following existing schema and migration patterns. Develop familiarity with the data volumes and access patterns typical of marketing analytics engagements.



 Quality and Collaboration
 
* Write and maintain tests for backend and frontend code. Ensure new features ship with adequate coverage and do not degrade existing functionality, with support from senior engineers on testing strategy.
* Participate in structured feedback sessions with Artemis Expert Consultants and go\-to\-market\-aligned specialists. Contribute observations and help translate feedback into concrete improvements in subsequent sprints.
* Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively across the team and with adjacent stakeholders.



 Innovation \& Emerging Technologies
 
* Drive innovation through out\-of\-the\-box thinking to solve critical business challenges and demands.
* Participate in technical discovery, POCs, and innovation workstreams to validate new tools, technologies, and designs.
* Investigate and keep up\-to\-date on emerging data, AI, and agentic technologies and trends; lead knowledge sharing.
* Entrepreneurial spirit, willing to try new approaches.



  






**ABOUT YOU** 





 Technical
 
* Proficient in Python for backend development, with exposure to or interest in async frameworks (FastAPI or equivalent). Able to implement features within an established codebase and framework.
* Proficient in React and TypeScript in a production or near\-production context, with foundational understanding of state management patterns, data fetching, and TypeScript type safety.
* Familiarity with CSS and comfort working within component libraries and design systems, following established conventions rather than authoring them from scratch.
* Working knowledge of relational databases: writing SQL queries, reading and modifying schemas, and debugging query issues.
* Exposure to data visualization libraries for building chart\-based interfaces is a plus.
* Experience contributing to time and cost estimates of product enhancements, advise on trade\-offs of features.
* Familiarity with AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex) to support and accelerate development workflows.
* Results\-driven, with an analytical and collaborative mindset. Eager to learn and grow in a fast\-paced Agile environment.



 Education
 
* Associate/Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience.



 Experience
 
* 2\-3\+ years of experience building full\-stack web applications.


* Track record of delivering in an Agile environment.
* Experience with troubleshooting and issue resolution skills.
* Experience building web interfaces for data\-heavy or analytics applications, where outputs are used by business users to make commercial decisions, highly preferred.
* Exposure to marketing, media, or commercial data (such as spend, sales, or campaign performance) in any context, including academic or side projects, is a plus.

title: Data Quality Specialist
description:
**About Us**
 Join us at Orange Business!
   

  

 We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.
   

  

 Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The ‘Data Quality Specialist’ will play a crucial role in ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and quality of our organization’s master data. He/She will be responsible for analyzing and interpreting complex data sets, identify trends, defining KPI’s and provide actionable insights to support data\-driven decision\-making. He/She will leverage skills in statistical analysis, SQL, PLSQL, Advanced Excel, Power BI to drive insights and improvements in data quality and usability.
   

  

 Data Quality Management:
   

  

* Ensure data quality by analyzing, profiling, and monitoring data to identify and resolve data quality issues.
* Develop and implement data quality standards, policies, and procedures.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to establish data quality metrics and targets.


 Data Governance:
   

  

* This role will interface with data governance frameworks, processes, and controls.
* Define data quality rules, data lineage, and data classification.
* Ensure compliance with data governance policies and regulations. Data Analysis and Reporting:
* Perform data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies.
* Generate data quality reports and dashboards to communicate findings and insights.
* Provide recommendations and action plans to improve data quality.


 Stakeholder Collaboration:
   

  

* Collaborate with Data Quality, Data governance, business users, data owners, and IT teams etc. to understand data requirements and resolve data quality.
* Provide guidance and support to stakeholders on data quality best practices.
* Conduct training and awareness sessions on master data quality management.


 Continuous Improvement:
   

  

* Continuously enhance personal knowledge and skills in data quality management through training, certifications, and staying updated with industry advancements, contributing to ongoing improvement efforts.


**About You**
 Education: A bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as computer science, information systems, statistics, or mathematics is often preferred.
   

  

 Preference to Professional certification in data analytics e.g., CompTIA Data\+, Power BI Data Analyst Associate, SQL, PLSQL, MS Excel.
   

  

 With minimum 3 years of relevant experience.
   

  

 Proven experience in analyzing and interpreting complex data sets, identifying data quality issues, and proposing solutions.
   

  

 Strong communication skills and experience in collaborating with cross\-functional teams, documenting data quality issues and presenting findings to stakeholders.
   

  

 Proven ability to identify data quality problems, investigate root causes, and implement corrective actions.
   

  

 Understanding of data management principles, master data, data quality frameworks and data governance practices .
   

  

 Proficiency in analyzing and interpreting complex data sets, identifying patterns, and drawing meaningful insights.
   

  

 Ability to query databases, to extract and manipulate data for quality assessment.
   

  

 Ability to think analytically and critically to solve complex data quality problems.
   

  

 Willingness to stay updated with emerging trends and technologies in data quality management.
   

  

 Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
   

  

 You bring a can\-do attitude, tackle challenges head\-on and challenge the status quo with new and innovative ideas.
   

  

**What We Offer**
* Global Opportunities: Work in multi\-national teams with opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and customers from all over the world.
* Flexible Work Environment: Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working).
* Professional Development: training programs and upskilling/re\-skilling opportunities.
* Career Growth: Internal growth and mobility opportunities within Orange.
* Caring and Daring Culture: Health and well\-being programs and benefits, diversity \& inclusion initiatives, CSR and employee connect events.
* Reward Programs: Employee Referral Program, Change Maker Awards.


**Only Your Skills Matter**
 Regardless of your age, gender identity, race, ethnic origin, religion/belief, sexual orientation, marital status, neuroatypia, disability, veteran status or appearance, we encourage diversity within our teams because it is a strength for the collective and a vector of innovation. Orange Group is a disabled\-friendly company and equal opportunity employer: don't hesitate to tell us about your specific needs.

title: Senior Product Analyst
description:
**About dunnhumby**
 dunnhumby is the global leader in Customer Data Science, helping the world's most ambitious retailers and brands put the customer at the heart of every decision. With nearly 3,000 experts across Europe, Asia, Africa and the Americas, we partner with iconic businesses like Tesco, Coca\-Cola, Meijer, Procter \& Gamble and Metro to turn data into growth, innovation and measurable value for their customers.
   

  

**Product**
 Our Product team owns the vision, strategy and roadmap for the dunnhumby platform — the data, science and software that powers retailers and brands around the world. We work at the intersection of customer data, AI, and commercial impact, building products that turn insight into measurable growth.
   

  

**The Role**
 The Senior Product Analyst plays a key role in helping us build better products through data\-driven decision making. Working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Designers and Data Engineers, you'll transform complex product data into actionable insights that shape product strategy, improve user experiences and drive measurable business outcomes.
   

  

 You'll champion product analytics across our product teams, enabling experimentation, establishing best practices and ensuring decisions are backed by meaningful data.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
 You'll combine analytical expertise, product knowledge and stakeholder collaboration to deliver insights that influence product direction and maximise customer value.
   

  

* Own product analytics across a portfolio of products, defining key metrics and ensuring they are measured, reported and understood effectively
* Partner with Product Managers, Engineering Managers and Product Designers to support product strategy, objectives and key results (OKRs)
* Identify opportunities to improve product performance through data analysis, experimentation and evidence\-based recommendations
* Work closely with Data Engineers and product squads to ensure the right data is captured, modelled and available for meaningful analysis
* Deliver end\-to\-end analytics, from defining requirements and success metrics through to presenting insights and recommendations to stakeholders
* Build, maintain and continuously improve product performance dashboards that provide clear, actionable visibility into product health
* Support product discovery, roadmap planning and experimentation by providing data\-driven insights and commercial context
* Leverage multiple data sources to identify trends, answer business questions and uncover new opportunities for product improvement
* Continuously improve analytics practices, reporting tools, data visualisation and automation to enable faster, more effective decision making
* Communicate insights clearly through compelling data visualisation and storytelling tailored to technical and non\-technical audiences


**What We're Looking For**
 You'll bring strong analytical capability, curiosity and a passion for using data to solve product challenges while collaborating with cross\-functional teams.
   

  

* Experience in product analytics, product management, product ownership or a similar analytics\-focused role within a software or technology environment
* Strong analytical skills with experience interpreting complex data and translating findings into actionable business recommendations
* Experience working with cross\-functional product teams, including Product Managers, Engineers, Designers and Data Engineers
* Knowledge of product metrics, experimentation, performance measurement and product analytics best practices
* Experience building dashboards and communicating insights through effective data visualisation and storytelling
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence decision making through data

 We won't just meet your expectations. We'll defy them. So you'll enjoy the comprehensive rewards package you'd expect from a leading technology company. But also, a degree of personal flexibility you might not expect. Plus, thoughtful perks, like flexible working hours and your birthday off.
   

  

 And we don't just talk about diversity and inclusion. * Lifestyle \& Flexibility: Office commute support, internet allowance of INR 2,000 per month for blended working, work\-from\-home kit support, subsidised food, and wellbeing resources.
* Recognition \& Extras: Long service awards, Talent Scout referral programme, and family milestone support.
* Time Off \& Family Leave: 25 days holiday plus 10 public holidays, paid maternity, paternity and adoption leave, and a day off for your birthday.


**Our approach to Flexible Working**
 At dunnhumby, we value and respect difference and are committed to building an inclusive culture by creating an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work.

title: Senior Associate - Consumer & Retail Consulting
description:
**Job Title: Senior Associate \- Consumer \& Retail Consulting** 




  





 Location: Gurgaon, Haryana, India
 



 Experience: 4–8 years
 



  





**About the Company** 




 Alvarez \& Marsal is a global professional services firm helping organizations tackle complex business issues, improve operating performance and maximize stakeholder value. Founded in 1983, A\&M is known for practical, action\-oriented advisory, business performance improvement, turnaround management and interim leadership services across industries and geographies. Its professionals combine independent thinking, deep expertise and an operator mindset to deliver measurable results for clients. The India Global Capability Center partners with A\&M leadership and case teams across the Americas, EMEA and APAC, supporting end\-to\-end client delivery, thought leadership, digital enablement and analytics. The Consumer and Retail Group works with companies across consumer products and retail to address disruption, strengthen performance and create growth. A\&M’s culture is guided by integrity, quality, objectivity, fun, personal reward and inclusive diversity, with founding principles centered on leadership, action and results.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 As a Senior Associate in the Consumer \& Retail Group, you will own medium\-to\-complex workstreams across corporate transformation and performance improvement engagements. You will translate ambiguous client questions and operational data into fact\-based insights, practical recommendations and measurable actions across consumer products and retail. Working in a flat team with Managers, Directors and senior clients, you will lead analyses, manage key stakeholder relationships and help deliver outcomes across market assessment, growth strategy, supply chain, pricing, merchandising, store operations and financial performance. The role combines analytical depth with commercial judgment, clear communication and hands\-on execution. You will also contribute to pitches, thought leadership, capability building and mentoring, while working onsite from Gurgaon and remaining open to business travel and potential future relocation within the India capability center.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own medium\-to\-complex workstreams from problem definition through client\-ready output, using structured analysis to identify performance gaps and convert findings into practical transformation actions.
* Develop Consumer and Retail solutions across consumer products and retail sectors, connecting market, operational and financial metrics to growth strategy, value creation and improved client performance.
* Analyze and benchmark data across supply chain, inventory planning, pricing, merchandising, digital, brand assessment, G\&A and store operations to surface underperformance and prioritize interventions.
* Lead client and internal stakeholder interactions by clarifying requirements, communicating insights and explaining business impact to senior CRG clients, A\&M leaders and third parties.
* Build accurate models, dashboards and presentations using Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx or Python to support timely decisions and zero\-defect deliverables.
* Manage milestones, dependencies and competing priorities under pressure, while collaborating with team members to deliver agreed outputs and maintain momentum across projects.
* Support A\&M growth through pitch development, marketing, innovative offering development, recruiting, training and mentoring Analysts and Associates.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Strong Consumer Products and Retail expertise, including sector data and metrics across supply chain, inventory planning, pricing, merchandising, digital, brand assessment, G\&A and store operations.
* Demonstrated experience in strategy, analytics, operational consulting or transformation, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems and deliver fact\-based recommendations that influence client decisions.
* Advanced Excel modelling and analytical skills, including organizing complex data to draw conclusions, test scenarios and support timely operational and financial decision\-making.
* Strong PowerPoint capability, with a track record of creating clear, persuasive and defect\-free presentations for senior clients, leadership teams and business development discussions.
* Working proficiency in Power BI or Tableau for data visualization and Alteryx or Python for data analysis, with the judgment to select appropriate tools for each problem.
* Excellent written, verbal, research and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate difficult messages with integrity and explain analytical impact to varied stakeholders.
* Practical leadership, prioritization and teamwork skills, including mentoring junior colleagues, motivating teams and delivering high\-quality work in pressured environments.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Experience across multiple Consumer Products or Retail subsectors, such as Food and Beverage, Personal Care, Household Goods, Health and Wellness, Electronics, Grocery, Apparel or E\-Commerce.
* Exposure to corporate transformation, performance improvement, operating model change or financial enhancement programs in a consulting or industry setting.
* Interest in developing thought leadership, new offerings and client relationships within a growing global Consumer and Retail practice.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* A graduate degree from a strong institution and 4–8 years of relevant experience, including 3–6 years of post\-MBA experience in strategy, analytics, operational consulting or a comparable transformation environment.
* A commercially minded Consumer and Retail problem solver who understands how industry metrics connect across growth, operations, customer experience and financial performance.
* An entrepreneurial, self\-starting approach: you are comfortable with ambiguity, require limited direction, challenge the status quo and take ownership through to measurable client outcomes.
* The communication, judgment and integrity to lead workstreams, mentor Analysts and Associates, influence senior stakeholders and deliver messages clearly even when they are difficult to hear.



  





**Why Join Us** 




 You will join a rapidly growing Consumer and Retail team where your work directly shapes high\-impact transformation programs for global clients. The role offers exposure across the full project life cycle, from market analysis and growth strategy through operational improvement and financial performance enhancement. You will work closely with Managers, Directors and senior client stakeholders in a flat structure that rewards ownership, sound judgment and practical execution. A\&M’s entrepreneurial culture gives high\-performing professionals early responsibility and the opportunity to influence both client outcomes and the growth of the practice. You will deepen your expertise across consumer products and retail subsectors while contributing to pitches, thought leadership, new offerings and capability building. The India Global Capability Center connects you to colleagues and case teams across the Americas, EMEA and APAC, creating a genuinely global platform for learning and impact. Development is supported through mentorship, formal training, performance feedback, on\-the\-job learning and internal mobility. Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits accompany a culture that values integrity, inclusion, personal growth and results.
 



  





**What We Offer** 



* Direct exposure to senior A\&M leaders, global case teams and client stakeholders, with meaningful ownership of workstreams and visible influence on transformation outcomes.
* Structured professional development through mentorship, performance feedback, formal training, on\-the\-job learning and opportunities to build expertise across Consumer and Retail sectors.
* A collaborative, entrepreneurial environment with competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, well\-being resources, inclusive diversity initiatives and opportunities to contribute beyond client delivery.

description:

Day in and day out, we propel some of the biggest brands in the world to the intersection of attention and culture. * You will translate this into constructed queries and research or report plan that will monitor the social conversation for clients’ brands, competitive brands, Influencers, programs, products, marketing campaigns, and events.

**Trend Spotting**

* You will be responsible for owning methodology and collecting trend sources for your market and create a semi\-automated workflow that can pickup daily social triggers


**THE TASK AT HAND**
* Consult stakeholders on topic definitions, social listening measures and filters to define objectives and set deliverables for standard and custom reports.
* Implement social analysis for campaigns/events and present insights back to inform content /Media decisions for campaign/event activities and advise on actions to take from optimizations standpoint.

* At times be the direct client contact for regional projects and coordinate work amongst junior analysts
* Manage a deliverable calendar of recurring scheduled and ad hoc reports.
* Good housekeeping \- upkeep of shared calendars and the storage of report agreement documents and delivered reports.


**Qualifications**
* Professional Experience: 3–4 years in social media marketing, social media analytics, measurements, social listening, or community management.
* Analytics Expertise: Minimum 2 years of experience deeply embedded in online/social analytics.
* Social Listening: Relevant experience building complex queries and pulling data from platforms such as Sprinklr, Brandwatch, or Pulsar.
* Data Infrastructure \& Visualization: Proven ability to work within Snowflake and Tableau to design, build, and maintain automated reporting dashboards.
* Technical Foundations: Foundational understanding of SQL and cloud data warehousing architecture to efficiently query, structure, and manipulate data streams.
* Data Storytelling: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to synthesize complex data points into concise, high\-impact cultural stories.
* Interpersonal Skills: A strong mix of technical understanding, sharp business sense, and experience handling client communications.
* Platform Fluency: Deep understanding of global and regional social media platforms, including YouTube, Instagram, X/Twitter, Facebook, TikTok, and chat applications.


**What You Should Know About VaynerMedia**
 Think “lab” and not “agency”. We get excited about solving business problems, not creating advertising for the sake of making advertising. Our entrepreneurship DNA runs deep. We’re willing to break rules, try new things, and test hypotheses if it means better understanding our craft. It’s fun!
   

  

 Our environment (and pace) feels much more like a start\-up than most agencies you might be used to. Hopefully that, and the opportunity to collaborate with the talented and enthusiastic crew, work with big brands excites you, as it does us.
 **We can’t wait to meet you.**

 We are looking for strong early\-career talent first. Based on your aptitude, interests and demonstrated capability, you may work across:
 



  





 • AI \& Generative AI

 • Data Engineering

 • Generative AI and AI applications
 



 • LLMs, RAG and AI agents

 • Internal technology products

 We are more interested in your ability to learn, think, solve problems and build.
 



  





**WHO SHOULD APPLY** 




  





 Please apply if you:
 



 • Have completed B.Tech / B.E. / BCA / MCA
 



 • Are a fresher or recent graduate
 



 • Want to build a serious career in technology
 



 • Have basic programming knowledge
 



 • Are comfortable learning new technologies
 



 • Enjoy solving problems
 



 • Can learn independently
 



 • Are willing to work across technologies rather than restricting yourself to one stack
 



 • Are available for full\-time employment
 



 • Are willing to work on\-site in Gurugram
 



 • Are comfortable working in a lean, fast\-moving technology company
 



  





**WHAT WILL MAKE YOU STAND OUT** 




 We care more about what you have tried to build than how many certificates you have collected.
 



 It could be:
 



  





 • A college project
 



 • A website or web application
 



 • A MERN application
 



 • A Python application
 



 • An AI chatbot or AI agent
 



 • A Data or Analytics project
 



 • An API integration
 



 • An automation workflow
 



 • A dashboard
 



 • A cloud project
 



 • A GitHub repository
 



 • Any technology prototype you built yourself

 • What did you build?
 



 • What part did you personally work on?
 



 • What problems did you face?
 



 • How did you solve them?
 



 • What did you learn?
 



  





  





**WHAT WE LOOK FOR** 




  





 Learning Ability
 



 Can you understand something unfamiliar and start working with it?

 Can you break an unfamiliar problem into smaller pieces and work towards a solution?
 



  





 Curiosity
 



 Do you explore technology beyond your college curriculum?

 Do you actually build things rather than only completing courses and certifications?

 POSSIBLE TECHNOLOGY TRACKS

 • Full Stack / MERN

description:
**About noon** 




 We’re building an ecosystem of digital products and services that power everyday life across the Middle East—fast, scalable, and deeply customer\-centric. Our mission is to deliver to every door every day. We want to redefine what technology can do in this region, and we’re looking for a CRM Manager who can help us move even faster.
 



  





**noon’s mission: Every door, every day.** 




  





**About Dubai Mall** 




 The Dubai Mall Online is the official digital platform of Dubai Mall, bringing together the mall’s iconic retail brands into a single online shopping destination. Powered by best\-in\-class e\-commerce technology, logistics, and customer experience capabilities, the platform enables customers to discover, shop, and receive products from multiple Dubai Mall retailers through a seamless digital journey.
 



  





 Joining The Dubai Mall Online offers a unique opportunity to help build and scale a high\-growth business from the ground up, working alongside some of the world’s most recognized brands while shaping the future of omnichannel retail in the GCC.
 



  





**What you'll do:** 




 As the CRM Manager for Dubai Mall Online, you will own the end\-to\-end lifecycle retention strategy, automated customer journeys, and multi\-channel engagement across App Push, WhatsApp, Email, and SMS. You will be working closely with the growth, product, and commercial teams to build and optimize scalable retention funnels designed to drive first\-order conversion, repeat purchase frequency, and long\-term Customer Lifetime Value (LTV). You will be responsible for operationalizing our CRM stack from scratch.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Own Lifecycle Automation \& Funnel Build:** 
 Build and optimize automated customer journeys including Welcome, Onboarding, Cart/Search Abandonment, Post\-Purchase, and Win\-back flows.
* **Analytics Partnership \& Cohort Setup:** 
 Work with Analytics to build and operationalize customer cohorts, RFM segments, and behavioral triggers.
* **WhatsApp WABA Governance \& Tier Ramp:** 
 Manage WhatsApp Business API operations, including Meta template approvals, display\-name verification, and messaging\-volume tier growth.
* **Arabic Journey Execution:** 
 Deliver fully localized English and Arabic CRM communications, including RTL\-compliant copy, offers, and timing.
* **Internal Messaging Tool Governance:** 
 Manage campaign scheduling, audience rules, templates, and delivery health across internal email and push platforms.
* **Wallet \& Cashback Communications:** 
 Own customer communications related to wallet balances, cashback, credits, return windows, and promotional incentives.
* **Cross\-Ecosystem \& Community Broadcasts:** 
 Coordinate strategic audience campaigns with noon Growth teams and Emaar stakeholders across relevant customer databases and channels.
* **Data Hygiene \& PDPL Compliance:** 
 Ensure compliant opt\-ins, unsubscribe processes, customer\-data synchronization, and database hygiene under UAE PDPL.
* **A/B Testing \& LTV Optimization:** 
 Establish continuous testing across timing, channels, messaging, personalization, and recommendations to improve engagement and repeat purchases.
* **Analytics \& Retention Reporting:** 
 Build daily and weekly reports covering customer cohorts, repeat orders, channel performance, deliverability, and uninstalls for Growth leadership.



  





**What you’ll need** 



* **5\+ years of CRM/lifecycle marketing experience** 
 , ideally within mobile\-first e\-commerce, marketplaces, or digital consumer platforms.
* **Strong hands\-on experience with messaging platforms** 
 , including building customer cohorts, RFM segments, and behavioral triggers in partnership with Analytics teams.
* **Expertise in WhatsApp Business API (WABA)** 
 , including Meta template approvals, display\-name verification, and messaging\-volume tier management.
* **Strong understanding of data privacy and compliance** 
 , particularly UAE PDPL or GDPR, including opt\-in/opt\-out processes and customer\-data hygiene.
* **Exceptional attention to detail** 
 with a strong focus on accurate customer\-facing copy, links, audience rules, and trigger timing.
* **Entrepreneurial, high\-ownership mindset** 
 , with the ability to build CRM frameworks, campaign calendars, lifecycle journeys, and experimentation roadmaps from scratch.
* **Professional fluency in English** 
 ; Arabic reading/writing or prior GCC market experience is a strong advantage.



  





**Who will excel?** 



* We’re looking for people with high standards, who understand that hard work matters.
* You need to be relentlessly resourceful and operate with a deep bias for action.
* We need people with the courage to be fiercely original.
* noon is not for everyone; readiness to adapt, pivot, and learn is essential.

title: Manager- Digital
description:
**About Urban Company :** 




  





 Urban Company is a technology platform offering customers a variety of services at home. Customers use our platform to book services such as beauty treatments, haircuts, massage therapy, cleaning, plumbing, carpentry, appliance repair, painting etc., all delivered in the comfort of their home and at a time of their choosing. We promise our customers a high\-quality, standardized and reliable service experience. To fulfill this promise, we work closely with our hand\-picked service partners, enabling them with technology, training, products, tools, financing, insurance, and brand, helping them succeed and deliver on this promise.
 



  





 Urban Company started out as UrbanClap in Nov 2014, when its founders, Abhiraj, Raghav and Varun realized that the home services industry was predominantly unorganized, fragmented and offline. Customers found it difficult to avail quality services in a convenient manner, and service professionals were struggling to make ends meet, having to rely upon several middlemen, contractors, and local aggregators. The founders felt that the industry was ripe for disruption, and launched Urban Company, with three key principles in mind \-
 


* Customer love: Build a platform that offers truly delightful and differentiated services
* Partner empowerment: Build a deep, full\-stack partnership with service partners, helping improve their earnings and overall livelihood
* Technology first: Bring innovation and technology to an age\-old industry.



  





**About the job :** 




  





 Urban Company is India's largest tech\-enabled home services marketplace — operating at scale across cleaning, beauty, wellness, and home maintenance. We're looking for a performance marketer who lives in the bottom of the funnel: someone obsessed with converting high\-intent users into first\-time customers, squeezing CAC, and scaling what works. This role owns UC's paid acquisition engine across Search and Social — the channels that drive real installs and first bookings.
 



  





**What you'll own** 



* **Paid Social (Meta):** 
 Run performance\-first Meta campaigns — conversion campaigns, app install campaigns, and dynamic product ads — optimising for CPO and install\-to\-booking rate, not just clicks.
* **UAC / App campaigns:** 
 Manage Google UAC and Meta App Campaigns to drive new installs from high\-intent audiences; optimise in\-app event bidding toward first booking as the conversion goal.
* **Paid Search (SEM):** 
 Own Google Search and PMax campaigns end\-to\-end — keyword strategy, match types, bid management, Quality Score optimisation, and ad copy testing — with a relentless focus on driving high\-intent traffic that converts to first bookings.
* **CAC \& efficiency management:** 
 Set and manage CAC targets by channel and category; build spend pacing models to maximise new user volume within efficiency guardrails.
* **Audience \& targeting:** 
 Build high\-intent audience segments using keyword intent signals, platform behavioural data, and first\-party CRM lists; run retargeting flows to recapture drop\-offs in the install\-to\-booking funnel.
* **Landing page \& conversion optimisation:** 
 Partner with product to identify and fix conversion bottlenecks between ad click → app install → first booking; brief and test landing page variants to improve post\-click CVR.
* **Attribution \& MMP management:** 
 Own AppsFlyer/Adjust setup — campaign tagging, event mapping, cohort reporting, and fraud monitoring — to ensure clean, accurate new user attribution across channels.
* **Creative for performance:** 
 Brief and iterate on direct\-response creatives (static, carousel, search copy); run structured A/B tests on offers, CTAs, and formats; kill what doesn't convert fast.
* **Reporting \& forecasting:** 
 Maintain weekly performance dashboards (CPO, ROAS, install\-to\-booking rate, CAC by channel); build forward\-looking acquisition forecasts tied to spend scenarios.



  





**What we're looking for** 



* 3–5 years of hands\-on performance marketing experience at a consumer internet company, D2C brand, or digital agency — with a clear track record of driving new user/customer acquisition through paid Search and Social.
* Deep hands\-on expertise in Google Ads (UAC, Search, PMax) and Meta Ads Manager (conversion campaigns, app installs, dynamic ads).
* Strong command of bottom\-funnel metrics: CAC, CPO, CPI, ROAS, install\-to\-booking rate, first\-order conversion rate, and payback period.
* Experience managing MMP platforms (AppsFlyer or Adjust) — event setup, attribution windows, cohort analysis, and fraud detection.
* Analytically strong: able to build CAC forecasts and channel mix models in Excel/Google Sheets; SQL is a strong plus.
* Bias for action: comfortable making fast, data\-backed decisions on bids, budgets, and creative — without waiting for perfect information.
* Graduation from a Tier 1/2 institute.



  





**Why join Urban Company** 




 This is a high\-ownership role at the sharp end of UC's growth. You'll have real budget, real data, and real accountability for new user numbers — with the cross\-functional support to move fast. If you're a performance marketer who wants to own outcomes rather than manage reports, this is your seat.
 



*Urban Company is committed to equal and fair opportunities in employment and an inclusive, harassment\-free work environment for all.*

* Design storage tiering and archival strategies that transition inactive data to cost\-effective storage while maintaining recoverability and compliance.
* Serve as the primary escalation point and subject matter expert for enterprise data archiving and retention matters.
* Partner with Legal, Privacy, Compliance, and business stakeholders to translate regulatory requirements into practical governance controls.

* Experience working with SAP RISE with S/4HANA or comparable SAP cloud\-managed service environments.
* Understanding of shared responsibility models associated with SAP cloud services and ILM operations.
* Knowledge of Databricks technologies including Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, VACUUM operations, and data lifecycle management concepts.
* Experience developing and operationalizing enterprise\-wide data retention policies across multiple business domains and jurisdictions.
* Knowledge of storage tiering strategies and archival storage solutions.
* Strong understanding of global regulatory and compliance requirements, including GDPR, CCPA, PIPEDA, SOX, tax retention requirements, and related regulations.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills across technical, legal, compliance, and business audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to translate complex regulatory requirements into practical governance controls and technical implementations.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Advanced degree in a relevant discipline.
* SAP ILM, data governance, privacy, or information management certifications.
* Certifications such as CDMP, CIPM, SAP certifications, or equivalent.
* Experience within food manufacturing, consumer packaged goods (CPG), or related industries.

title: Insights Analyst
description:
**Insights Analyst** 




**A US\-headquartered product company scaling its India insights team** 




**Location:** 
 Delhi, India — hybrid
 



**The Gap This Role Closes** 




 A US\-headquartered product company is scaling its India insights team and has partnered with Flexiple to hire an analyst who can do more than produce reports — someone who reads a pile of usage data, survey responses, and market research and comes back with an actual point of view on what the business should do next. Flexiple is a managed marketplace that helps global companies build high\-performing teams and GCCs in India.
 



 The company already has data. What it is short of is someone willing to commit to a recommendation instead of handing back a chart and letting the room decide.
 



**What You'll Own** 



* Pull together product usage data, customer research, and competitive signals into a single, coherent view of what is happening and why
* Turn ambiguous questions from product and leadership into a research plan, and the research plan into a specific recommendation
* Present findings to stakeholders who will push back, and defend the recommendation on its merits, not just the data behind it



**How You'll Operate** 



* Partner with product, marketing, and strategy teams to understand what decision an analysis needs to unblock before you start it
* Build repeatable frameworks for the questions that come up quarter after quarter, instead of starting from zero each time
* Flag when the data does not support a clean answer, rather than forcing one



**What You Bring** 




 2 to 6 years in research, analytics, insights, or strategy, with a track record of turning data into a recommendation someone acted on — not just a deck someone read. Strong analytical instincts, comfort with ambiguity, and the writing skill to make a complex finding land in three sentences. Working knowledge of SQL, Excel or Sheets, and at least one BI tool.
 



**Nice to Have** 



* Experience at a product or SaaS company specifically, rather than pure market\-research or academic research
* Exposure to Python or R for deeper analysis
* A background in consulting, strategy, or a similarly recommendation\-driven role



**What You'll Gain** 



* A seat where your output is a decision, not a dashboard nobody reopens
* Remote\-friendly, pan\-India hiring with long\-term placement
* Direct visibility into how product and leadership actually use research



**How We Hire** 




 HR Screening → Case Study Assignment → Team Round → Culture Fit
 



 One application is considered for this role and any future matched openings, so there is no need to apply twice.

 This role is responsible for maintaining Workday HCM systems and other modules and providing specialized technical expertise to contribute towards creating an exceptional colleague experience. This role collaborates with global internal customers, peers and various stakeholders to discuss user requirements, problem solve, design, assess available technologies, and develop/ package/ present/ test/ implement solutions.  As a Sr HR System Support Analyst, you will directly contribute to creating an exceptional employee experience, collaborating with teams across the organization to continuously identify, design and execute key digital initiatives that transform how our colleagues work and engage in our tools and enhance the overall colleague experience.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Demonstrated attention to detail and customer service.
* Ability to learn and navigate new systems quickly with a passion for working with systems, data and people.
* Build solid effective working relationships as part of a team and interact with all levels of management.
* Use relevant computer system applications at an advanced level.
* Triage and resolve or escalate global "tickets" timely and effectively.
* Provides technical consulting support for HRIS projects or region/ global system needs \& issues.
* Apply Agile and Design Thinking concepts to come up with and execute solutions to promote continuously improving the employee experience.
* Able to discuss and advise on various solution options to configure Workday to support the global HCM needs
* Focus on every possibility to automate and improve efficiency for the complex HR and security needs globally across various businesses
* Develops business relationships and integrates activities with other departments to ensure successful results
* Researches internal and external global HCM system questions and problems as related to business processes and data.
* Assist in planning, support, communications, and change management, as a result of Workday or other system upgrades and changes.
* Develops requirements for new business process configuration and/or feasibility of implementing existing Workday functionality not currently being used.
* Assists IT in integration problem resolution/ testing.
* Completes data fixes, mass updates and data analysis.
* Influence/ Configure Workday HCM to achieve best manager and colleague experience
* Perform other Workday functional activities such as building calculated fields, report configuration, EIBs and system audits
* Serve as an advisor to solve design challenges by identifying effective workarounds for best end users experience
* Develops advanced level custom reports to extract data from systems, including providing breakouts in excel formatting, pivot tables, or graphs.
* Develop and/or configure custom notifications, help text, custom fields, etc.
* Assesses process/ practices for efficiency and implement recommendations for improvement.
* Support the implementation of solutions that scale and streamline data collection globally.
* Complete reviews with stakeholders to ensure agreement on system data principles. Standardize data parameters, document and revise system design procedures, test procedures, and quality standards. Devise flow charts and diagrams describing logical operational steps of programs.

**Knowledge, Skills And Experience**
* Proven ability to manage multiple projects and tasks simultaneously
* Possesses strong organizational and time management skills, driving tasks to completion
* Strong quantitative, analytical, and creative problem\-solving skills
* Excellent attention to detail
* Ability to adapt to a rapidly changing environment \- Energetic, flexible, and open minded
* Excellent communication skills and able to create and conduct formal presentations.
* Ability to successfully interact with various levels within the organization
* Exceptional customer focus and service orientation
* Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to manage / achieve consensus
* Strong conflict resolution skills
* Ability to work independently with minimal direct supervision
* Experience working in an Agile environment
* Self\-aware and receptive to learning and change
* Intermediate Excel
* 5 or more years Workday experience
* Proficient in 3 or more additional Workday modules (Learning, Recruiting, Advanced Comp, Talent, etc.) with Global experience.


 At TD SYNNEX, our values guide everything we do: Together, We Own It, We Dare to Go, We Grow and Win, and above all, We Do the Right Thing. These principles shape how we work with each other, our partners, and our communities as we drive innovation and create lasting impact.

* Grow Your Career: Accelerate your path to success (and keep up with the future) with formal programs on leadership and professional development, and many more on\-demand courses.
* Elevate Your Personal Well\-Being: Boost your financial, physical, and mental well\-being through seminars, events, and our global Life Empowerment Assistance Program.
