title: Performance Marketer
description:
Performance Marketer
 
  





**Company:** 
 IZGGI Mercado Private Limited
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time \| In\-House
 



**Location:** 
 New Delhi
 



**Experience:** 
 2–4 Years
 



**Department:** 
 Growth \& Marketing
 



  




 About IZGGI
 
 IZGGI is a growing fashion and lifestyle brand focused on building a strong digital\-first presence and delivering products that customers love.
 



 We are looking for a
 **Performance Marketer** 
 to join our in\-house team and take ownership of our paid marketing efforts across platforms. This role is ideal for someone who is highly data\-driven, commercially minded, and comfortable taking complete ownership of campaign performance.
 



  




 The Role
 
 As a Performance Marketer, you will be responsible for planning, executing, optimizing, and scaling paid acquisition campaigns with a strong focus on
 **profitable growth and revenue generation** 
 .
 



 You will work closely with the Creative, Growth, E\-commerce, and Management teams to turn data and insights into campaigns that acquire customers efficiently and scale revenue.
 



  




 Key Responsibilities1\. Paid Advertising
 * Plan, launch, manage, and optimize campaigns across
 **Meta Ads and Google Ads** 
 .
* Manage campaign budgets and allocate spending based on performance.
* Build and manage prospecting, retargeting, and customer acquisition campaigns.
* Continuously test audiences, creatives, offers, placements, and campaign structures.
* Identify opportunities to scale high\-performing campaigns while maintaining profitability.
* Monitor campaign performance and take corrective action when performance declines.



  




 2\. Performance \& Growth
 * Own key performance metrics including
 **ROAS, CAC, CPA, CTR, CPC, CPM, CVR, AOV, and revenue** 
 .
* Track and improve overall customer acquisition efficiency.
* Understand the difference between platform\-level ROAS and actual business profitability.
* Analyse new vs. returning customer performance.
* Work towards improving the overall
 **Marketing Efficiency Ratio (MER)** 
 .
* Identify growth opportunities across products, audiences, campaigns, and channels.



  




 3\. Creative Testing
 * Work closely with the Creative Team to develop performance\-driven ad concepts.
* Identify winning creative angles, hooks, formats, products, and messaging.
* Establish a structured creative testing process.
* Analyse creative\-level performance and provide actionable feedback to the creative team.
* Continuously refresh creatives to prevent ad fatigue.



  




 4\. Analytics \& Reporting
 * Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly campaign performance.
* Prepare regular performance reports with clear insights and action points.
* Analyse campaign, product, audience, and customer\-level data.
* Use
 **GA4, Shopify Analytics, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, and spreadsheets** 
 to analyse performance.
* Maintain accurate UTM and campaign tracking.
* Identify tracking or attribution issues and coordinate with relevant teams to resolve them.



  




 5\. Conversion Optimization
 * Analyse the complete customer journey from
 **ad → landing page → product page → checkout → purchase** 
 .
* Identify conversion drop\-offs and recommend improvements.
* Work with the E\-commerce/Technology team on landing\-page and website optimization.
* Test offers, product positioning, landing pages, and other conversion opportunities.



  




 6\. D2C \& Commercial Understanding
 
 The candidate should understand the commercial side of performance marketing, including:
 


* Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
* Average Order Value (AOV)
* Contribution Margin
* Break\-even ROAS
* Customer Lifetime Value (LTV)
* Repeat Purchase Rate
* COD vs. prepaid performance
* RTO impact
* New vs. returning customers
* Overall profitability



 The objective is
 **not simply to generate sales, but to generate profitable and sustainable growth.** 




  




 Required Skills
 * 2–4 years of hands\-on experience in Performance Marketing.
* Strong experience with
 **Meta Ads Manager** 
 .
* Strong understanding of
 **Google Ads** 
 .
* Experience working with
 **D2C / e\-commerce brands** 
 is highly preferred.
* Strong analytical and numerical skills.
* Good understanding of GA4 and Shopify Analytics.
* Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, events, and attribution.
* Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills.
* Ability to interpret data and turn insights into actions.
* Strong understanding of digital marketing funnels.
* Excellent communication and problem\-solving skills.


- 

 Preferred Qualifications
 * Experience managing a significant monthly advertising budget.
* Experience scaling a D2C/fashion/e\-commerce brand.
* Experience with Performance Max and Google Shopping.
* Understanding of Meta Pixel, Conversions API, and server\-side tracking.
* Experience with A/B testing and CRO.
* Experience working closely with creative teams.
* Experience with marketing dashboards and reporting tools.



  




 What We Are Looking For
 
 We are looking for someone who:
 


* Thinks in
 **numbers and outcomes** 
 , not just activities.
* Takes ownership of campaign performance.
* Can explain
 *why* 
 a campaign is working or failing.
* Is comfortable experimenting and testing new ideas.
* Understands that high ROAS does not always mean high profitability.
* Can work independently and make data\-backed decisions.
* Moves quickly and adapts to changing performance.
* Wants to build and scale something rather than simply manage an existing account.



  




 Key Performance Indicators
 
 Your performance will primarily be evaluated on:
 


* Revenue generated through paid channels
* CAC / CPA
* ROAS
* Marketing Efficiency Ratio (MER)
* Conversion Rate
* AOV
* New Customer Acquisition
* Contribution to overall profitable growth
* Quality and speed of campaign optimization
* Creative testing velocity and learnings



  




 Why Join IZGGI?
 * Work directly with the core growth and management team.
* Own a meaningful part of the brand's growth journey.
* Build and execute strategies rather than simply follow an agency's plan.
* Work closely with creative, e\-commerce, and technology teams.
* Opportunity to take significant ownership as the brand scales.



  




 Application
 
 Candidates should share their
 **CV along with details of the brands/accounts they have managed, approximate monthly ad spend handled, and key performance results achieved.** 




 Candidates who can demonstrate
 **actual revenue growth, efficient customer acquisition, and successful scaling of campaigns** 
 will be strongly preferred.

title: Business Analytics Manager
description:

**Company Overview** 




  





 Fareportal is a travel technology company powering a next\-generation travel concierge service. Utilizing its innovative technology and company owned and operated global contact centers, Fareportal has built strong industry partnerships providing customers access to over 600 airlines, a million lodgings, and hundreds of car rental companies around the globe. With a portfolio of consumer travel brands including CheapOair and OneTravel, Fareportal enables consumers to book\-online, on mobile apps for iOS and Android, by phone, or live chat. Fareportal provides its airline partners with access to a broad customer base that books high\-yielding international travel and add\-on ancillaries.
 



  





 Fareportal is one of the leading sellers of airline tickets in the United States.We are a progressive company that leverages technology and expertise to deliver optimal solutions for our suppliers, customers, and partners.
 



  






 FAREPORTAL HIGHLIGHTS:
 




  




* Fareportal is the number 1 privately held online travel company in flight volume.
* Fareportal partners with over 600 airlines, 1 million lodgings, and hundreds of car rental companies worldwide.
* 2019 annual sales exceeded $5 billion.
* Fareportal sees over 150 million unique visitors annually to our desktop and mobile sites.



  





 Fareportal, with its global workforce of over 2,600 employees, is strategically positioned with 9 offices in 6 countries and headquartered in New York City.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




  





 We are seeking a highly analytical and business\-oriented Business Analyst with 4–5 years of experience to join our travel and hotel division.  This role will be responsible for driving business growth by identifying market opportunities, improving financial performance, optimizing costs, and generating actionable insights across our travel ecosystem.
 



  




* Demonstrates strong analytical capabilities to interpret data, derive meaningful insights, and identify opportunities for business improvement.

* Owns end\-to\-end project execution, including solution design, implementation, impact measurement, and continuous optimization.

* Exhibits a self\-driven mindset with strong stakeholder management skills, capable of coordinating across departments and leading initiatives as a project manager when required.

* Recommend process improvements to enhance productivity and reduce costs.

* Create predictive models and business cases to support strategic decisions.

**Education**

title: GA / Data Analyst
description:
**Role Overview** 
* **Role:** 

 GA / Data Analyst
* **Experience:** 

 2 to 5 years
* **Team:** 

 Analytics / CRO Services
* **Location:** 

 India / Remote
* **Role Type:** 

 Individual Contributor
* **Primary Focus:** 

 Google Analytics, digital analytics, data analysis and CRO insights



  




**About the Role** 
* We are looking for a data driven analyst who can work with digital analytics data, understand user behaviour and turn complex datasets into clear business and CRO insights.
* The role will be closely connected to our CRO and experimentation teams, helping identify
 
**what is happening, why it may be happening and where there is an opportunity to improve conversion** 

 .
* You should be comfortable working across analytics platforms, exploring data independently, identifying patterns and anomalies, and translating findings into actionable recommendations.
* The ideal candidate is not someone who simply creates dashboards or reports. You should be able to
 
**question the data, investigate the reasons behind trends and tell a clear story from the numbers** 

 .



  




**What You Will Own** 
**Data Analysis** 
* Analyse website and product data to understand user behaviour and conversion journeys.
* Identify trends, patterns, anomalies and potential areas of improvement.
* Analyse key metrics across acquisition, engagement, conversion and retention.
* Perform funnel analysis to identify where users drop off.
* Analyse user journeys and behavioural patterns across different segments.
* Compare performance across devices, browsers, traffic sources, geographies and other relevant dimensions.
* Investigate sudden changes or unexpected movements in important metrics.
* Translate analysis into clear business and CRO insights.



  




**Google Analytics** 
* Work extensively with
 
**Google Analytics 4 (GA4\)** 

 .
* Build and analyse reports and explorations in GA4\.
* Work with:
* Events
* Conversions / key events
* Audiences
* User properties
* Dimensions and metrics
* Funnels
* User journeys
* Segments
* Acquisition data
* Understand GA4 data collection and measurement concepts.
* Identify gaps or inconsistencies in analytics implementation.
* Validate whether events and conversions are being captured correctly.
* Work with Google Tag Manager where required to understand and troubleshoot tracking.
* Understand the relationship between website behaviour, analytics implementation and reported data.



  




**Other Analytics Platforms** 
* Experience working with one or more additional analytics or product analytics platforms such as:
* Adobe Analytics
* Mixpanel
* Amplitude
* Heap
* Hotjar
* Microsoft Clarity
* FullStory
* Understand differences in data collection and reporting across platforms.
* Combine quantitative analytics with behavioural data where appropriate.
* Validate findings across multiple sources rather than relying blindly on a single platform.



  




**CRO and Experimentation** 
* Work closely with CRO strategists and developers to identify opportunities from data.
* Analyse conversion funnels and identify potential friction points.
* Use analytics data to support CRO hypotheses.
* Analyse experiment results and understand the impact of different variations.
* Understand A/B testing fundamentals and statistical concepts relevant to experimentation.
* Analyse performance across experiment segments and dimensions.
* Identify whether an observed change is meaningful or could be caused by data quality, traffic mix or other external factors.
* Support post experiment analysis and help translate results into future testing opportunities.
* Understand how tracking and implementation issues can affect experiment analysis.



  




**Data Quality and Tracking** 
* Identify tracking gaps, inconsistencies and anomalies.
* Audit analytics implementations from a data perspective.
* Validate events, parameters and conversion tracking.
* Work with developers and CRO teams to troubleshoot tracking issues.
* Understand basic JavaScript, HTML and website structure sufficiently to investigate analytics implementation issues.
* Identify situations where reported data may not accurately represent actual user behaviour.
* Document tracking requirements and data issues clearly.



  




**Reporting and Insights** 
* Build meaningful reports and dashboards based on business requirements.
* Avoid reporting metrics without explaining what they mean.
* Present findings in a simple and actionable manner.
* Highlight important changes, trends and anomalies.
* Convert analysis into clear recommendations for CRO, product and marketing teams.
* Present insights to both technical and non technical stakeholders.
* Create recurring analysis frameworks for important business and website metrics.



  




**Technical Skills** 
* Strong hands on experience with
 
**Google Analytics 4** 

 .
* Strong understanding of digital analytics concepts.
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills.
* Experience with:
* Google Tag Manager
* Looker Studio
* Excel / Google Sheets
* Working knowledge of SQL is preferred.
* Basic understanding of HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
* Understanding of web tracking and event based analytics.
* Experience with one or more product or behavioural analytics platforms.
* Understanding of A/B testing and experimentation is strongly preferred.



  




**Ideal Candidate** 
* You enjoy digging into data and figuring out what is actually happening.
* You don't stop at reporting that conversion went down. You investigate
 
**why** 

 .
* You are comfortable working with messy or incomplete data and identifying whether the data can be trusted.
* You naturally question unusual numbers and investigate anomalies.
* You can move from a dashboard into raw data when necessary.
* You can explain complex analysis in simple language.
* You understand that analytics is useful only when it leads to better decisions.
* You are curious about user behaviour, websites and digital products.
* You are comfortable working closely with CRO strategists, developers, designers and clients.
* You have strong attention to detail and a healthy skepticism about data.



  




**Minimum Qualifications** 
* 2\+ years of experience in digital analytics, web analytics, data analytics or a related role.
* Strong hands on experience with GA4\.
* Experience analysing website traffic, funnels and user behaviour.
* Experience creating reports and dashboards.
* Experience with event based analytics and tracking.
* Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills.
* Experience working with stakeholders to convert business questions into analysis.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

title: Operations- Performance Analytics- AVP
description:
**Company Overview**
 KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world\-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.
   

  

**KKR's Gurugram** 
 oﬃce provides best in class services and solutions to our internal stakeholders and clients, drives organization wide process eﬃciency and transformation, and reﬂect KKR's global culture and values of teamwork and innovation. The oﬃce will contain multifunctional business capabilities and will be integral in furthering the growth and transformation of KKR.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 KKR is hiring for an enterprise Data Operations group to collect, manage, and harness the power of data across our diverse business activities. The Data Operations Center of Excellence (CoE) is a cross\-functional team dedicated to formulating and driving KKR’s enterprise data strategy while also providing the operating leverage required to bring these strategies and frameworks to life.
   

  

 We are hiring an AVP to lead the Performance Analytics function within the Data Operations CoE. This individual will own how fund, deal, and investor\-level performance is modeled, calculated, validated, and reported across KKR’s private equity, credit, real assets, and infrastructure strategies. The role is accountable both for the underlying calculation logic, including methodology, mechanics, and documentation, and for the reporting and analysis delivered on top of it to investment teams, senior management, Finance, and Global Client Solutions.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on leadership position. The successful candidate will personally build models and write code while also leading a team of approximately three analysts and associates, setting technical standards, reviewing work, and developing junior talent. We are looking for a practitioner who is credible in the details of performance measurement and equally comfortable explaining a result to a senior stakeholder who wants to know why a number moved. The ideal candidate brings 7 to 10 years of experience in performance analytics, investment analytics, or a closely related quantitative function, with substantial private markets experience. Exposure to credit, particularly private credit, is a strong advantage given the growth of that business.
   

  

 We are operating in a 4\-day in office, 1\-day flexible work arrangement.
   

  

**Role And Responsibilities**
* Performance Methodology \& Model Ownership: Own the design, documentation, and ongoing maintenance of KKR’s performance calculation logic across asset classes, including gross and net IRR, MOIC, TVPI, DPI, RVPI, invested and returned capital, Dollars at Work, and levered versus unlevered return treatment. Define and defend methodology choices, including fee and waterfall mechanics, cash flow timing conventions, FX treatment, and hedged versus unhedged presentation.
* Multi\-Level Performance Analytics: Produce and interpret performance at fund, deal, asset, investor, and share class or series level, ensuring results are internally consistent and reconcilable as they roll up and drill down.
* Reconciliation \& Data Integrity: Reconcile performance outputs to accounting and fund administrator sources of truth, investigate and resolve variances, and establish controls that catch breaks before they reach stakeholders. Consume administrator and system\-calculated figures where appropriate while maintaining independent validation.
* Attribution \& Benchmarking: Build attribution frameworks that explain drivers of return and deliver benchmarking and public market equivalent analysis to contextualize fund and strategy performance.
* Credit Performance Analytics: Support credit and private credit strategies with the metrics that discipline requires, including yield, spread, loss and recovery analysis, and average funded balance measurement.
* Reporting \& Automation: Deliver recurring and ad hoc performance reporting for investment teams, senior management, Finance, and Investor Relations, including investor\-facing material. Replace manual processes with automated, tested, and version\-controlled pipelines that are transparent and easy to verify.
* Team Leadership \& Mentorship: Lead a team of approximately three analysts and associates. Set analytical and coding standards, review outputs, prioritize workload, and actively develop the technical and domain skills of junior staff.
* Stakeholder Partnership: Serve as the trusted point of contact for performance questions across the firm, translating stakeholder needs into analytical solutions and communicating results and their limitations clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner with data engineering, technology, Fund Accounting, and Investor Relations to ensure the data foundations, systems, and controls supporting performance analytics are robust and scalable.


**Qualifications**
* 9\-12 years of experience in performance analytics, investment analytics, fund reporting, or a comparable quantitative role within asset management
* Direct experience in private markets is required, including a working understanding of fund structures, capital calls and distributions, commitments and unfunded exposure, valuations, and fee and carry mechanics
* Demonstrated ownership of performance calculation logic and methodology, not solely the consumption of pre\-calculated figures
* Strong command of the core private markets performance metrics, including gross and net IRR, MOIC, TVPI, DPI, RVPI, invested and returned capital, and Dollars at Work, with the ability to explain how each is constructed and where each can mislead
* Advanced Python and SQL skills, with the ability to build, test, and maintain production\-quality analytical code and data models
* Experience reconciling analytical output to accounting or fund administrator data and resolving variances with a documented audit trail
* Experience building reporting and dashboards for senior stakeholders, and comfort presenting figures that will be scrutinized
* Demonstrated experience mentoring, reviewing, or formally managing junior analysts
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain methodology and results to non\-technical audiences
* Meticulous attention to detail, paired with a bias toward structured, formula\-driven, and independently verifiable work
* Strong cultural fit (teamwork, results\-oriented, proactive, and high integrity)


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience supporting AI workloads in financial services or other regulated industries.
* Experience with credit, and private credit in particular, including yield, spread, loss, and recovery analytics
* Experience across multiple asset classes, such as private equity, credit, real assets, and infrastructure
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a quantitative discipline such as finance, economics, engineering, mathematics, statistics, or computer science
* CFA, CAIA, or comparable credential
* Experience with cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake) and BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Sigma, Tableau)
* Familiarity with dbt, Git, and modern analytics engineering practices, including modular transformations and version\-controlled, tested data models
* Experience applying AI, machine learning, or large language models to improve analytical and reporting workflows
* Experience supporting investor\-facing performance reporting or LP due diligence requests.

 Working under the guidance of the Synthetic Data Technical Lead, the analyst will contribute to the delivery of Synthetic Data engagements from requirements gathering through implementation, validation, documentation, and support.
   

  

**Key Role And Responsibilities**
 This Synthetic Data Technical Analyst will be responsible for delivering scalable, secure, and high quality synthetic data solutions to meet exceptional client and internal stakeholder expectations. Standard work includes but is not limited to:
   

  

**Synthetic Data Solution Delivery**
* Analyse source datasets, schemas, relationships, dimensions, distributions, and business rules required for Synthetic Data generation.
* Develop and maintain Python, SQL, and automation scripts supporting Synthetic Data generation and validation.

* Support the creation and maintenance of reusable generation blueprints and framework components.

* Execute data profiling, statistical analysis, distribution testing, and validation activities.
* Validate generated datasets to ensure appropriate levels of data utility, statistical fidelity, business realism, privacy protection, and business\-rule compliance.
* Troubleshoot generation issues, data quality problems, and validation exceptions.
* Support development of reusable validation frameworks and automation assets.


**Governance, Documentation \& Compliance**
* Support governance processes to ensure Synthetic Data solutions comply with privacy, security, and enterprise standards.
* Assist with disclosure risk assessments, validation reporting, and governance documentation.
* Maintain technical documentation, delivery artefacts, audit trails, and supporting evidence.
* Ensure all activities align with organizational data governance and compliance requirements.


**Service Support \& Continuous Improvement**

* Assist with user support requests, issue investigations, and delivery activities.
* Contribute to reusable assets, templates, accelerators, and best practices.
* Participate in knowledge\-sharing initiatives and continuous improvement activities.
* Stay current with emerging Synthetic Data technologies, methodologies, and industry trends.


 The role may require periodic allocation of additional time to support critical deliveries, operational activities, or collaboration with global teams operating across multiple time zones.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Qualifications, Experience and Skills**

title: Senior Associate - Monitoring, Learning and Evaluation ( EAII Advisors )
description:
**This position is with EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India.**
**About EAII**
 EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India, supports state governments in delivering evidence\-based public health programs, including safe drinking water initiatives and school and Anganwadi\-based National Deworming Day and iron and folic acid supplementation. Operating across 10 states, EAII Advisors provides technical assistance to ministries of health, education, water, and women and child development, reducing health burdens in impoverished communities and improving the long\-term wellbeing of children and families.
   

  

 For more information, read about our work here: About Evidence Action and EAII
   

  

**About Evidence Action**
 At Evidence Action, we deliver data\-driven interventions that transform lives at an unprecedented scale. We identify neglected global health issues and deploy proven solutions, forging healthier futures for generations.
   

  

 Our model operationalizes leading academic research (including from Nobel\-winning economists). We measure progress and outcomes at every stage to ensure we're making a real impact for people living in poverty and suffering from preventable or treatable health issues. Operating across 11 countries, our team of 900\+ has reached over 500 million people, working closely with governments to scale these interventions.
   

  

* Our Deworm the World program has delivered over 2 billion treatments, significantly reducing worm prevalence and generating more than $23 billion in lifetime productivity gains.
* Through Safe Water Now, we've saved the lives of over 15,000 children.
* Our Accelerator explores untapped opportunities in global health, testing low\-cost interventions with the greatest potential to save and improve lives.


 At Evidence Action, your colleagues are your greatest asset. You'll partner with high\-caliber colleagues in an environment blending innovation, autonomy, and teamwork. Our team excels in disruptive thinking and believes in rolling up our sleeves to get things done. If you're looking to work flexibly and with purpose, join a team that delivers measurable change for millions.
   

  

**The Role**
 You will be part of our Monitoring, Learning and Evaluation team supporting the successful design and rollout of monitoring initiatives for the India Safe Water programme. The programme is implementing In\-Line Chlorination (ILC) technology in partnership with the Government of India's Jal Jeevan Mission, targeting communities served by Single Village Scheme water systems; ILC delivers safe, chlorinated water at the source and has demonstrated strong potential for cost\-effectiveness and scale. The programme is currently operational in Andhra Pradesh and Madhya Pradesh, with the goal of reaching 17\.5 million people across multiple Indian states with safe drinking water.
   

  

 As the programme portfolio expands, you will contribute to exploring and implementing innovative, technology\-enabled ways of operating at scale. The MLE team plays a central role in generating evidence, ensuring data quality, and informing programme decisions; this role requires significant experience in evaluation, quantitative research, impact assessment, development programmes, and applied data analytics.
   

  

 The Senior Associate \- Monitoring, Learning and Evaluation will be based in New Delhi and reports to the Senior Manager \- Monitoring, Learning and Evaluation.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Monitoring Framework and Systems
   

  

* Support the MLE team in developing programme Theory of Change, Results Framework, Logframe, indicators and measurement protocols aligned with programme objectives
* Develop and institutionalise monitoring tools, reporting formats, data quality protocols and SOPs
* Establish systems for routine tracking of programme outputs, outcomes and key performance indicators
* Work closely with programme teams to ensure that monitoring systems generate actionable insights rather than only reporting numbers
* Support the design and implementation of the MLE framework for the India Safe Water programme


 Evaluation Design and Assessment
   

  

* Work with MLE team to Develop evaluation designs appropriate to programme objectives, including experimental/quasi\-experimental approaches where feasible
* Work with the MLE team to develop sampling strategies, sample size calculations, survey designs, questionnaires and data collection protocols
* Define appropriate evaluation indicators and outcome measures related to safe water access, water quality, behaviour change, service delivery and programme performance


 Data Management, Analysis and Interpretation
   

  

* Analysis of large and complex programme datasets using appropriate statistical and econometric methods
* Conduct descriptive, inferential and multivariate analysis, as appropriate
* Identify trends, patterns, correlations and anomalies in programme data and translate these into actionable programme insights
* Develop approaches for data triangulation across survey and monitoring datasets
* Establish standards for data cleaning, validation, documentation and reproducible analysis


 Data Visualisation and Dashboarding
   

  

* Develop and maintain management dashboards and data visualisation systems to track programme performance
* Translate complex datasets into intuitive visualisations that can be used by field teams for decision\-making
* Design dashboards covering key programme indicators, performance, implementation progress, outcome indicators and emerging risks


 Data Quality and Field Monitoring
   

  

* Work with the MLE team to Establish and implement a robust Data Quality Assurance (DQA) framework
* Develop protocols for data verification, back\-checks, audits and validation of field\-collected data
* Conduct periodic reviews of monitoring data to identify inconsistencies, reporting gaps and potential data quality issues
* Work with field and implementation teams to strengthen data collection processes and address data quality gaps
* Ensure that data collection tools and processes are aligned with evaluation and analytical requirements


 Programme Learning and Decision Support
   

  

* Develop regular analytical reports and management briefs highlighting programme performance, challenges, emerging trends and recommended actions
* Institutionalise learning loops between monitoring, evaluation and programme implementation


 Stakeholder Coordination
   

  

* Work closely with programme, operations, technical and field teams to integrate M\&E into programme implementation
* Manage relationships with external agencies, survey firms, evaluators and technology/data partners


**Requirements**
* 3\-5 years of relevant experience in MLE, evaluation, quantitative research, impact assessment, development programmes, or applied data analytics
* Master's degree in Economics, Statistics, Public Policy, or a related field
* Experience in WASH, safe water, public health, or rural development is desirable

* Proficiency in Stata, SPSS, Power BI, and CAPI scripting. Experience with multiple analytical and data management tools is an advantage

title: Operations & Business Analyst
description:
**Job Description – Operations \& Business Analyst** 




  





**Department:** 
 Business Operations / Strategy \& Operations
 



**Experience:** 
 3–5 Years
 



**Location:** 
 Nutrabay
 



**Reporting To:** 
 Head – Operations / Business Operations
 



  





**Role Objective** 




 The Operations \& Business Analyst will work at the intersection of
 **data, business and problem\-solving** 
 .The role will work closely with Operations, Product, Technology, Logistics, Warehouse, Inventory, Customer Support, Finance, Marketing, and other business teams to identify opportunities, diagnose performance gaps, and convert insights into structured improvement projects.
 



 This is not intended to be a reporting\-only role. The individual should be able to move from:
 



**Data → Insight → Root Cause → Recommendation → Project → Business Impact** 




 The person will be responsible for driving projects from insight identification through stakeholder alignment, execution tracking, and measurable business outcomes.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Business Insights \& Analytics** 



* Analyze business and operational data to identify trends, anomalies, inefficiencies, risks, and growth opportunities.
* Build and maintain dashboards, trackers, and MIS reports covering key business and operational KPIs.
* Conduct deep\-dive analysis across sales, conversion, fulfillment, logistics, inventory, customer experience, cancellations, returns, NDR, serviceability, and operating costs.
* Go beyond reporting
 **what happened** 
 and determine
 **why it happened and what should be done next** 
 .
* Identify root causes behind KPI deterioration and recommend corrective actions.
* Segment performance across products, customers, channels, warehouses, courier partners, geographies, and processes.
* Quantify the revenue, cost, customer, or operational impact of identified business problems.
* Develop business cases for improvement opportunities.



  





**2\. Convert Insights into Projects** 



* Translate identified business problems into structured improvement projects.
* Define the
 **problem statement, baseline, business impact, objective, target KPI, scope, stakeholders, milestones, dependencies, and timelines** 
 .
* Recommend solutions based on data, customer impact, operational feasibility, and business priorities.
* Track post\-implementation results and validate whether expected business outcomes have been achieved.
* Continuously identify projects that can improve
 **revenue, customer experience, cost, productivity, turnaround time, or scalability** 
 .



  





**3\. Cross\-Functional Stakeholder Management** 



* Act as a liaison across Operations, Product, Technology, Logistics, Warehouse, Inventory, Customer Support, Finance, Marketing, and other teams.
* Bring the right stakeholders together to solve cross\-functional business problems.
* Conduct or participate in cross\-functional project and business reviews.
* Ensure stakeholders have consistent visibility into progress, risks, decisions, and dependencies.



  





**4\. Business Performance Management** 



* Track key business and operational KPIs against targets.
* Develop early\-warning indicators for business and operational risks.
* Monitor both leading and lagging indicators to identify potential problems before they materially impact performance.
* Provide leadership with clear, data\-backed recommendations for prioritization and decision\-making.
* Maintain centralized visibility of strategic projects, expected impact, actual impact, risks, and current status.



  





**Major Business Themes** 




  





 The analyst will work across broad business themes rather than being restricted to one operational function.
 


* Identify customer friction across ordering, fulfillment, delivery, returns, refunds, and customer support.
* Analyze warehouse, logistics, inventory, serviceability, and last\-mile performance.
* Improve fulfillment reliability, order\-to\-delivery TAT, delivery success, and SLA adherence.
* Identify structural performance gaps across courier partners, warehouses, hubs, and fulfillment processes.
* Identify cost leakage across logistics, warehousing, inventory, customer support, and operational processes.
* Analyze inventory availability, stock\-outs, ageing, excess inventory, and inventory movement. Identify opportunities to improve inventory turns, allocation, and availability.



  





**Why You Should Apply** 




  




* **High\-Impact, End\-to\-End Ownership:** 
 You won't just build dashboards; you are expected to take projects from data analysis all the way to execution, stakeholder alignment, and measuring financial impact.
* **Cross\-Functional Exposure:** 
 You will work directly with various core departments—including Product, Tech, Logistics, Customer Support, and Marketing—giving you broad operational visibility.
* **Clear Performance Metrics:** 
 The role evaluates success on tangible business outcomes, such as cost savings, revenue growth, and process improvements, rather than vanity metrics.
* **Problem\-Solver Culture:** 
 Perfect fit if you thrive on ambiguity, naturally ask "why" when numbers shift, and prefer a bias for action over long waiting periods.



  





**Why You Should Not Apply** 



* **Not a Pure Data/Reporting Role:** 
 If you prefer strictly writing SQL queries, building Power BI/Tableau reports, and handing off the work without managing people or execution, you will not enjoy this role.
* **High Stakeholder Management Friction:** 
 The role requires pushing back, challenging assumptions, and constantly following up across multiple teams to enforce accountability without formal authority.
* **Ambiguous Problem Statements:** 
 If you require structured, pre\-defined tasks and clear instructions from a manager before starting work, this role will feel overwhelming.
* **Heavy Focus on D2C/Supply Chain:** 
 If you lack interest or background in D2C, e\-commerce, fulfillment, logistics, inventory management, or customer journey funnels, the day\-to\-day focus may not align with your career goals.
* **High\-Accountability Environment:** 
 Performance is tied directly to real business outcomes (RTO reductions, SLA adherence, cost leakage), meaning simple task completion isn't enough to succeed.



  





**Preferred Experience** 




  





**3–5 years of total relevant experience.** 
 Ideally, the candidate should have demonstrated experience in at least 3–4 of the following:
 



  




* Business or operations analytics
* Advanced Excel / Google Sheets
* SQL\-based analysis
* Power BI / Tableau / Looker or similar BI tools
* Business dashboard creation
* Root\-cause analysis
* Cross\-functional project management
* Process improvement
* Ecommerce operations
* Customer funnel analysis
* Supply chain / logistics / inventory analytics
* Business case development
* Product or technology requirement gathering
* Senior stakeholder communication



 Previous experience owning a project
 **from identifying the problem through implementation and impact measurement** 
 should be strongly preferred.
 



  





**Why Nutrabay:** 




 We believe in an open, intellectually honest culture where everyone is given the autonomy to contribute and do their life's best work. As a part of the dynamic team at Nutrabay, you will have a chance to learn new things, solve new problems, build your competence and be a part of an innovative marketing\-and\-tech startup that's revolutionising the health industry.
 



 Working with Nutrabay can be fun, and a place of a unique growth opportunity. Here you will learn how to maximise the potential of your available resources. You will get the opportunity to do work that helps you master a variety of transferable skills, or skills that are relevant across roles and departments. You will be feeling appreciated and valued for the work you delivered. We are creating a unique company culture that embodies respect and honesty, which will create more loyal employees than a company that simply shells out cash. We trust our employees and their voice and ask for their opinions on important business issues.
 



**About Nutrabay:** 




 Nutrabay is the largest health \& nutrition store in India. Our vision is to keep growing, have a sustainable business model, and continue to be the market leader in this segment by launching many innovative products. We are proud to have served over 1 million customers uptill now, and our family is constantly growing.We have built a complex and high\-converting eCommerce system, and our monthly traffic has grown to a million. We are looking to build a visionary and agile team to help fuel our growth and contribute towards further advancing the continuously evolving product.
 



  





**Funding: We raised $5 million in a Series A funding**

title: Business Intelligence Engineer II, AOP
description:
**Description**
 Amazon strives to be Earth's most customer\-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want \- low prices, vast selection, and convenience \- Amazon continues to grow and evolve as a world\-class e\-commerce platform. The AOP team is an integral part of this and strives to provide Data and Science Capabilities to fulfill all customer processes in the APAC, LATAM, IN and MENA Ops businesses.
   

  

 This BIE role sits at a rare intersection and has high growth prospects. On one side, you have cutting\-edge ML/OR models making split\-second cost saving decisions across Ops network. On the other, you have the analytical depth required to understand why those models succeed, where they fall short, and what needs to change. You won't just be observing these models from the outside — you'll own them along with the Scientists. Their performance, their enhancements, their evolution over time — that's your responsibility. When the model needs a new feature, a re\-calibrated threshold, or a fundamentally different approach to a particular corridor or condition, you're the one driving that forward in partnership with the scientists who built it. In some instances you will also directly own these models.
   

  

 The technical challenges here are genuinely complex and rewarding. You'll work with large\-scale, low\-latency data flowing through real\-time pipelines. You'll design automated reporting frameworks that need to be as robust as the system they monitor. You'll apply statistical rigor to evaluate model performance in production, design experiments to validate enhancements, and quantify impact in an environment where conditions shift daily. But beyond monitoring, you'll be the one identifying what's broken, proposing what to build next, and owning the analytical path from hypothesis to deployed improvement. This is a role without a single well\-worn toolkit, you'll have the opportunity to continuously sharpen your skills across data engineering, statistical analysis, and model evaluation to keep pace with the problems in front of you.
   

  

 What makes this role particularly compelling is the combination of ownership and impact. The products you will work on drive millions in cost savings for Amazon Ops. You will also be involved in cutting\-edge research. You'll need to be comfortable with ambiguity. Many of the most important questions in this space haven't been cleanly articulated yet — they emerge from patterns in the data, from model behavior that doesn't match expectations, from edge cases that only surface under certain network conditions. You'll need strong statistical foundations, fluency in SQL and Python and AWS Services, and experience building scalable BI solutions. Your ability to move between deep technical analysis and clear stakeholder communication — and to own outcomes end\-to\-end rather than just deliver reports — is what will make you exceptional in this role.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The AOP Science Team is the central science team of Amazon APAC, LATAM, IN and MENA Operations. We are responsible for creating core science capabilities to scale decision making across domains such as Truck Capacity Optimization, Short\-term capacity planning, Network Abuse Detection, Impact analyses, Productivity improvement Models and so on. As a team our goal is to support our customers to make better decisions by leveraging applied statistics, machine learning, OR, deep learning architecture and algorithms. Team owns end\-to\-end life cycle for science model development which includes data exploration, experimentation, automating near real\-time data pipelines, data visualization and model productionization.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
* Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
* Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
* Experience in Statistical Analysis packages such as R, SAS and Matlab
* Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift
* Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large\-scale, complex datasets

If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

**Staff, P\&C Actuarial, EY GDS Consulting**

Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are looking for a Staff member to join our General Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.
   

  

 Within our talented and dynamic Actuarial team, the members work on multiple client engagement teams that perform actuarial model building and validations, reserving (actuarial liability estimation), due diligence, premium calculation, valuation analysis for IFRS, GAAP, and Statutory calculations and review, capital/risk modeling and other related actuarial projects for General and Health insurance businesses. The team members also receive on\-the\-job training to acquire practical experience in addressing business/technical issues and in applying industry knowledge and EY policies/procedures on client engagements. The position is designed to enable the member to pursue actuarial exams while developing the basic skills needed to be a successful actuarial consultant, combining both excellent learning and career opportunities.
   

  

 Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 As a Staff member within the Actuarial team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
   

  

 On engagements, you will:
   

  

* Be responsible for providing high quality results and generating effective solutions working along with Seniors, Managers or Senior Managers in delivering the project
* Establish/manage priorities, communicate the status of activities, and accumulate/report all chargeable hours
* Maintain/develop productive working relationships with stakeholders and other team members


 Within the actuarial practice you will:
   

  

* Estimate actuarial liability for general insurance lines of business which involves data preparation, data loading to tools, analysis of liabilities and presenting results
* Analyze the historical claims data and identify potential issues and trends and report the findings
* Perform valuation of reserves through IBNR model using the data supplied for estimation
* Review data, methodologies, assumptions, results and benchmark against the market
* Assessment of technical provisions and standard formula/ other capital calculations
* Large loss analysis, rating factor analysis and CAT benchmarking
* Updating the report/memo sent to stakeholders showing results of the analysis
* Maintain strong focus in finishing Actuarial exams along with developing a strong subject matter expertise
* Knowledge of ARIUS or similar reserving software is desirable, but not mandatory
* Exposure to data analytics tools such as SQL and Alteryx is an added advantage
* Familiarity with IFRS 17 and Solvency II frameworks is preferred
* Stay informed of current business/economic developments relevant to the industry/ geography
* Maintain strong focus in finishing Actuarial exams along with developing a strong subject matter expertise


 We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.
   

  

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
 Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organizations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.
   

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* 1\+ years’ experience in the General Insurance industry, either within a consulting firm or an Insurer or an organisation providing Insurance services (such as reserving, capital modelling, pricing, rate filling, CAT modelling, IFRS17, technical provision, solvency II and risk management)
* Ability to multi\-task and flexible work attitude packed with good analytical skills
* Proficiency in MS\-Office Suite, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, Alteryx etc, will be a plus
* Good exam progress


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Strong academic background with a bachelor’s degree with an emphasis in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics or finance related supplemented ideally with a professional qualification
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* Overseas exposure (especially Australia/UK/US/Europe market experience)


**What We Look For**
* Deep knowledge and experience of the insurance industry and/or consulting.
* Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organizations
* Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

title: Business Analyst / Manager – State Integration
description:
***Roles and Responsibilities:***



* Coordinate with State/UT Governments and departments for onboarding of approvals and services on NSWS.
* Analyse and map State\-level approvals, licences, registrations and NOCs for inclusion in the Know Your Approvals (KYA) framework, including applicability based on business activity, sector, location and other relevant parameters.
* Identify gaps in existing State approval information and coordinate with concerned departments for validation and up\-dation of approval details, procedures, timelines and requirements.
* Gather business requirements, map existing workflows, identify process gaps, and prepare functional requirements and process documentation.
* Track State onboarding, KYA mapping, integration milestones, dependencies and issues, ensuring timely resolution with concerned stakeholders.
* Support UAT, validation and rollout of State approvals and related NSWS features in coordination with State departments and technical teams.
* Analyse stakeholder feedback and coordinate with technical teams for resolution of functional and system\-related issues.
* Prepare MIS, status reports, presentations, briefing notes and Records of Discussion (RoDs) for senior management and government stakeholders.
* Ability to translate monitoring functional requirements into required reports and dashboards



  





***Educational Qualification:***



* B.E / B.Tech in any stream Postgraduate in Engineering, Technology, Management, Public Policy, Computer Applications or related discipline will be an added advantage. Experience Criteria \& Desirable Certifications.
* 6–7 years of relevant experience in Business Analysis, e\-Governance, Government Consulting, Single Window Systems, EoDB, or large\-scale digital transformation projects.
* Experience working with State/UT Government departments and government stakeholders will be highly desirable.



  





***Skills \& Competencies Required:***



* Strong Business Analysis, requirement gathering, process mapping and stakeholder management skills.
* Understanding of State Government approval processes, regulatory frameworks and Ease of Doing Business (EoDB) initiatives.
* Experience in KYA/approval mapping, UAT, functional testing and coordination with technical teams.
* Working knowledge of MS Excel and data analysis; familiarity with Power BI and APIs/integrations will be an added advantage.
* Strong communication, documentation, analytical and problem\-solving skills.

title: Consumer Credit Analytics – Global Product Manager - Specialist
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Consumer Credit Analytics – Global Product Manager \- Specialist
   

  

**Overview**
 The Advanced Analytics group within Business \& Market Insights drives Enterprise \& Credit Risk solutions that are globally scalable and provide value to the various parts of the credit lifecycle value chain.
   

  

 Developing relevant solutions that solve our customer’s Enterprise \& Credit Risk problems while leveraging Mastercard assets is a key differentiator to grow revenue for our retail and commercial clients. To this end, developing and managing a suite of product solutions through internal and external partnerships, creative constructs, solid frameworks, and executable roadmaps are crucial drivers for commercialization and business impact. Have you ever used your MA card and it was declined for an unknown reason? We are working to improve that customer experience on a global scale.
   

  

 As part of this role, you will work closely w/ Global \& Regional product teams to ensure a seamless go\-to\-market
   

  

**Role**
* Collaborate and partner closely with the Consumer Credit Analytics team to support global product development and GTM efforts.
* Leverage Mastercard data to quickly identify product performance challenges, creating proactive plans to drive usage and revenues. Use data\-driven insights to ensure our customer are receiving the value from our services.
* Demonstrate a commitment to continuous learning by leveraging the learning \& development curriculum to augment existing knowledge, skills and experiences
* Leverage the Mastercard product management framework to manage the delivery of ongoing innovation and enhancements to focus Products


**All About You**
* Exhibit ownership, agility, and a strong entrepreneurial mindset, taking initiative and driving results in a fast\-paced, evolving market.
* Experience conducting data analysis, understanding MA Data and navigating matrixed orgranizaiton
* Have a problem solver mindset with the ability to investigate potential solutions and drive outcomes
* Demonstrated strong time management skills, effectively prioritizing multiple tasks and consistently meeting deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.
